One of the best places to have dinner in Surat Thani. Great atmosphere but a bit loud. Excellent and diveres food and wines.

Recently dined at Day & Night. It was an amazing experience from start to finish.
The ambiance was cozy and lively, making it a perfect spot for casual dining.
As for the food, it was delicious and beautifully presented.
The prices were great value for the quality, and overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a great meal.
I’ll definitely be coming back!

The food here is absolutely delicious! The starters are great, the pizzas are definitely a highlight, and the ribs were perfectly cooked—tender, flavorful, and seasoned to perfection. If you’ve got room for dessert, don’t hesitate; they’re fantastic and won’t disappoint.

The only downside was the seating. Inside, the restaurant was quite loud, and the air conditioning was a bit too strong. Outside was more pleasant, but there were quite a few mosquitos. However, these minor inconveniences didn’t take away from the overall experience.

All in all, it’s a fantastic spot for a satisfying meal and comes highly recommended!

This place is a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience authentic Thai cuisine in a “European” setting. We tried the braised pork, a signature dish of watermelon with fish, a delicious starter, and rice with pineapple and shrimp. Every dish was bursting with flavor and love!

I’ve found that, in this special spot, the spiciness of the food truly complements the flavors instead of overwhelming them, which has been a rare delight for me. Each dish felt like a beautiful symphony, not just for the taste buds but for the heart too.

I was also pleasantly surprised by the aftertaste. Usually, I can have some side effects after trying new foods, but not this time! I think it reflects the quality and harmony of the flavors I experienced.

Very nice restaurant with - in general - good food. I was very disappointed by the dessert. I hoped for a real Italian gelato (ice cream) but what I got was hard to discribe. The only thing it had in common with ice cream was that it was served frozen. Other than that it was chewy, its taste was artifical I really didn‘t like it. The espresso then was aa again phenomenal.

This place is on an expensive side but worth the price!
The restaurant has been around for quite some time and is consistently busy, which speaks about its popularity. All the dishes I've tried have been excellent, especially the foie gras ravioli and ribeye steaks-absolutely delicious! The complimentary focaccia is also my favorite.
The service is at a standard; the staff is attentive without being intrusive, ensuring you feel comfortable throughout your meal. However, during my last visit, the food service was a bit slower than usual, which disrupted the flow of our dining experience. There were moments when we had to wait longer than expected for our dishes.
Overall, I highly recommend this place for its fantastic food and great atmosphere, but I hope they can improve on the timing during busy periods!

Dear team of Lenzi Tuscan Kitchen,
Thank you for such a wonderful evening. I really do not know how you elevated everything beyond the superb meal on offer. We were so touched by your thoughtful and attentive and unassuming service. It could not have been a better experience.
Really nice find dinning Italian restaurant. Really enjoy their excellent services. Business lunch quite satisfying however the option quite small compare to other shops.

Our party of 4 adults and 2 children were seated promptly on arrival. Service was efficient and smooth. The food authentic, very concentrated flavors, coming from a pleasingly visible tight kitchen brigade. Would highly recommend.

Such great Thai experience! First of all the interior and space, high ceilings, water, beautiful furniture and colours. This is a cozy luxury Thai dining experience. Two chefs, Michelin-starred Chef Henrik Yde-Andersen and Resident Thai Head Chef Berm Chayawee and their team has created menus that makes you leave with a smile on your lips. Their current ”Whispers of the Land” menu focuses on local ingredients from different parts of Thailand. Everything came with a story from the very attentive waiters.

The decoration looks great but the food and service quality undermined the whole experience. Too many tables to serve resulting in staff rushing to present the dishes. Felt more like a mass production line rather than a relaxing fine dining experience. Though the food looks interesting as a concept, the sequence and combination of format of the dishes didn’t meet expectations, especially the taste that did not really complement one another. Still I appreciate that they made it an interactive experience with magic tricks and more, but the quality and value for money was underwhelming.

Absolutely amazing!
It deserves more than just 1 Michelin-star.
Beautiful, tasty, surprising, innovative cuisine.
It's my second time here and not only I was not dissapointed, but it was even slightly better than last time.
Thanks to Pompimol and all the super friendly and professional staff members!!!
Highly recommended.

My partner and I had a wonderful dinner here. We really enjoyed the restaurant's atmosphere. The food is fantastic and full of creativity, which brought lots of joyful moments to us. They even guided us to the kitchen back of the house to fully appreciate how their cuisine is made.
Thanks for the Peachy service. It was one of the most memorable nights in Bangkok. Highly recommended!

The most amazing lunch. We ordered the 3 course meal but chose the different options and shared… so it felt like the 5 course meal. The whole experience was just incredible. A very sensory experience. Service was also fantastic. Highly recommend in Bangkok! Also very reasonably priced

We ordered set menu 19,500 Baht for 10 people. Food quality and quantity is worth to spend. The environment and atmosphere suit for business discussion (VIP room) and also family time. Overall, Im impressed with it.

I’ve been here many time. Foods are nice especially the vegetables menu. They offered fish maw from the very cheap to more of the expensive one.

Fast-cooking, staffs are kind.

Foods are tasty and the restaurant is clean. You can sit down in the private room in case you come with family, friends or business meeting.

One of my favorite Chinese restaurants in Bangkok.
The food in Set 2 should be selected more high quality to match the price. You slice the fish meat thinly.

Made my reservation weeks ago for Lunar New Year reunion dinner with family. This old school chinese thai restaurant is spacious with clean modern interior and have several private rooms. Service is attentive and quiet, staffs are very warm and welcoming.

Food is good and the fish maw soup packed with flavours. The steam dumplings and spring rolls may looked ordinary but its something not to be missed trying. The highlight of the meal is the final dessert, sweet taro puree with gingko. I picked out this place because of that. Its a Teochew specialty and to be honest its nothing special but it has a place in my heart because my father loves it. I remembered as a child, my family traveled to Thailand during Lunar New Year and we had this dessert end of the meal. Now that we are back in Thailand, I want everybody to remember this sweet memory again. The restaurant’s preparation is less sweet and well balanced with the bitterness of gingko and the taro puree is smooth.

Great authentic taste. The fish is fresh. The fried rice is unique with their dried fish that is different from other restaurants. The big flat noodle menus are awesome. Cozy setting - suitable for big families with separate rooms for privacy. Plently of parking spaces. Will definitely go back to try more menus.

Great food and much of the herbs are from their own garden which is beautiful. It has an amazing view of the river too. I'd recommend it to anyone. It's very, very cheap for a Michelin starred restaurant. The garden also makes it one of the most beautiful restaurants I've ever dined in. The curries are lovely so is the fried fish.

This establishment is quite pleasant, and the atmosphere is delightful.
The staff members are exceedingly polite and provide excellent service.
The traditional Thai cuisine is absolutely wonderful.
I would highly recommend the "Kratong-thong" appetizer.
The main courses are exceptionally flavorful and well-balanced, without being overly spicy.
Furthermore, the ice cream for dessert is incredibly delicious.

This Michelin-starred restaurant serves the best Thai food I’ve ever had. Set in a beautiful park by the river, with the option to dine outdoors or inside, it offers stunning views along with incredible food. Prices are very fair, making the experience even better. We’ll recommend it to anyone visiting Bangkok, and it’s now a must-visit spot for us every time we’re in Thailand.
The food was delicious, though the flavor might be a bit mild for Thai taste. However, the presentation and serving were very refined and carefully prepared.

An unplanned destination but turned out super! Loved every dish, especially the dessert. Hard to find a really good Gluay Khai Chuerm these days, but Suan Thip can provide. Moreover, the green garden around us was very cool and refreshing.  Recommend to reserve a table in advance. We visited on Mother's Day and it was the last table, how lucky!

I always enjoy visiting this Japanese restaurant, as the food is incredibly fresh, the atmosphere is pleasant, and the flavors are delightful. I have had the pleasure of trying numerous dishes, including sashimi, tempura, noodles, donburi, and dessert, and each one has been truly impressive. The prices are also quite reasonable considering the high quality of the food, and I would highly recommend it.

Emceerichardstyle Mic Rating
🎤🎤🎤🎤🎤
🙏Itadakimasu!
The food was exceptional, staying true to authentic Japanese flavors with a beautiful presentation that highlighted the freshness of the ingredients!

The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, with a calm and elegant ambiance that sets it apart from other fine dining experiences in Bangkok. You can truly feel the attention to detail, not just in the food but in every aspect of the dining experience.
🙏Gochiso-osama!

Visited Yamazato at The Okura Prestige Bangkok for a refined lunch in a private room.
The presentation of each dish was stunning a feast for the eyes before even taking a bite.
The private dining room was spacious and offered a beautiful view, creating a calm and relaxing atmosphere.
Service was excellent, with attentive and professional staff making the experience even more enjoyable.
A perfect spot for a sophisticated lunch. 🍱🇯🇵

Unfortunately, I’m limited to a 5-star rating on this platform—if I could give more, I absolutely would. My family and I are regular customers of Yamazato, and we all agree that it’s one of the best Japanese restaurants in Bangkok.

The quality of the ingredients is consistently exceptional—always fresh and delicious. The craftsmanship in both cooking and plating each dish is truly impressive. The service is equally outstanding; the staff are attentive from the moment you walk in, and the overall atmosphere is warm and refined. Everything is top-notch, and we’ve never had a reason to complain.

One of our favorites is the giant sushi rolls, generously filled with a variety of seafood and vegetables in every bite. The tempura is also a standout—crispy, flavorful, and never overly salty. The shared mixed sushi platter is not only beautifully presented but also offers a delightful range of flavors from each distinct type of seafood. And the Unagi Don—delicate river eel grilled to perfection, glazed with their signature sauce, and served over steaming Japanese white rice—is simply delicious.

Love the Teppanyaki grill here. The 24th floor views and chef cooking in front of you add to the occasion, of course, but the quality and freshness of the food are what really impress. The set menu of wagyu and seafood is just delicious. Seafood first - quite simply prepared, exquisitely presented, a few Japanese condiments, the flavors are incredible. The wagyu is to die for - melt in your mouth sensations. On a really special occasion, try the top end of the wagyu selection - very memorable.

Best experience fine dining in Bangkok. Elegant yet very welcoming. A masterpiece from start to finish. The service was amazing. The wine pairing was really impressive. Although it was our first time, it felt like we have been coming here for years. The complimentary Birthday dessert was to die for. Will definitely come back again and again. Bravo!

went for lunch! german fine dining. food was really good especially the wild boar pate, duck, trout and lobster! the flavours aren't particularly innovative but definitely on point and balanced. presentation was elegant too

i couldn't appreciate the pasta dish tho which was a supplement- i think can skip

service staff were a lil amateur for 2 stars, maybe because we can't speak thai and there was a language barrier. it was really sweet that the twin masterchefs greeted every guest personally at the door though 😍

wouldn't recommend the wine pairing - maybe also a lot lost in translation due to language barrier

An impressive fine dining experience at Sühring Bangkok. The dishes were creative, beautifully presented, and full of delicate flavours that showcased modern German cuisine at its best.

Shoutout to Nori’s for providing the best service ever!

Sühring is a beautiful blend of modern German fine dining and warm hospitality. Set in a restored villa, it’s elegant yet welcoming. Every course was thoughtfully prepared, from delicate starters to hearty mains, all highlighting seasonal ingredients. We especially loved the appetizers — the trout, lobster, and duck were the most memorable. We tried both the wine pairing and the non-alcoholic pairing, and both complemented the dishes perfectly. Service was friendly without being overbearing, making it a truly memorable dining experience in Bangkok.

I recently celebrated my partner’s birthday at Sühring Bangkok, and once again this restaurant reminded me why it sits at the very top of my fine-dining list.

Whenever I think of the best restaurants in Bangkok, Sühring is always the first name that comes to mind.

The tasting menu is an exquisite journey — premium ingredients combined with masterful techniques and artistic presentation.

Each course arrives like a small work of art, perfectly balanced in flavour, texture, and creativity.

The service is flawless: attentive, warm, and professional without being intrusive, making the whole evening feel truly special.

Visited during stay in Patong, and i would recommend to anyone traveling in Phuket.
Restaurant is beautiful, and at night it looks magical. Hidden from the surroundings, close to the beach, with beautiful garden.

Food has been exceptional! We ordered a set menu, containing of 4 servings, we left full and happy!
To the food we had some cocktails, not paired with the menu, can be an improvement for the restaurant in the future!

As for service, we were welcomed and shown the area around the kitchen, there is a garden where the team is growing their herbs! Its always nice to see the food that later we eat :)
During our dinner while one of us has been still eating the other plate has been already cleaned, so therefore 4 starts, my boyfriend also dropped his fork on the ground, but no one has noticed (he didn’t mind), but as the restaurant is Michelin guide recommended I would expect the staff to notice and replace it with a clean one.

In general i think its an amazing place to visit!

We had a delightful dining experience. We tried two different set menus, and almost all the dishes were incredibly amazing and delicious. Overall, it was a great experience.

The ambiance was beautiful and picturesque, surrounded by lights and candles. The outdoor seating offered a stunning sea view. Everyone at the restaurant was dedicated to making our experience memorable.

The appetizers and desserts were impressive, and the main courses had unique flavors. All the seafood items were delicious, especially the snapper and shrimp.

If you can afford it, I highly recommend visiting this place. Including taxes and sparkling water, the average cost per person was around 2500 baht.

We enjoyed the food and the ambience however, the staff attitude spoilt the evening for us.

Food
1. stir fried pork belly - was good and a different taste from the usual thai fare.

2. Tom yum goong - not sure if this was a taste from the south as mentioned by the server but it was sweet and tasted like tomato soup instead

3. Stir fried merlinjo veg - not sure if I spelt it correctly but it is a local veg and tasted good with it being stir fried with dried shrimps.

4. Grilled seabass - from pond to table concept. Guests get to eat their own catch from the pond. Fish was fresh and grilled nicely .

Wine list - suggest the wine list could be expanded and include more variety of grapes and locations.

Ambience
- nice village/nature set up.

Staff
- the male server attending to our table met the requirements of a server, although the friendliness felt forced at times however, still cordial and acceptable.

BUT he disappeared after we made the payment and it was pouring. We were seated in the indoor glass house and had no way to get to the main area without an umbrella. No umbrella was left for us and no one was around for us.

We were shouting “EXCUSE ME”, “HELLOOO” multiple times and loudly. The female servers at the outdoor patio were SO FOCUSED on their job of pulling down the blinds (facing us yet could not see or hear us). The staff at the cashier were also standing around and we felt they looked in our direction and looked away. but no reaction to come get us.

Both of us were now shouting together and all the staff still could not hear us! They were notified by the guests sitting NEXT to the outdoor counter where the 2 female servers were to let them know we were calling them. Guests could hear us but not them - something we could not understand.

When one of the female servers came over with an umbrella, the following convo proceeded (in actual words).
Us: “you couldn’t hear us shouting excuse me?”
Server: “YA I can hear you now”
Us: “what about just now?”
Server: stared at us and diverted the topic “you want buggy back to room?”

The tone used was impatient and unhappy and her face was as black as the wok.

We were appalled at this reaction and attitude.

Working at rosewood does not mean you’re of an elevated status or was it because we were Asians and not caucasians?

Of course, forget about a tip.

Ta Khai was our favourite meal of the trip!

We sampled a few different dishes, some we chose ourselves and others were recommended by our lovey waiters.

We opted for some of the fresh seafood on display, and the standout for me was the whole Crab which we got wok fried Phad Char. It was herbaceous and spicy, though not overpowering—delicious even if a bit tricky to eat with the shell.

We also got the whole fish - (cooked as Tod Rad Prik Sabparot ) a sweeter dish compared to the others but equally as nice

Another favorite was the Yum Nuea Yang (Thai beef salad)—simple but so well-executed. The Poh Pia Sod (fresh Phuket rolls) also impressed, especially the accompanying sauce which brought everything together perfectly.

The mocktail (Ta Krai fizz) I ordered was incredibly refreshing definitely worth a mention!

Highly recommend if you're in Phuket and looking for something nice

Obsessed with this place!!! Such an amazing menu with fresh ingredients. Paul was the best waiter. He was so kind and made sure we had the best experience. Highly recommend this spot. Great green curry, tom yum soup, and mango sticky rice.

This restaurant is completely deserving of its praise. Had the pleasure of dining with Chef Charlie and his crew at Aulis on Tuesday. The quality of menu and the food was outstanding. Chef Charlie had complete command of the room without having to say a word and was able to spend a good portion of the meal discussing food, life, travel and everything in between. The build out of the restaurant was absolutely beautiful. Special shout out to Arsen, who was a phenomenal host, maitre’d, bartender and jack of all trades. If you’re in Phuket and enjoy fine dining, this is a can’t miss.

Like having dinner with friends…

From the first moment you arrive at Aulis, you know that you are in for a special experience. Arsen, Charlie and the rest of the team work in perfect synchronisation to deliver you a beautifully curated taster menu. Every single bite is an unforgettable experience - neither me or my husband could pick a favourite dish as they are all so beautiful. The menu perfectly exhibits local Thai produce and in trusting the chef’s knowledge and expertise each course is a surprise. The whole experience is only enhanced by the setting - a 15 seater chef’s table where you watch every step as your food is prepared. It also offers you the opportunity to engage with the Aulis team throughout the evening as they talk to you about the food, their industry experience and general conversation. By the time my husband and I left, we truly felt like we had had (an amazing) dinner with friends. I only hope we can be lucky enough to visit again. Thank you Aulis team!

An incredible fine dining experience that is not pretentious and just fun. From very friendly welcomes to interaction throughout all the courses and from an upbeat playlist to nightcaps at the end - just fabulous. The food was excellent,  the use of local protein and ingredients very well put together. The team are passionate and genuinely interested in their guests! Enjoyed the chat and banter. Looking forward to try Aulis in Hong Kong soon. And...the new Roganic.

The Best Michelin Restaurant Experience!

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team for making my birthday truly unforgettable! This was the best Michelin restaurant we have ever been to. It was such a unique and exciting experience—everything from the atmosphere to the food was absolutely perfect. The appetizers were incredibly delicious, and every detail was thoughtfully prepared.

We truly enjoyed not only the food but also the entire process—the interaction with the team, watching how each dish was prepared with such love and passion, and seeing how dedicated and involved everyone was. It was fascinating to learn about how they grow their own vegetables and carefully select every ingredient.

Yes, the price is high, but it is absolutely worth it. I highly recommend this restaurant to everyone looking for a truly special dining experience. Thank you for an amazing celebration!

As someone who isn’t a fan of raw food, and after having experienced most of LA’s Michelin-starred non-Japanese restaurants with Niko, we feel lucky to reserve reservation at this place less than a week in advance.

From the moment we arrived, we were impressed—Chef Charlie personally came out to greet us by name, which has never happened to me at any Michelin restaurant in LA! (Happy +1) I was seated right in the center with a full view of the open kitchen, where the chefs were crafting every dish with precision. (Happy +1) The manager was also kind and even helped arrange a car for us after dinner since we were staying over 50 km away. (Happy +1) for great hospitality.

Food highlights:
•The Wagyu tartare appetizer topped with caviar was absolutely my favorite—so rich in flavor. Even those who typically avoid raw dishes loved it. (Happy+1)
•The prawn was springy and fresh, served raw but with zero off-putting flavor. The broth had a creamy flavor? citrusy finish from bergamot is refreshing (Happy +1)
•The dry-aged beef initially looked too rare, but one bite changed my mind—it was tender yet bouncy, with a light sauce that elevated the meat without overpowering it. (Happy+1)
•The yogurt course was so good I could eat it every day. Didn’t get enough of it! (Happy+1)
•The signature logo dessert was amazing! It is like a mousse with a texture somewhere between ice cream and mousse? likely infused with a bit of alcohol. Unique and memorable. (Happy+1)

Since Niko and I aren’t big on alcohol, we skipped the wine pairing and didn’t want any sweet soft drinks either. Even just with water, the food stood strong on its own—more refined than most Michelin spots in LA. The chef clearly has high standards, down to the precise plating. The ambiance combined postmodern minimalistic luxury with greenery, making the whole dining experience relaxed yet elevated.

A few downsides:
•The opening duck dish didn’t taste great.
•One mushroom-based dish was overly salty.
•The water glasses were awkwardly large and hard to grip.

Overall, I’d give it a 9/10, and hope to see them earn 3 star soon!

— Stacy L & Niko L

2024 Michelin guide beef noodles in the Khon Kaen city, about 15-20 minutes from Khon Kaen Airport. The restaurant is on the roadside. You can park the car on the side of the road. Afternoon weekdays are not crowded, no need to wait in line. The main menu is beef noodles, starting at 70 baht, the price is affordable. Beef was so tender, umami tasty beef soup. There is also meat and pork satay with Peanut Sauce.
Great local food. Eating with local people is a good experience.
One of the best local beef noodle spots, made with care and cooked to perfection. The beef was tender and meaty and the soup was just right Thai flavor.
Some of the best beef noodles I have had in Thailand! Very strong beef flavor in the nam sai(clear) soup. Staff are all very friendly.
Best food I’ve eaten in Thailand so far. Incredible value and amazing quality with extremely friendly employees. Khob khun krap
Great food. Worth Michelin Gourmand title. Soft shell crab with garlic and chef Omelette are excellent. The seafood rice noodle salad is also good. Must try if you up are in Chiang Mai.

Very basic for the price that you are paying here! The Michelin Gourmand rating probably brought in too much attention to them. But the restaurant is made very much for expats and tourists and doesn't actually bring down the originality of the Thai flavour that one would expect while travelling. Even for the expats it's not an amazing place. I had the "Thai basil rice with shrimp" which was very average and the omelette with minced pork which was very oily.

Very homey place. Drinks are self service. Food is quite fast, but maybe cuz we went nearly their closing time so not many tables left.
The food we ordered were tasty. Stir fried soft-shell crab was exceptionally delicious. Really recommend.
Apparently the place is famous among Korean tourists also.
Got their chef omelete and yellow curry stir fry...its tasty but lack of some omphhh..can try but not worth your time to queue. I came at 630pm on tuesday, no wait..
The soft shell crab with curry tasted extremely good. Highly recommend the omelette as well. Portions are pretty big, so be careful of over ordering. Loved it here! Great food

I’ve been to this restaurant four times during my two separate visits to Bangkok. Some of the dishes were a bit underwhelming while some were exceptional. I would high recommend 1.spicy and sour shrimp soup with lotus root 2. Tom yum soup 3. Cowslip flowers with either shrimp or pork mince.

We were fortunate to got a chance to try michelin (bib) restaurant and it was really worth it. Everything tastes amazing especially crab and prawn. We also tried coconut ice cream which was super delicious and i would recommend trying it out!
The downside was parking which was quite difficult to find (took us around 10 min) and too many tourists leading a but noisy for us. The service was also great.
Delish food & reasonably priced. Love every dish we ordered & will definitely go back again to try others on the menu

I heard that the founder of the restaurant was ex-chef of Royal family so we came here to eat. We asked a staff and he recommend us 6 dishes. All were enormous portion, mouthful, dedicate, sophisticated and delicious like exactly what we expected. We will definitely come back here again.
I didn't feel the need to go to the main store, and in fact, I enjoy visiting this place. Great taste foods and friendly staff. I think that it's one of the best restaurants in Bangkok.

I had the joy of hosting a family dinner at Celadon, and it turned out to be such a delightful experience. From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly attentive—anticipating every need and offering warm, welcoming service that made us feel completely at ease and well looked after.

The flavors were unforgettable. The green curry stood out as one of the most delicious I’ve ever tasted—creamy and perfectly spiced, with a depth of flavor that lingered long after the last spoonful. And those duck spring rolls… absolute perfection. Crispy on the outside, tender and flavorful inside—truly a dish to remember.

But it wasn’t just the food that made the evening special—it was the entire atmosphere and level of service. The staff remained calm and efficient throughout, checking in just enough to ensure everyone had everything they needed without ever feeling intrusive.

All in all, it was truly one of the best meals I’ve had, not just because of the exceptional food, but because everything—from the green curry and duck spring rolls to the top-notch service—came together seamlessly to create a memorable and heartwarming family dinner.

Extremely gorgeous restaurant with great ambience. The three of us had the sharing set menu, most of the food was alright but we couldn’t appreciate the sour soup. Grilled chicken skewers were a little tough and the stir fry morning glory was a little too salty. The best dishes were the freshly grilled river prawns and the chicken fried rice. On hindsight, we might have enjoyed ourselves more if we ordered ala carte and choose the dishes that we liked more.

They have traditional thai dance performance at 7:30 and 8:30pm and it’s well worth your time to schedule your meal around these timings to watch the beautiful performances. Service is great and not overly intrusive. The restaurant is decorated nicely with traditional Thai influences. Truly quite a memorable dinner experience.

Will return.

Location 地点: 4
Ambieance 气氛: 5
Service 服务: 5
Food 食物: 4
Tableware 餐具: 5
Stems 酒杯: Riedel

We've their family tasting menu, which is less than the full tasting menu: but it’s still bit too much for me to stomach.

This Michelin 1 star restaurant is in the Sukhothai (site), a few steps from our hotel COMO.

The story of Thai celadon: "Behind this modern stoneware from Thailand is a story that goes back more than two thousand years in time. Celadon 青瓷 is known as the aristocratic oriental ancestor of the pottery family and takes its name from the elegant glaze developed by the master potters of the northern China to duplicate their beloved opaque jade. ..."

Coming off a busy street, the lotus ponds put you in a serene mood. The high-ceiling interior is tastefully decorated. Orchard at the entrance and a single lotus flower at each bare table, beautiful and straightforward. The glass partition makes the two areas spacious.

Their service is good. Well-trained staff are around but not intrusive.

The food: from crabmeat-filled dumplings to grilled chicken (free-range) skewers, to big river prawns, ... I find the veggie Morning Glory with garlic and red pepper the most interesting: it's the 通心菜, the most ordinary veggie in Hong Kong, that I love. Not that I mind, but I'm a little surprised to find it served the way an ordinary restaurant on Main Street does. When I've guests over, I always put the veggies in a bowl, then flip it onto a serving plate to give it a slight shape.

Coming down a high horse, is pretty adorable.

Enjoyed the tasting menu with my family of 6.  Snappy casual is fine. We were not guests of the hotel and intentionally came to the restaurant based on a recommendation from a colleague who lived in Singapore.  Snappy casual is fine...plenty of hotel guests who were dressed in general resort wear.  Atmosphere was great...very comfortable and higher end feel.  Food was very good and enjoyable...glad we tried the restaurant once.  Waitress/servers highlighted each course and explained it which was nice. Service was a bit lacking....waitress disappeared for extended periods of time.   Time between courses was longer than what we expected.  We arranged an early dinner reservation so I don't believe the kitchen was overwhelmed.  Cultural dancing features was a nice touch.

I was somewhat disappointed from the food. Given the fact that it is supposed to be a Michelin Restaurant the food was rather average (at maximum). The Starter somewhat tasted like old paper and the main course was cooked same as in a streetfood stand. I expected much more and was disappointed. The local Thai dancers contributed to a good and somewhat authentic feeling.

Had an amazing experience at Royd - from the minute I stepped into the restaurant till the end! The food was so well executed and beautifully plated and taste was so refined for all the dishes. We appreciated how the chef personally came to explain some of his dishes and small talked with us. The sommelier and kitchen staff were very pleasant throughout too. Food is on the spicy side - only thing is because the place is small and cozy you can hear your neighbours’ conversations

My third visit here was just as delightful as the first.  I truly appreciate the authentic, spicy Southern fine dining dishes made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The atmosphere was charming, and the service was warm and attentive.

When I tell you, I had an experience with food. Let it be known that Royd gave me exactly that. Chef had me trying out locally sourced ingredients, I've never heard of before used in dishes, explaining concepts behind each dish exceptionally, telling me of his laziest meals after work. The food here, tell a story and I could feel that in every dish. I don't think they were prepared for how much I would ask about food and their personal connection to it. There was nothing I didn't want to know and I love that they made feel comfortable enough to ask
We enjoyed an exceptional 8-course dinner at Royd. Every dish was thoughtfully crafted and full of flavor, offering a wonderful tasting journey through Southern Thailand cuisine.

Chef Luca recommended me to try this place and indeed it was pretty good. Southern Thailand bold flavors, which is very interesting and appetizing to me. Love the duck and rice main dish. Dishes were great, but pairing was not very well done and seems the somm doesn't speak much English. Didn't manage to chat with the chef as he was busy with an important table of guests. Overall service was still good, but short of a good fine dinning place (such as providing a wrong menu) and not every staff can communicate well in English. On top of the pairing, I ordered a separate bottle as I was craving for a lighter wine. The selection was limited as with most of restaurants in Phuket.

Overall, food is still very enjoyable, if you want something different, spicy, bold southern flavors that are made in a modern way.

The food was just okay, but the environment was great and the staff were all very friendly. The best thing there might be they they offer small size meal so ppl come alone can try diverse dishes.

The fried rice with crab lacked “wok hei” flavor, the stir-fried cabbage with shrimp was only average — too salty, with shrimp that were tough and overcooked. The best one would be the stew pork ribs with red wine sauce.

Overall, it just wasn’t to my taste😔

Michelin-starred restaurant
The crab meat omelette is delicious! Initially thought it was a bit pricey, but it’s worth it. Lots of crab meat, great flavor.

Watermelon with pork floss, a simple pairing, tastes fresh and delightful, with a crisp texture and good savory flavours .

Lotus flower dish, served with petals, well-balanced flavors, delicious.

Red wine sauce pork ribs, great taste, ribs cooked until very soft.

This restaurant is amazing, a must-try.
Recommend making a reservation in advance.

Their food is good, authentic Thai and on the spicy side. The crab omelette has chunks of juicy crab meat. It's so fresh and flavorful with spices on the side, perfect for the heat intolerant diners. Pork in brown Tom yum is a stew with tender and juicy pork but the spice kicks in a bit late. The fried noodle is reminiscent of pancit with a different  flavor profile.

reviewer: Thai Massage NYC Village Thai Spa
review_text:
Love Thai food Baan Landai,
Amazing thai food in Chiang Mai. We had a great time nice and warm people working here. The food was the best I been eat since we were in old town Chiang Mai. Reservation is the best. We’ll see you again.

The pork of tom yam gong and the local noodle soup were very delicious. We found this place on google map and walked in without reservation, but it was fully booked. We were lucky, there were people left after a few minutes. I definitely recommend it.

If you’re looking for amazing seafood in Samui, Ban Suan Lung Khai is a must-visit. The quality of the seafood is outstanding.

We ordered the big seafood set, it was incredible! The crab was the highlight: unbelievably fresh, meaty, and full of flavor. Every dish in the set was cooked perfectly, showcasing the great quality and freshness of the seafood.

The atmosphere is simple and relaxed, which makes the freshness of the seafood stand out even more. Each dish feels authentic and made with care, giving you the real taste of Samui.

Highly recommended for seafood lovers who value freshness and quality above all.

it's a bit of a drive to get there, but trust me, it's so worth it! They have a few set menus, and we went for the 1200/person one. The table was absolutely covered in food, and the seafood was super fresh, everything was delicious.

​My favorite surprise was this stir-fried coconut dish, something. I never had it before but after one try, I was in love!

​Just remember to book in advance.
I'm definitely going back.

(Here is the picture of coconut dish I was talkingabout, and the dessert I kept re-ordering again and again, love it 😍)

I visited Baan Suan Lung Khai restaurant and really enjoyed the food — everything was delicious! There were only two of us, so we ordered the 500-baht set menu. The place was recommended to us, and I’m glad we tried it.

However, I didn’t know that some of the dishes could be refilled. The staff only mentioned that we could get more rice, but didn’t tell us that the side dishes were refillable too. It was a bit disappointing to find out afterward.

Also, the staff didn’t check on us very often. We had to walk to the kitchen a few times to ask for things, which made the experience a little less convenient.

Overall, I had a great dining experience and would definitely recommend the restaurant. I just hope the staff can provide clearer information next time — it would make the experience even better!

More than a seafood dinner! It is an experience to eat inside a forest

We had a set menu of 700 thb / person
Great value for what we received
Very FRESH seafood and I love the idea not having a menu
My favorite dish is mantis shrimp — exceptional
The pandan rice is fragrant and creamy
I also love the pandan dumpling with coconut milk ( dessert )

I found the staff very friendly despite of limited English .

Recommended !! The area is nice for sunset time worth to go for earlier dinner !!!

Beautiful place with below average food ( unsalted crab, oysters without vinegar), stuff was very unhelpful, nobody could speak any English and looked very arrogant. And I totally get that it’s a restaurant in Thailand and people’s native language is not English, but there was 0 local people, every guest was a foreigner. Do not recommend to go there.

A Memorable Experience at Chef’s Table

Our visit to Chef’s Table was nothing short of exceptional. The food was truly excellent – each dish reflected impressive technical precision and creativity, with beautifully balanced flavors. The wine pairing was exciting and well thought out, complementing the menu in a way that elevated the overall experience.

Service was impeccable – attentive, knowledgeable, and warm, striking just the right balance between professional and personal. It’s clear that the team takes great pride in every detail.

This dinner will remain one of the most memorable Michelin experiences we’ve had. Truffle and caviar were featured as optional enhancements to some courses. While already used thoughtfully within the menu, their addition could be better presented as a way to complete a dish rather than feeling like an upsell.

One minor point – the live piano music, while elegant and well played, was a little too loud at times for our taste, slightly interfering with conversation.

That said, it was a truly unforgettable evening that fully lived up to its reputation.

It was quite the experience! Everything was perfect; the food, the service, ambience and views. Chef Vincent was so friendly and engaging. The staff were all very professional yet warm. The flavours were amazing, such genius. The price of dining at The Chef’s Table is on the high side but it’s such a wonderful experience that my partner and I agreed that it was worth it. Will certainly be back for a special occasion next time.

This was only our third Michelin restaurant experience, and we actually flew into Bangkok for the night as a break from our beach vacation in Phuket. Overall, the experience was good, but not great. The food was, as you'd expect, beautifully presented, and tasted good, although a few of the items were not to our taste (which is fair enough). We did the wine pairing, which again was good, but not great. Can't really say why, other than it leaned into whites (and a cider!), and we tend to prefer reds.

Our main issue was the upsells before dining. This is already a pretty expensive endeavor for most of us, so the upsells for more caviar, more truffle (and one other option I forget) got a little tedious, and it made the whole thing a bit tacky. Have it as an option on the table perhaps, but we don't need the song and dance.

We stayed in the hotel, which as others have said, is looking worn in places. I don't know how to describe it, the room was huge, and well appointed, but the overall vibe was a typical 1990's US Marriott, so not really becoming of the restaurants at the top.

An amazing experience if you are into star cuisine. Everything is well organized and scripted. The dishes itself were wonderful and depends on personal taste and were made with high effort. The piano was a way to loud which makes it hard to understand things if you are to close to it. All courses were explained well, maybe a more personal touch overall was missing but thats anectotal. Again an outstanding tastingjourney that takes care aswell of the little things which is worth a visit.

Service was excellent no doubt. Food was okay, consistent taste not too complex. Food presentation wise, it was well prepared chef gave attention to details. The restaurant decoration was nice but where it is situated doesn’t suit well with the restaurant. The hotel is extremely old and needs alot of repairs. We would think more than twice to return.

I booked Punjabi Grill for 2 people and we had a fantastic time. The atmosphere and decor was high quality, the service was outstanding and extremely helpful. The food was amazing, quantities were perfect and flavours were incredible. It was my partner's first time experiencing Indian cuisine and she had a fantastic time. Will definitely return and recommend.

We went for dinner on Diwali eve and had a wonderful experience!

The service truly stood out for us. A special mention to Sunita for her exceptional hospitality — from the moment we were seated, she helped us choose the right dishes and made sure all our preferences were taken care of. She really made our evening extra special! We’d also like to appreciate Jeevan for his attentive and courteous service.

The food was excellent — the Lucknowi Tikki was one of the best we’ve had! We also really enjoyed the Malai Kofta and breads. The Avocado Galauti was not great, we had expected better.

The live music was also really nice.

Overall, we had a lovely dining experience and would definitely recommend this place for authentic Indian cuisine in a fine dining setting.

It’s been more than 4 years since I have returned to have a meal at Punjab grill and I got to say I was blown away by the overall environment , ambience , service and the food quality. Not the typical kind of local Indian food you would expect but Punjab grill has incorporated a fusion of Thai spices with indian local favorites especially their naan and curry. I personally would endorse anyone who is staying in sukumvit to go there for a meal as it is indeed Michelin worthy.

This restaurant is recognized by the Michelin Guide 2020-2025, and it truly lives up to the reputation. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was excellent — attentive, polite, and professional. It’s clear why the restaurant has received such accolades.

However, one disappointing aspect of our visit was the seating arrangement. We came as a party of two but were seated right next to a large group of about 20 people who were having a noisy party. The noise level was very distracting and took away from what could have been a more enjoyable dining experience. What made it more frustrating was that there were still many empty tables in other, quieter parts of the restaurant.

Despite this, I would still recommend the place for its food and service, but I hope the restaurant will consider better table management in the future, especially when quieter seating options are available.

Everything was amazing.  Service was incredible with Sunita ensuring that we all had a great time and that our plates where full.  The food was beyond delicious (we did the non-veg tasting menu) with each course bringing new flavors and smells. Enjoy!

One of the most impressive Asian restaurants I have ever been to!

Sorn is truly exceptional in preserving the authenticity of traditional Thai cuisine while adding a subtle touch of modern creativity in the presentation. Each dish is a masterpiece with beautiful plating and mouth-watering flavors that perfectly balance the essence of Thai taste.

The team takes great care in selecting high-quality local ingredients and blends them harmoniously from one dish to the next. Every bite showcases the diversity and depth of Thailand’s culinary heritage, elevated to a fine-dining level without losing its soul.

I honestly cannot find enough words to praise them. The best I can say is that if you are a food lover, you simply must experience Sorn for yourself.

The food was excellent, but honestly I would expect more from a 3 starred.  In all fairness, everything was cooked to perfection and the taste was on point.  It’s rather spicy, so if you cannot handle spice, make sure you let them know early on.  Service was good, not perfect though.  I like the fact that they sanitise the loo every time someone uses it.  However, the service was not in point yet, and the food, although very good, doesn’t feel like it’s “value for money”and have not had anything I felt like it’s new or “surprise, guess we are paying for the stars.  Good place to try southern thai food.

Amazing Southern Thai Food

I’m Thai, but I was surprised to try so many new ingredients I’ve never had before. Everything was super fresh and full of flavor. Every dish was delicious, and I ended up eating way too much—in a good way!

The service was great. We went on a rainy day and took the BTS. They picked us up from Sukhumvit 26 close to BTS and even gave us towels and shawls to stay dry and warm. Really thoughtful!

The price is totally worth it for a 3-star Michelin meal.

The only downside was that the table next to us was a bit loud, so it was a bit hard to hear the staff explain the dishes. But overall, it was an amazing experience. Highly recommended!

Hands down the best fine dining restaurant in Bangkok. The level of refinement in the food, service and ambiance was a level above the others. So many details here, tasteful story telling and precise service only added to the amazing flavors and execution of the food. Truly a 3-star restaurant and worth all the money and effort to get here. One of the finest if not the finest meal you can in Southeast Asia.

🌟 Dining at a Michelin 3-star in Bangkok 🇹🇭 was truly unforgettable! Focused on fresh ingredients from Southern Thailand 🌶️🍋, the flavors were bold, tangy & spicy — absolutely incredible. The cozy atmosphere made it even more special 💫. Super hard to book 📅, but every bite was worth it 🙌✨ #BangkokEats #MichelinStarExperience

We came here without knowing that it was a Michelin star restaurant. But it was a great surprise.

It had a very good atmosphere with excellent decor.

The food is great. We had the le crispy pork with Thai basil and the khao soi with braised beef. Both very good. The appetizer mix is also very good for the price.

The waiters are very efficient and friendly.

One of the best Pas Thai in town. Deep fried Lotus root is amazing as well as Fresh Spring Roll. Steam seafood curry in young Coconut is one of my favorite.

Cocktail and drink are amazing.
The service is excellent. Just communicate and explain how I would like the level of spicy because I am not prefer spicy and not sweet.

Overall is one of the best in town👏

I visit this restaurant since I was in high school and now almost 30 yo. The atmosphere and service are amazing but the food options are limited. They mostly serve Thai fusion/ twisting food but the taste is good. The price is generally higher than others. It is usually fully booked during high seasons or festivals. Not many parking. Better make a reservation before you go.

What a pleasant surprise this was. Without any expectations we reserved a table here and were stunned what was about to follow. We felt like we have traveled back in time. Back to a time where smartphones have not been invented yet and people were still talking to eachother. A time where a visit to a restaurant was about the food and the atmosphere and not about instagramability.
We  ordered the braised beef which was de-li-cious. Such a round taste, with tender bites of slow braised beef in a heartwarming coconut sauce. The dumplings and the other appetizers were on point where as the beetle leaves stood out. I would definitely come here again even tho it is, in comparison to other Thai places - a bit more expensive.
Absolutely delicious! The flavors were perfectly balanced and authentic! One of the best Thai meals I've ever had. The staff was kind and welcoming too. Highly recommend.
Great view and amazing food.  Wonderful people.   Their menu is has some unique items, definitely should visit if in the area.
Tom kha was nice. Place has a good location but atmosphere inside is not so cozy as it could be.

Look no further than this hidden gem in Ubon Ratchathani! They specialize in delicious local fishes and you can enjoy  Klong river view. The restaurant is recognized as Michelin guide too.

From fresh river prawns to succulent fish, every dish is prepared with traditional Thai flavors and a touch of local flair.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience the true essence of Thai cuisine. Visit this local restaurant and savor the flavors of Ubon Ratchathani!

Not sure why this place has low-ish reviews, the food is very nice! Staff are friendly. We wanted to try the giant river prawns and they were very clear about the price for them. This is Northeast Thailand, so you will probably need a bit of Thai language ability to travel easily here. I have a feeling a lot of confusion comes from foreigners not understanding the place.
They are good at the fish menu. Try to stick to the fish dish then you won't regret.

The steak is excellent, cooked to the perfect doneness (I ordered medium rare). The flavor is delicious, the staff provide great service, and the atmosphere is quiet and peaceful (especially in the evening). The parking area is spacious. Highly recommended for steak lovers!

I had a pleasant experience at Vacca Italian restaurant. The nice ambience and good-tasting food, paired with nice coffee, make it a great spot to enjoy a meal before catching a flight. The fast service is a plus, especially with the convenience of being just five minutes away from the airport. It seems like a perfect pre-flight dining choice!

Gracious hostess awaits our visit ! 50 % off pizzas before 5pm ( 17:00 ) !!! Unexpected yet great discount, 2 two scoop ice creams for the kids = yummy factor 😋, comfortable interior space with attractive art, and other objects of decor. Our pizza was wonderful 👏,  Vacca treats people right ✅/ back again update ; they are open until 9 :30pm ..came by on my way to the airport and had Tiramisu and ice cream ! Love the staff and great atmosphere 👌//// Update ; Aug 2024 & thoroughly enjoyed our four cheese pizza / mozzarella, fontina, bleu & parmesan. The base was well suited for the cheeses w/ crispy edges and a light dry finish. Always enjoy Vacca, the are Michelin award recipients and they earn their prestigious awards 🏆!!! Update ; Songkran 2025 ; Fabuloso ! Australian 200 gr. ribeye so tasty & cooked med rare to perfection. Love Vaccas crinkle cut fries, garlic toast - fresh, tasty, crispy, abundant portions. I had a fine caesar w/ out the chicken and it was very good. Yes , dessert , I thought you would never ask 😉, biscoff  & dbl. choc. gelatos...rich, creamy, flavor packed - two scoops 1/1 finish a Grand meal. The light jazz  allows a  slower more enjoyable pace to dine, converse, and take in the amazing decor, art, wine collection/ offerings & more. Roma tomato colored ceilings w/ subdued spot lighting quite romantic in nature. One of Khon Kaens very best , please experience for yourselves, no risk , only a rewarding day or evening ! As always on a final note the staff is gracious , efficient, clean , expeditious and here year after year after year 🏆.

So close to the airport I didn't even thought possible to have a restaurant of that level. Decoration is already welcoming you. Good taste all over. Even if prices are high for Thailand I think it is worth to go there for lunch or dinner. Well prepared meals good presentation and so delicious. Worth to spend a couple of hours there before your trip.

I have been to Vacca's restaurant about 5 times in the last few months and have had a steak on each visit (always takeaway). It is by far the best steak I have tasted in Khonkaen, and when I think about it the best I have had in Thailand. That last bit was said with the caveat that I have only had steak about 7-8 times in the 11 years I have been in Thailand and that is because of the disappointing steaks I have tried

I have also tried the pizza and a few of the pasta dishes, simple but delicious.

The staff are really friendly and helpful, however a glass of water would be appreciated while I wait for my takeaway.

Vacca's isn't cheap but is well worth a visit.

This restaurant is not to be missed. You will find a lot of delicious E-San food here which is hard to find anywhere else. My favorite is the bbq fish paste in banana leaf and the signature stir-fried chicken with chilli jam. The overall flavor has toned down to not very spicy so I can enjoy most of the dishes.

Great food and great atmosphere. Been here twice and both times the food was excellent. Serves local Khon Kaen cuisine including a dish with fermented river barb which I find fantastic. Might not be for everyone.

Praprai Khon Kaen is a north eastern food restaurant . The location is near Khon Kaen  airport. I recommend Pla Som Tod ( Pickled fish deep fried) and Pad  Cha Pla Beuk ( Stir fried spicy with Giant fish) served with  hot  sticky rice.It was very delicious. SomTum( Papaya salad)  was indifferent.
Michelin guide 2024 recommended restaurant
Isaan food at an affordable price close to the Khon Kaen Airport

restaurant_name: Jok Guay Jab Tom Sen Bat Queue
review_text: Even the outlook of this dish is super messy but first bite is very delicious! Btw the last bite kinda weird, recommend to have coke beside you.

restaurant_name: Jok Guay Jab Tom Sen Bat Queue
review_text: The one and only boiled noodles shop! They have a unique dish that has boiled noodles which is not the same as any other noodle shop. To the best of my knowledge, this is the only place who make this dish!

restaurant_name: Jok Guay Jab Tom Sen Bat Queue
review_text: i like to mix everything. it’s a street food so don’t expect the atmosphere to be clean. but it’s worth a try and a good late night meal

restaurant_name: Jok Guay Jab Tom Sen Bat Queue
review_text: Delicious. Super busy in the evening

restaurant_name: Jok Guay Jab Tom Sen Bat Queue
review_text: Loved it. Must try 😻
Great food. Not impressive with the poor quality of audio system though. Otherwise love the variety of the menu.
Legendary of the Chaiyaphum's north eastern food style

The place is a comfortable restaurant and banquet hall, not far from the city. There is a lot of parking, very convenient. Today I went to a birthday banquet. The banquet hall is beautiful. The sound system is good. The table setting is beautiful. There are neat tablecloths. The chairs have beautiful covers. They look clean. The staff are well trained. There is no interruption in the queue for serving food. The food tastes good. They use fresh ingredients.
Suitable for holding meetings or parties, good atmosphere, delicious food.
Delicious food, good service, fresh, clean, able to organize a complete party. Recommended.

Basically street food in a restaurant setting. Family style dining experience with dishes to share between everyone at the table. Items are all very well prepared but we did find the crab omelette slightly underwhelming. Everything else was very good though. Staff are helpful and service is fast and efficient. Worth dropping by if you’re in the area.

Highly recommend open kitchen Thai restaurant if you like spicy food. Their curries were good as well as the freshness of ingredients. Highly recommend the oyster appetizer. Very nice service as well. The only downside was there is no parking space. Advance reservation is recommended.

Charmgang really impressed me. The food was full of flavor — every dish had a nice balance of spice, freshness, and depth that made it stand out. It feels creative but still very Thai at heart, which I really enjoyed.

The atmosphere is fun with the neon lights and open kitchen, and the staff were friendly and helpful throughout the night. Prices are not the cheapest, but for the quality and experience, it felt worth it.

It’s the kind of place I’d definitely come back to with friends, since sharing and trying different dishes makes it even more enjoyable.

Stop reading and book a table immediately!

This is the best meal I have eaten in Thailand. This place is an awesome blend of delicious food in a relaxed setting.

The vibe is great, the restaurant had a real buzz about it and the staff were all smiling, and that is always a huge positive!

Too many places are doing bad versions of "elevated thai food" and falling short. Charmgang on the other hand does it perfectly. Exceptional flavor throughout, everything was bright and well balanced, I loved everything we ordered. Great use of spice and smoke.

We started with duck wafers which were crispy and super tasty. Scallop topped cupcakes were fun and delicious and the fish bite wrapped in betel leaf was a slap in the face with huge flavors.

We moved on to the pork jowl salad which tasted like the best glazed ham! And we had the smoked fish curry which was inspired. So so tasty.

I can't reccomend this place highly enough. Ive had some really dissapoiting Michelin starred tasting menus in Bangkok on this trip, and charmgang was such a refreshing change. Exceptional!!!!!

The vibes is this place is good! Two days before our dinner reservation they WhatsApp me to confirm and check if we’ve any food allergies and if there was any special occasion

When we arrived they greeted us at the door with warm smiles the moment we hopped off our ride! Servers explained that they have a tasting menu available too or we can place Ala carte orders and then there’s the daily specials.

The scallops on cupcakes were perfectly done!

We tried their most spicy curry ever! The Chanthaburian Chicken curry is out of this world. Very tasty curry with bananas, sweet peas and mini Thai eggplants. The cardamom gives the entire dish a very nutty flavour to it but boy when the heat hits u at the back! They have us a slice of rose apple with coconut sugar on top of it to help with the heat!!! And it does work!

Must try their crab omelette with bean sprouts. One of the lightest and fluffiest Thai omelette we’ve had

Most intriguing texture was the veggie stir fry which was mainly succulent bite size chunks of water bamboo stir fried to perfection

The staff were just fabulous!!!

Will definitely be back every time we revisit Bangkok

Dining at Embassy Room La Marina was truly a delightful experience. The atmosphere was elegant yet relaxing, and the dishes offered a unique and memorable flavor. The highlight of the evening was definitely the salt-grilled fish — perfectly cooked, tender, and bursting with natural freshness, balanced by just the right touch of savory seasoning. Other dishes were equally impressive, combining creativity with refined presentation that showcased the chef’s craftsmanship. Special mention goes to Jack, whose professional and warm service made the entire dining experience even more enjoyable, leaving a lasting impression and making the evening feel truly special.

Visited with friends for lunch. The food was exceptional and the service absolutely exquisite, thanks to Pu. The new chef, Alessio, is super funny, engaging, and incredibly talented. The head of F&B, Alex, also came to greet us.

10/10 for both the Vongole Spaghetti and Casoncelli Gamberi e Zucchine. If you have a sweet tooth, I recommend the Tiramisu and lemon sorbet. 100% Nonna style!

I’ll definitely be bringing my family next time.

This restaurant is truly a hidden gem. Thanks to Joi, who gave us exceptional service with such kindness and professionalism, our experience was absolutely fabulous. Because of him, we will definitely come back on our next trip and even consider staying at this hotel just to enjoy this wonderful restaurant again. A big thank you for making our evening so memorable!

Amazing lunch experience at Embassy Room La Marina! The food is fresh and made with top-quality ingredients. Chef Alessio is kind and friendly. Don’t miss the Melon & Prociutto, Tuna Tartare, Burrata and Tomato & Casoncelli di Gamberi, ravoli is also homemade and super delicious, and the Patagonia Toothfish, incredible. Also, you can’t miss Tiramisu, the best!

We had sunday brunch with voucher bought from Thai Tiew Thai.
- outstanding services, friendly, they’ve tried their best to please you.
- great quality of raw materials
- too big of a portion (perfect for a table of 4 to share them)
- lamb is so tender and juicy, however it shouldn’t be named “grilled lamb” to mislead our expectation.
- comfy and relax ambience with the gentleman with “banjo” , or something of that sort, playing live music
- for “italian brunch” , we would preferred something less fantasy but focus more on pasta section. (This is just our own preferences since we love pasta so much)

Extremely happy to dine like a local Thai! Quite an experience and the Roti is delicious! Crispy & tasty! The goat curry is awesome! Love it!
The fried chicken with Kao Niao is good!
Price is cheap!!!
Very satisfied brunch infeed!!!

Tried this lovely place straight from the airport after arriving, it closes at 1.30pm so it's mainly for people who want breakfast or lunch. My Wife and I had the famous Roti (which is a type of paratha), with Massaman Beef curry, and a bowl of Goat meat curry (which was not on the menu but recommended) . The Massaman was very flavourful and almost sweet in comparison to the Goat meat curry which was excellent and beautifully spicy. A breakfast of champions! Also it was full when we got there but only a 30 second wait for a table. The food service was fast considering it was very busy. Just a minor issue...the sign of the premises is written in Thai ,so we had to confirm with the staff that this place is Roti Chaofa and a lot of them speak English so no problems there, also most of the customers are local which is a good sign.

A must-try breakfast spot in Phuket. It’s been featured in several food guides and included in the Michelin Guide for a few years now, and it definitely lives up to the hype.

The goat curry is packed with flavour and highly recommended. The roti is also excellent, you can choose from a few variations. The plain one is great, but I especially loved the egg and cheese roti. Everything was fresh, tasty, and satisfying.

Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in Phuket!

We couldn’t resist coming back to Roti Chaofa twice during our trip!

The crispy fried chicken was seriously addictive, especially paired with sticky rice. And don’t get us started on the chicken skin… so crunchy and flavorful! The roti was perfectly crispy on the outside, soft inside, and the curry was rich and flavorful.

Friendly staff, fast service, and real local flavors. A must-visit spot when in Phuket!

Wonderful place for my first time in phuket! I love the cultural atmosphere. The goat curry roti fried chicken sticky rice chicken sauce with onion crisps is delicious. Thai tea matcha mixed drink. The staff was so nice and helpful . The ladies are so very kind and helped me with my grab while it was raining. I recommend this place to everyone they treated me like a local🙏❤️

"On The Rock Restaurant" boasts delicious food and stunning views of Karon Beach. Set against a backdrop of picturesque mountains, beautiful beaches and crystal-clear waters, it creates the perfect setting for a memorable dining experience.

The restaurant has good views of the sea and the beach... Food wasn't that great... Only good part was the ice cream. It also has direct access to the beach, in case you like to take walks post dinner. Service was very good any fast. Courteous staff.

Stunning views, great service and delicious food!

We originally stopped in only for a drink as we weren't hungry and staff were super gracious about this removing our cutlery etc! The cocktails were awesome and ultimately seeing all the food come out we changed our minds again the staff were gracious and gave us placemats cutlery etc without complaint.

We settled on a green curry and asked for it to be extra spicy and they delivered and delivered well! Great amount of coconut cream and not watered down like some places

Shame we weren't hungry because I can't wait to go back and try more dishes!

The views are simply beautiful too!
We

This place is a must-see in Thailand. Book for the balcony at around 6pm to catch a beautiful sunset. You’ll also notice there’s a fire show on the beach around 7-8. The food was simply spectacular, beautiful cocktails. Very easy to split the bill and pay if you’re with a group.

Food was great. Staff was well behaved and accommodating.

But man the view is unbelievable. One of the best view I’ve ever enjoyed in a restaurant. Must visit if you are in the west coast of Phuket.

The restaurant is hiding from main highway. It has nice ambience with collection of Star Wars characters.  The food is tasty with wide varieties menu but wine list is limited. Service is second to none. I went there on weekdays, so parking is plentiful with efficient parking staff. The restaurant is worth many revisit.

We-La-Dee Cafe & Restaurant is an absolute gem! From the moment you step in, you're greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The food is simply delicious – every dish I've tried has been fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. What's even better is how reasonably priced everything is, especially given the high quality.

Beyond the fantastic food, the service truly stands out. The staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and go above and beyond to make sure your dining experience is enjoyable. They're always ready with a smile and helpful recommendations.

As an added bonus, it's wonderful to see that We-La-Dee is accessible, featuring a convenient wheelchair ramp. This thoughtful inclusion makes it a welcoming spot for everyone.

I highly recommend We-La-Dee Cafe & Restaurant for anyone looking for a superb meal, excellent service, and great value. You won't be disappointed!

Teddy-themed. Beautifully designed - visually impressive. The decor is warm, elegant, and visually impressive — perfect for families, groups, or anyone looking for a relaxing dining experience. There’s a private zone available, which adds a nice touch for more intimate gatherings.

The menu offers a fusion of Western and Thai dishes with wide appeal. Most flavors are light and balanced — suitable for various palates. The carbonara could have been creamier and thicker, the Thai dishes were well-presented.

Service was attentive and professional. Overall, it's a lovely place— especially for those who appreciate charming interiors. Highly recommend making a reservation during peak hours.

The restaurant’s decor was nice with adorable bear themed for decorations.

Ordered 8-9 dishes with drinks, for a total of 2,800+ baht.

For a highly reviewed restaurant and a Michelle Star restaurant, the foods were average.

3 Stars for me, as the restaurant have alot of flies flying around..... for me that's a No No.

I would avoided the soup... extra ingredients were discovered.

Good to make reservation before heading down to avoid the wait.
One of the best Thai food dining experience in Chiang Mai. The food is high quality and authentic. The service is attentive and considerate. A great ambience for celebrations or a family dinner.
WOW! AMAZING FOOD! best we had in Thailand so far! must visit in town!!

Quaint restaurant, loved the decor.
The meals were just OK, nothing special for a restaurant in the Michelin guide 2021, 22, 23 and 2024.
Service was poor, staff spending more time looking at their phones than attending to the customers.
Pity as we expected more after quite a drive to get there.

May be I made wrong choices of dishes or may be not.. this is the total disappointment and I really have no idea how they’ve got michelin bibgourmand. At least the grilled pork should be good since I expect every Thai restaurant could be master of it. Except the pounded tomatoes and eggplants with assorted veggies, all other dishes have very poor taste. And it’s quite expensive so I wasn’t happy at all to pay for what I didn’t enjoy or can’t even finish.

Food is utterly amazing, really top drawer. Thai Omlette, Papaya salad and prawn soup were my favorite.
Also very cheap for the quality and service experience (€40 for 6 people!). We will be back

This place was highly recommended by Google and all. I've been visiting many other similar places here in Chiang Mai and I can say that this restaurant is not like what I expected. food looks good but did not taste good and service was also below standard, not attentive and slow and it would have been difficult if we cannot speak Thai. If you are English speaking visitor, please be aware that communicating can be difficult. Parking for car wasn't an issue as you can park along the street. Enjoy.

The bak kut teh soup was salty but rich.We ordered the sharing pot at 500 bht. The ingredients only contains 4 pieces of meat,4 slices of pig tail and a handful of innards. We also tried the fried basil and minced pork with white rice, cucumber and a fried egg. My personal take is good to try if you pass by but it doesn't do justice to the value if you are looking for a meal. Will not want to return to try it again.

Thian Leng Bak Kut Teh: A Delicious Dive into Bak Kut Teh

Thian Leng Bak Kut Teh offers a truly authentic Bak Kut Teh experience. The rich, savory broth, infused with the perfect blend of herbs and spices, is the star of the show. The tender pork ribs is delicious. The restaurant itself has a cozy and inviting atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for a family dinner or a casual meal with friends. Highly recommended for Bak Kut Teh lovers!

Kitty and I, along with a group of friends, were on a road trip through Thailand, making our way from Phuket to Krabi. Our friend had planned Thian Leng Bak Kut Teh (เทียนเหล็ง บะกุ๊ดเต๋) as one of our lunch stops, as it had rave reviews on Google and we were all craving some delicious Bak Kut Teh.

We quickly learned that this restaurant is highly acclaimed for its exceptional Bak Kut Teh, a traditional Malaysian pork rib soup.  Thian Leng has even earned a spot in the Michelin Guide for its authentic and flavorful Bak Kut Teh, which is prepared using a secret recipe from Kedah, Malaysia.  As soon as we entered the shop, we saw a display of their Michelin awards, a testament to their consistent quality and excellence from 2021 to 2025.

The soup is slow-cooked with a blend of Chinese herbs and spices, resulting in a rich, aromatic broth that is both savory and medicinal. The pork ribs are incredibly tender and fall off the bone easily, making for a truly satisfying and comforting meal.

We ordered the signature Bak Kut Teh, and it truly lived up to the hype.  The broth was flavorful and aromatic, and the pork ribs were cooked to perfection.  We also couldn't resist trying the pork blood and a comforting porridge, which were both delicious and perfectly complemented the Bak Kut Teh.

The restaurant itself was visited by locals and tourists alike, and the atmosphere was casual and welcoming. The staff was friendly and attentive, and we felt well taken care of.

Thian Leng Bak Kut Teh is a popular destination for a reason.  It's a recommended visit for anyone in the Phang-Nga area looking for an authentic and delicious Bak Kut Teh experience.

I am a Malaysia-Cantonese. Bak Kut Teh is originally from my province and the original recipe born.

This restaurant is super close the taste as Malaysia Bak Kut Teh. It is one of the best I have in 'Thailand'. The restaurant without any bullsxxt advisor and any chef recommending awards, but it is the 5 stars Bak Kut Teh I will rate by my sharp-tongue of Cantonese, trust me.

How did I miss this place? I must have driven by 50 times and never noticed.
The point is, I love Malaysian style Bah Kuh Teh. I like a nice, dark broth, lots of Chinese medicine smell, you know what I'm saying?!
Sorry Singapore.
This place hits the spot. You can smell it as soon as you open the car door. Pork was tender, Cha yen was good, and I'm coming back.

Really good restaurant with beautiful view and amazing service. Prices are higher than usual but well worth it because of portion size and it is Michelin rated. The soft shell crab there in any dish there is amazing. The fried ice cream is also really really good.
Great view, delicious food and attentive service. Better to come a bit before sunset: at around 5pm groups of people started coming, and tables got taken.

Come here for the view and great service. The food was barely average. We ordered shrimp cakes, which were good. Fried pork with garlic and pork in curry were bland. Our stir-fried morning glories were boring. Crab fried rice my son could make better.  Again, go for the views. They are fantastic.
Lovely place with amazing view, friendly stuff and super delicious food. Must visit when in the area.
There was only our table when we went there. Very nice view and quiet. Food was good especially the banana blossoms salad. Reasonable price for food and the view combined.

A nice clean and simple Chinese Thai restaurant with a touch of class in culinary cuisine especially the crab omelette, fried garlic prawn, delicious tom yum (non spicy version is fantastic) and seafood. Price is reasonable and wallet friendly. Coffee is great there too.

Non aircon so prepare to sweat it out.

We came here after seeing it in the Michelin Guide and it did not disappoint. The legendary stir-fried beef was absolutely packed with flavor, tender and perfectly cooked. The crab omelet was another highlight – fluffy, rich, and full of sweet crab meat. Simple setting but world-class taste.

I stumbled upon Por Pochaya completely by chance — had no idea it was a Michelin-listed spot! I managed to get a table right away, probably because it was close to closing time. The restaurant is only open for 4 hours a day, from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

Some dishes were already sold out, but the staff were super friendly and gave great recommendations.

The place has a cozy. Prices were reasonable and portions were just right.

I have to say — the garlic fried pork liver was the best I’ve ever had. So tender and flavorful, it just melted in the mouth. The spicy pork cartilage tom yum, crab omelet, and fried king mackerel were all amazing too.

There’s paid parking available at the hotel next door, which makes things really convenient.

Definitely a hidden gem worth visiting again!

Food was so bold and punchy!

Highly recommend the morning glory with garlic and pepper and Tom yum khun. So comforting, the flavours were balanced well and everything was cooked perfectly tender. The pork tongue was overly sweet for my taste.

Iced Thai tea with espresso shot went down like smoothly. Not too sweet.

The atmosphere was buzzing and I was the only foreigner

Great old school Thai-Chinese restaurant with all the tasty Thai treats you are looking for. Lots of seafood but also pork and egg dishes. The place has the weirdest opening hours. They are only open a few hours every day. Except for weekends. So make sure to use your chance when you happen to be around during their opening hours. They also have a coffeeshop in the restaurant.

I hate to have to write an average review but I can only speak from our experience. We had no reservation and managed to get a table with no problem. The staff were all friendly and the restaurant is beautiful however for most of our meal it was either in silence or a crackling speaker above us that was intermittently working. The air con was super cold, often a positive but I felt it was a bit too chilly.
Onto the food, yes it's higher in price than other areas but I would expect that in the location. The starters were average at best, we had crispy sea bass (I think) and pork skewers. Really not the best start to the meal.  The mains I'm pleased to say we're a lot better. The steak, marinaded egg yolk and rice were perfectly cooked and my red curry was one of the best I've tasted. The pork and pineapple cooked perfectly.
Although the staff were welcoming downstairs, I felt the service was a little cold at times and they cleared our main courses far too quick.
The main courses made up for the negatives but I would not return.

This Thai restaurant specializes in Eastern Thai cuisine, offering a distinctive and stylish menu that’s not easy to find in Bangkok. The dishes highlight fresh ingredients from the East, with flavors that are both authentic and delicious.
