We got the tasting menu at Tambu, and every dish made us feel like we were right in India — bursting with authentic spices, herbs, and depth of flavor. At first, I was a bit worried that everything would be too spicy, but I was pleasantly surprised — I could taste every note: sweet, savory, salty, and rich.

The starters were already strong contenders, especially the ragda — flavorful, comforting, and a perfect start. From there, each course built beautifully toward the mains. My favorites were the butter chicken and the lobster — both perfectly balanced and full of character.

Some of the chefs even came out to explain the dishes themselves, which made the experience more personal. One of them even served us an extra portion of butter chicken, which was such a thoughtful gesture and definitely a highlight of the evening.

The place itself was beautiful and had a relaxing ambiance. Although it was a bit cloudy that day and we couldn’t see the sunset, the view and atmosphere still made the experience special.

It was also a meaningful night because I celebrated my partner’s birthday here. Our server, Lenny, was incredibly helpful and thoughtful, making sure we understood and enjoyed every dish. Knowing that Lenny was also a kababayan made us feel even more at home.

The executive chef personally checked on us to ensure everything was perfect — and it truly was.

A wonderful dining experience from start to finish — flavorful, heartfelt, and memorable. Highly recommended!

On our all boys trip, we decided to eat at Tambu, since we were staying at the Avista.
The experience was surreal. On a cool July Phuket night we were treated to some excellent food.
It began with the following;
1. Palak Patta Chat- This was uniquely made with liquid nitrogen. They in-fact wheel a cart to your table just like chaat-gaadis.
2. Potato Starter- Very good.
3. Paneer Tikka- The most fresh and succulent paneer I've ever eaten.
4. Daal Makhni- Lip-smacking- kudos to you chef.
5. Missi Roti & Saag- Hot, tasty and full of flavor.
6. Biryani- Had meat didn't eat.

Anusha and Sushmita- you guys are fabulous! We enjoyed our time here.

Wow - such an amazing experience here. I took my husband for his birthday celebration, he loved it very much.

The food is amazing - we did the courses with wine pairings. I especially loved the lamb dish.

The atmosphere also very nice, I recommend to go during sunset time for the best view (: and that day we went - the hotel had a fire show!

And i have to say all the staffs are very polite, friendly ! Love love everything. Thank you Tambu

When I found out that Tambu won a new award, I decided to visit them again. It was my second time at Tambu, and every time I think it can’t get any better, they surprise me! The new dishes were incredibly delicious and beautifully presented. I was especially impressed by the dessert tower with five different fillings. And on top of that, there was a stunning fire show. Thank you, Tambu, for the amazing experience!

The food absolutely lives up to the hype — beautifully presented, rich in authentic Thai flavors, and clearly prepared with care. Every dish we tried was delicious and well-seasoned, especially the Local grill fish is to die for. It’s clear why the place is recommended by Michelin and so popular with both locals and tourists.

However, the experience was unfortunately overshadowed by the wait time. We had to wait nearly two hours for a table, and although the staff was friendly, there was little communication or accommodation during the wait. For a restaurant of this caliber, I had hoped for a smoother or more organized system.

In short: amazing food, but be prepared to wait — and bring your patience. It’s worth visiting, but ideally with a reservation or on a quieter day.

Another pearl in foodland!
This place we had dinner today.
The ambiance is super cosy. Big place but nice set up, good lighting,  very cosy. You want to stay longer. The food is amazing 11 out of 10, everything we ate was very delicious! Staff very helpful, kind and polite. I fully recommended anyone who loves a traditional Thai restaurant to visit this place.

Hidden gem! 🍛 The fried rice here is unlike any other—packed with flavor and perfectly done. Loved the short mackerel curry, but the standout was the Moo Krob Sam Chan with egg lava—absolutely divine! 😍 Great vibe, amazing food—10/10 for taste and atmosphere. 🌟🍽️

Deserved 5 stars if river prawn is available. Unfortunately, was out of stocks even though we came at 6pm.
The rest of the food was exceptional. But be prepared to wait for your lovely food to arrive. Must order: the recommended special steamed rice... Die die must try
Plenty of wine and cocktails to get the ball rolling
Had an enjoyable dinner. Worth the wait

This was one of the worst Thai food experience. We have waited for our food for over an hour. I’m pregnant and I was very hungry, we had to rush them with the food twice. No one warns you that it will be that long, if we knew we would go to another place. Forget the food, my husband has waited 20min for his beer and my smoothie took about 30mins. Water came fast, just 10 mins. The waiting time is ridiculous and that’s with the case that we didn’t wait for a table and booked in advance.

Also it wasn’t that busy, no queues lining up, as you can see not even all the table were taken when we ordered.

Food is nothing special. Out of 6 dishes I liked one, which is barracuda larb. We came here for specifically barracuda order, but they didn’t really have any other dishes available except larb. The omelette was terrible, the worst I’ve ever eaten, others were okay. After one hour wait for Thai food (which is the fastest cooked food ever) I expect it to be heavenly good and not below average.

Prices aren’t worth it. Stuff is all over the place, difficult to call.

The restaurant is pretty though and they have good parking.

I had crispy pork noodles here. I loved my food. The atmosphere is also perfectly local, authentic, and non-fancy.
(I found this restaurant through Michelin Guide).
His cooking is skillful! Food very suitable for me tasty 😋... Wish to try more dishes from him the next visit, thank you! 🙏🏿
Found this place from GuideMichelin App. Popular for Mee Klob Pad Se Ew. Must try!!!

- Local Rad Na, original
But there are many more menus
- You can park your car next to the building next to the foundation. Walk a little bit more. In front of the shop, you can only park motorcycles.
- The shop opens at around 4 pm.
- Eat at the shop, wait a little bit because the orders are always online.
- Next time, I will go to eat "Chicken Stir-fried with Cashew Nuts" 😋

reviewer: ร.อ.หญิงมาศสุภา
review_text:
This restaurant's facade isn't particularly noticeable. It's a shophouse with an old-world feel, with high ceilings and a spacious feel. The tables aren't crowded, but every table is occupied. The kitchen is located at the back, creating a spacious space.
The tables are clean,
the shop is bright,
and not stuffy.
The drinking water is clean.
The vendors are friendly and attentive.
The Rad Na isn't particularly spicy, but it's delicious.
Those who prefer it spicy may want to add more seasoning.
The kale is crispy, and the pork pieces aren't very large, but they're tender and fragrant with sesame oil.
Overall, it's delicious. If you're passing by, I recommend stopping by. The prices are reasonable. I'll definitely try the a la carte dishes next time.

restaurant_name: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom
review_text: Must try spots if you want to experience authenticity northern Thai flavor. The shop is simple and local, but the taste is unforgettable. The Khao soi here has rich, creamy curry broth with the perfect balance of spice and coconut milk.

restaurant_name: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom
review_text: Best Khao Soi!! A must try. As featured on “Somebody Feed Phil”. Had the beef and it was so tender. Good spice and amazing flavor. Ask for the air conditioner room with the washrooms. It is $10 TBH a person but worth it!

restaurant_name: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom
review_text:
One of the best Khao soi noodle shop in Chiang mai area.
It’s old and not so clean shop but has great taste of Khao soi all over the Chiang mai.
This shop is very famous that no need to explain furthermore.
Just visit this restaurant and trying should be enough.

restaurant_name: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom
review_text:
This Khao Soi shop is one of the famous spots in Chiang Mai and I can see why. The khao soi here is rich, creamy, and really flavorful. The beef is tender and the crispy noodles on top make it even better. The place is small and simple but feels authentic and welcoming, with lots of photos on the walls.

For me, the taste was really good but a bit on the spicy side. I managed to finish the whole bowl but my stomach felt hot the rest of the day. Still, I loved it and think it’s worth trying if you want a true local khao soi experience in Chiang Mai.

restaurant_name: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom
review_text: One of the best Khao Soi in Chiang Mai. The broth is rich and balanced, the spiciness is perfect 🌶️, the beef is tender, and portions are generous . Simple authentic atmosphere, great prices. No wonder it’s a true legend among locals and tourists ✨
Absolutely the best meal we have had in Thailand so far. True northern Thai cuisine and so delicious! Recommend the fried Chiang da leaves and minced pork Laab

A fantastic choice when looking for authentic Northern Thai dishes - and only 30 minutes by car from the old city area - and their dishes are bold and spicy and fragrant and fabulous! The frog is juicy and fresh and the mango salad is demanding and yummy. There are beans and eggplant and shallots and pig blood cakes and rice noodles and cracklings and sticky rice, and everything is hearty and delicious. Remember to look around and enjoy the sight of rice fields and coconut trees and the natural beauty of North Thailand. 👏🫰👏

Thai northern food that I really recommended. Taste like the original Thai northern food in the real atmosphere. Be sure that you make a reservation.
If you are a new beginner ,try fried pork and chilly paste (Nam prik) with sticky rice.
If you are an advanced, they Kang hoe or Tum manoon and Kang Pak pang .
❤️

We ordered the spicy sour fish soup and fried fish and everything was really delicious the soup was rich and flavorful the fish was fresh and well cooked and the beautiful view of the rice fields made the meal even more special this place is worth a visit

The food is very authentic, which very good for the tourist who want to taste the real Northern Food. But for the people like my friend who not good at new style food, she could eat only ขนมจีนน้ำเงี้ยว 😅😅 but for the people like me who loves to explore the new taste, this restaurant of course worth the try.

restaurant_name: Mae Khlong Hua Pla Mo Fai
review_text:
They do not accept the reservation on weekend so you should come as soon as possible. The parking was a bit limited but they have another parking nearby. While the restaurant was quite large, it got fulled really quick as well. They offered indoor and outdoor.

All dishes were large, pricey and delicious. I meant it is okay for quality but we had higher expectations than this and you better come with a group of friend or family. Honestly, the prawn in fish sauce was the only amazing dish (IMO). The others were delicious though.

restaurant_name: Mae Khlong Hua Pla Mo Fai
review_text:
The seafood at this place is really fresh. The must-try menu is Ithe river prawn, it’s one of the best I've ever tasted, way better than what I've had at other restaurants. It’s super delicious and not too salty. The squid is also quite large and fresh.

However, I did visit during a busy lunchtime, and the way they manage the lines could use some improvement. I ended up waiting quite a while.

restaurant_name: Mae Khlong Hua Pla Mo Fai
reviewer: N U N W O R
review_text:
Wow! It takes 3 hours to wait and eat. I came here on Sunday at 12:30 PM and there was a 50+ queue and I was realized that is waste your time and not worth to waiting.

Overall, the food tastes good, but I am quite disappointed with the colossal crab meat omelet (ไข่เจียวปูโครตใหญ่). It is made with a mix of chicken and duck eggs. So it was hard, dry texture especially the crab meat was not exceed my expectations, but I usually do not eat duck eggs.

Additionally, the staff didn’t mention any food allergies before get the order.

I would not say no to trying, but I wouldn’t recommend it. If the queue is shorter than it is now, just come.

restaurant_name: Mae Khlong Hua Pla Mo Fai
review_text: The food is great overall, but it’s a bit overpriced at this location. I also had an issue with the crab: I was told it would be 1,600 THB, but the bill showed 1,980 THB with no prior notice. The staff said the higher price was due to its actual weight. I expect them to be clearer about this. Everyone, please check the price carefully before placing your order.

restaurant_name: Mae Khlong Hua Pla Mo Fai
review_text:
This was, without exaggeration, the worst restaurant I have ever been to — and the fact that it has been mentioned in the Michelin Guide for 6 years makes the experience even more shocking. The hype is completely undeserved, and the reality is chaos, dirt, and disappointment.

There is no host stand, no hospitality, and no organization whatsoever. To even get in line, you have to walk through a fruit shop and find a messy whiteboard with a marker. That’s their “queue system.” No proper waiting area, no order, and just one person randomly calling names. They even have a microphone, but for some reason don’t use it — so customers are left in total confusion.

I waited over an hour just to get a table, and then another hour for food. During that time, the place looked like it hadn’t been cleaned in days. The floor under the tables and chairs was completely trashed — food scraps, napkins, and litter everywhere. It was uncomfortable, unhygienic, and honestly disgusting.

The so-called queue kept getting shorter not because tables were moving, but because people simply gave up and left. Looking back, I wish I had too.

When the food finally arrived, it was bland, carelessly prepared, and absolutely not worth the price. Dishes here are five times more expensive than normal, but taste like something from a cheap roadside stall — except without the charm, flavor, or friendliness. It’s nothing but a rip-off disguised under an old Michelin mention.

In short: Mae Klong Hua Pla Mo Fai is chaotic, dirty, disorganized, overpriced, and overrated. The food is not special, the service is nonexistent, and the whole experience is a waste of time and money. If you value your sanity, skip this place — there are hundreds of better, cleaner, cheaper, and tastier restaurants in Thailand.

Located inside the Four Seasons Hotel. First time tasting a legitimate hot and sour soup. A  lot of dishes we ordered were Cantonese classics but slightly elevated in presentation and preparation. Delicious overall with great service - definitely could see why they have a Michelin star. For a party of 4, we spent roughly $300 USD, so relatively good value

Four Season Chinese Restaurant truly serves the best baby pork I have ever eaten in my life! The flavor is absolutely incredible, perfectly crispy on the outside and tender inside. Every time I come here, the service is exceptional friendly, attentive, and consistent. This place never disappoints. Highly recommended!

This is one of the Chinese restaurants I frequently return to, and it never fails to impress. The Peking duck is outstanding, every dish is consistently excellent, and each visit leaves me with memorable dining experiences.

Yu Ting Yuan, located in the Four Seasons Hotel, boasts a truly stunning setting—elegant, refined, and beautifully designed. The ambiance and interior are top-notch, creating a luxurious dining experience.

The service was excellent, as expected. As for the food, it was good overall, though we had higher expectations. The clear standout was the Peking Duck—crispy, flavorful, and perfectly prepared—and the dessert was also a delightful surprise.

The other dishes were decent, but didn’t quite wow us. Still, a lovely place to dine for the atmosphere and standout service. 🥢🦆🍨✨

I recommend this place if you look for fine and authentic Chinese food in Bangkok.
They have Dim Sum for lunch which I recommend. And prices are less expensive than evening time. Also their wine collections are selected prices range from 2,000THB or more.
The service is quite trained and comfortable services. I thank to great staffs, Tee, Singtoh, Bow and Arawan. Definitely visit there again!

This spot is definitely on the pricier side, but you’re paying for more than just the food — the atmosphere, interior design, and views are truly breathtaking. The entrance alone feels like walking into a piece of art, and the city skyline backdrop is worth a visit on its own.

Cocktails were beautiful and well-crafted, both visually and in flavor. The food was good — interesting takes on Mexican dishes with their own unique twist but still kept the fundamentals. But don’t be coming here for authentic Mexican because it’s not. Portions are decent for sharing, though not overly large.

The atmosphere was smooth and relaxed, perfect for a night out where you want to enjoy both conversation and aesthetics. The staff were lovely and attentive without being intrusive.

Overall, a great place if you’re looking for an elevated dining experience with stunning visuals. I’d rate it an 8/10 in my books — worth it for the experience, especially if you appreciate design, presentation, and views as much as the food

Read reviews & saw the views and knew I had to book a table. So glad I did. We had great service from Reindeer, very personable and on top of everything. We had two cold apps, two hot apps, and a main dish - everything was delicious, but the standouts were the crab quesadilla and the beef birria tamal. Absolutely exceptional. If you’re a gin drinker, the Dry Martini GDL is a great choice and it’s got a little kick to it. Will definitely return next time I’m in Bangkok.

The food is great — rich, flavorful, and beautifully presented. But since every dish is quite indulgent, having too many at once can feel a bit heavy. The atmosphere is lovely and the service is excellent, with a superb view of Bangkok from the top of the Mahanakhon building. It’s a little on the pricey side for the portion size, but overall a good dining experience.

Ojo let’s go!

What an inspired choice to celebrate my recent birthday at the much celebrated and Michelin awarded Ojo.

The fun begins with the elevator ride up to the 75th floor, which reminded us of the Empire State experience. Stepping out of the lift the magnificent 360 degree view of Bangkok hits you first, then the stunning interiors of the restaurant. Modern, quirky, refined, and classy are the adjectives that spring to mind.

Then onto the food. The four of us enjoyed the 2 course lunch deal ordering two lamb dishes, ceviche, grilled fish, pork ribs, and a mushroom quesadilla. This was Mexican food, but not as you would expect, the Ojo dishes are modern, clean, beautifully cooked, and presented.

Having enjoyed lamb Barbacoa at the famous South Philly Barbacoa last year, the Mojo version was better in our opinion. Intense flavor and super tender - it was our favorite.

We also loved the attentive service, great music, and relaxed atmosphere - it is a great combination and I’m already looking forward to a return visit.

A magical dinner and an unforgettable proposal at Ojo 💖

— We had the most unforgettable dinner at Ojo Bangkok earlier this July. Not only was the food absolutely delicious and the skyline view from the Mahanakhon building breathtaking, but it also turned into the most special night of our lives — my partner proposed to me here! 💍

The ambiance was stunning, elegant yet romantic, perfect for such a meaningful occasion. What made the night even more memorable was the exceptional service from the staff. Huge thanks to Ash, Meili, and Kim for taking such wonderful care of our table. They were professional, attentive, and truly made us feel celebrated.

If you’re looking for a place for a romantic dinner, a proposal, or a special celebration, I can’t recommend Ojo enough. It was magical from start to finish. ✨

I came here in December 2024 with my partner for the 21-course omakase lunch. We had a very intimate and personal experience as we were the only reservation for that time slot. The food and drink was so delicate and finely tuned. The freshness of the seafood was exquisite. And we really enjoyed the explanations of the Executive Chef who told us about all the different types of fish, and squid, and other ingredients and where they came from in Kyushu. The intricately cut squid and eel were particular highlights that were prepared with precise skill and care. We felt very lucky to have the restaurant to ourselves and we were so grateful for their immense hospitality. Thank you, again.

Stunning. Best sushi I've ever had, with service that's very classy yet friendly and welcoming. I had at least 5 dishes I could reasonably call my favorite, and I have no notes on anything I ate. It honestly blew my mind. My green tea and sparkling water were watched constantly and filled the moment the cups flirted with emptiness,  which is a blessing for this climate. And the green tea is perfect, too.

I highly recommend this to solo diners, as the food pace is pleasantly brisk and watching your chef in action is consistently interesting. My chef was also happy to talk about the food with me in great English and was very charming.

The food was great! So much better than the other place I went during my trip. It was a pity they don't have an alcoholic beverage pairing list. The chef was also very conversant in English.

I would recommend this place if you want to have sushi in Bangkok.

Amazing food, absolutely fantastic and friendly chef plus great service. Everything is delicious, well presented and thoroughly explained in English by the chef.

The experience is worth 5 stars, and the only thing that disappointed is the very misleading advertising by the W hotel and their own Google description. They make it sound like this restaurant has 2 Michelin stars, when it in fact doesn’t have any, it’s the original one in Japan that has two stars.

Overall a great but pricey experience for a non Michelin restaurant, but hopefully they will get their own stars soon!
A hidden & very underrated Sushi place in Bangkok - somewhat so great but not the first choice of most of people. Highly recommend! 🍱🍣

Ok, so you should definitely get yourself along to Keller. A truly tranquil and luxurious experience in Bangkok, a very high level of eating at an extremely reasonable price. We ate at the kitchen bar, a pleasure to have that level of interaction. The chef’s passion is clear. We attended for a birthday celebration and have left feeling entirely pleased with the experience, looking forward to coming back in the future!

We had the privilege of dining at Keller Bangkok in June 2025, and it was nothing short of unforgettable. My wife and I went on a Thursday evening and, to our surprise, we were the only guests that night — yet Mirco and his team opened just for us. That in itself already made it feel like such a special occasion.
The food was absolutely delicious, but what made the evening truly outstanding was the entire experience. Each dish was not only beautifully crafted but also came with a story: where the ingredients came from, what inspired it, and how Mirco’s philosophy as a chef shines through his cuisine. I also loved that there was both a wine pairing and a mocktail pairing option — thoughtful and creative down to the last detail.
What made the night even more personal was the time we spent learning about Mirco himself: his journey, his passion for food, and even his love for his cats waiting at home. That human connection elevated the dinner into something far beyond just a meal.
Thank you, Mirco and team, for making this such a unique and memorable evening. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a fine dining experience in Bangkok that blends culinary excellence with genuine warmth and storytelling.

I believe Keller offers one of the finest dining experiences in Bangkok. Their 9-course dinner will leave you absolutely stupefied!

From the very first dish to the last, Chef Keller’s masterful interpretation satisfies not only your appetite but also your curiosity. I couldn’t help but wonder what thoughts or experiences inspired him to create dishes with such depth, using locally and carefully sourced ingredients—dishes that may appear foreign at first glance but are packed with flavors that evoke a deep sense of nostalgia for the Thai palate.

The service from the staff was phenomenal—warm, attentive, and informative from the moment you walk in to the moment you leave. The pacing and timing were just right. The open kitchen is intriguing; it creates a relaxed atmosphere that’s neither too formal nor too casual. It also gives you the feeling of being part of the process, allowing you to truly appreciate the care and craftsmanship behind each dish.

Highly recommended!

Keller Bangkok orchestrated one of the best meals I’ve had in years. Creative. Fun. Delicious. We enjoyed our front row seat at the counter and appreciated the attentive service from the staff. The man behind the name was actively involved, walking us through each of the dishes (and how to best eat them) with a down-to-earth, accessible-to-all demeanor. This is not a pretentious dining experience. This is for those who love good food, appreciate the process, and want to be an active participant in the evening. My wife and I stayed late to chat with the head chef/owner (apologies if we delayed your departure). His passion for what he does was evident, and his genuine interest in feedback was fantastic. This man is an exemplary chef, but hasn’t lost his desire to learn and improve. We loved every minute of it! Thank you to the entire team for making our night in Bangkok one to remember.

We had a lovely family dinner to celebrate our father’s birthday and Keller did not disappoint! Every single dish was crafted beautifully and full of flavor. We had the tasting journey dinner menu that changes every 8 weeks and I have to say that every bite was truly delightful :) Chef Keller is very very talented and we now have a new top restaurant on our list of venues to visit again

For dinner, we ordered salty egg squid (must order, I’m craving it for days after eating), bitter melon fried with fish (good), red curry duck (normal), sour and spicy soup (nice) and raw shrimp which I think it has been marinated for a while that the meat is not transparent. For dessert, we ordered fried banana with coconut ice cream.
Food was overall amazing and service was good. They helped us to cut open the coconut after drinking so we can scoop out the meat.

I would definitely come back.

Everything was delicious!! My partner said it was the best pad see ew he's ever had. The prawns in the curry were so juicy! It was on the slightly pricier side compared to local restaurants, but worth it! Would come back in a heartbeat. Service was a little slow but the food made up for it.

We were here tonight we started with the duck rolls and Gung Chub Torid we continued with one main dish Kaow shrimp pad and we took the golden dream for dessert. All the dishes were amazing. The restaurant is full worth it. And the staff is very friendly and kind

I am doing my research everywhere I go on where it is best to eat, I must say that it’s not clear from the online material how good this restaurant is. This was the best restaurant we have eaten in Koh Samui out of many we tried (which were recommended as well), I would say it is the best in Samui if I had to guess.

We tried the fried fish which was a show!! So good! Also the rest of the dishes were amazing. We took a spicy raw mango with calamari and grilled prawns with some spicy dressing.

This is a must!

This Michelin 2025 restaurant was really good, i got here 35 min before close and they took care of me  and recommended the duck curry and i was very happy with it. simple and clean and exactly what hits the spot. The pricing was very good considering the quality.

The staff were very sweet and welcoming. the open seating area is open and great incase you like to sit outside.

Very basic restaurant, but the food can't be faulted, as the Michelin star illustrates. For 5 dishes, 2 rice, and a bottle of water was AUD22, so the value is phenomenal. The food is Northern style, so it's nice to sample the difference to its Issan food equivalents. Must do when in CNX.

Larb Kwai (raw & cooked) were both really good, with a nice texture to it hence the glorious shape of the dish. Poo-Ong or the field crab was a must.
Food was fast, service was decent. Must visit.
One of the most delicious Lab Kua in Chiangmai
Great little eatary by the Canal Road. Speciality is laarp, and you get some Northern Thai specialities . Try their waterbuffalo dishes , like sun dried buffalo.

Great authentic northern Thai food at affordable prices, great service and staff - extra bonus is the pool table

Kop Kun khrap khun Mick 🙏

This restaurant deserve its Michellin 2025 award. Duck meat is well braised and have a good mixture of meat n fats, great tender texture. The duck meat's natural strench is well covered by the braise sauce.

The sauce they provided is savory and goes well with rice. Do not be fooled by the layer of light oil on the sauce. It is not oily.

Personally, I enjoy the meat better in its original flavour without the swet n savoury chilli.

The duck blood is very good, smooth and without the strong strench of blood smell. Very good texture!

Will visit it when I return. Imagine 440baht for 2 person with 2 bowl of rice.

Ignore the atmosphere scoring. I have my own standards.

Back in Bangkok (after 1 year!) and headed straight over to explore the hip & happening Song Wat Road on a hot, humid Saturday afternoon
❣️🛺❣️

Saw a long queue (which in the universe of queue = damn good food 🏆) in front of this little eatery in the wall helmed by local Chinese Thai which we thought was selling braised duck 🦆.

Saw a 'Sold Out' sign flipped up at the counter once the front few people in the queue got their seats (which there was not more than 8 tables at this petite eatery).

We sadly left to look for other food in the neighborhood.

Funnily when we walked by after an hour or so, the 'Sold Out' sign was gone & a new queue was in line again! We quickly took a number - 37  (written by hand on yellow paper pad next to their counter) & rejoined the queue (mainly locals Thai) & after 10mins or do, we successfully got a table! 🥳

When we saw finally their menu, we then realised this is a braised Goose eatery stall ...🤣
My absolute fav!!! 💛🪿🪿🪿💛

Ordered their medium serving, 2 rice & a soup for our entourage of 3. While we waited for the chopped goose, complimentary ice cold chinese tea (with big chunky ice cubes) in small glasses were served which was such a welcome thirst quenching drink on a hot summery afternoon 🤩

Our orders came swiftly and boy were we glad we followed our radar to join this queue of locals!

The de-boned braised goose was juicy, tender, flavorfully braised & soooooo delicious 😋😋😋 The limey 🌶️ chilli sauce added an extra punch to the braised goose which we proceeded to ravish in delight.

The simple pork paste 🐷 soup filled to the brim with coriander was also tasty & super comforting (just like home cooked soups) 💛💛💛

As we enjoyed our goose lunch, new customers kept coming but were turned away once their 2nd batch of goose were gone & their 'Sold Out' sign was up again .

So happy we accidentally stumbled by this area to have had such a lovely braised goose lunch (which was totally a random hit) 😋😋😋 in Song Wat.

Highly recommended to all who love goose to head over to Urai Braised Goose while in Song Wat area to try their yummlicious braised goose 👍🤤🪿💛💛

แนะนำเป็นอย่างยิ่ง! ❣️🪿🪿🪿❣️

No.1 of braised goose for me.  This restaurant has established for decades and the taste is still consistent.  The owner is friendly and picked very good parts for us.  My friend liked even the rice.  He said the rice was yum😁 when eating with the braised.  And this round was my first time to try the neck and brain part recommended by my friend who lives close to this restaurant, I would have to say I should have tried it long ago.  Oh wow!  Well deserved for Michelin Bib Gourmand.

Having seen so many food bloggers etc praising the place I had to try it myself. There is indeed high demand and I had to wait roughly 30 min before I got my table. It was worth the wait. Goose meat was tasty and definitely not what you get at every corner. They sell out quickly, don’t come late!

Grab a queue no. and wait for your turn to be called to an available table.
You will only be asked to order when they clear their previous orders, which is based on ur queue no.
You order when your queue no. is up.

Food is delicious and worth a wait. But do go early. They are sold out by 1130 on a weekday.

Have eaten here 2 times and both were very good. They have a large selection and friendly service. It's a popular location so can be busy during peak times. Additionally it's a good value and good quality

This is my favorite Isaan food spot, and every time I visit Pattaya, I make sure to stop by for ส้มตำ, ต้มแซ่บกระดูกหมูอ่อน, and เสือร้องไห้. The flavors are always spot on, and the quality never disappoints. I was thrilled to learn that this place was recognized by Michelin—it’s something my friends and I have often talked about. Definitely a must-visit for anyone who loves authentic Isaan cuisine! Better to come early, so that the cooks are not tired serving many people!

Down home authentic Thai pork neck cooked slowly over natural charcoal fire in a custom made cooker by an expert grill master. The wife knows how to make the som tum taste and texture just right. Menu in Thai with photos. The real Thai taste, as close to the street as one can get. Locals fill the seats during peak hours, so get there early or after the noon rush. Really good food! 😊

The food here was very delicious. We especially liked the grilled pork neck. Had an additional serving of it because it was that good. I also liked the grilled chicken. Tends to be busy during lunch time but worth the wait

I don’t know why they have such bad reviews. My wife and were eating there today. The service was good and the food was more than perfect. My wife is very picky but she said that the food was very delicious.

I went there around 10:30 on Saturday and it was still quite empty. The way to the restaurant is a bit tricky, but the food overall tastes really good. I especially recommend the stir-fried dok khae with shrimp paste ดอกแคผัดกะปิ, the bitter neem salad with mackerel ยำสะเดาปลาทู, and the sour soup with mackerel and madan fruit ต้มปลาทูมะดัน. Just note that the food is quite spicy 🌶️, so I suggest asking for less spicy when ordering.

I really like the atmosphere of the restaurant, especially the seating by the lotus pond. It’s such a nice and relaxing spot to enjoy a meal

Thai home-cooking style restaurant with the view of rice fields and lotus pond.
Stir-fried green curry and mackerel in Madan soup are highly recommended.

• Authentic local Thai food with a Michelin star — and it truly deserves it.

• The overall taste is superb and rich in flavor. Prices are affordable for the quality. Highly recommend the Stir-fried Green Curry with Pork (Kaeng Kiew Wan Moo Pad Haeng) — a spicy and delicious take on a classic dish.

• It’s always crowded, but the service is well-organized and efficient. Please note that the road leading to the restaurant is quite narrow for about 500 meters, so drive carefully.

By far the most authentic flavors we’ve had on our trip! Everything was delicious and perfectly spicy. The mango salad, in particular, stood out—it tasted just like my grandma used to make.

The restaurant has plenty of parking, with attendants to help direct you, which is a nice touch. Upon arrival, you check in with the host and receive a number for your table.

However, we had to dock a star due to the service. Our dishes arrived, but no one at our table had plates. It took flagging down three different waiters before we finally got them. Also, the number of flies was a big downside—they were relentless. You will really be fighting with them throughout your meal. The restaurant needs to put out fly traps to make dining more enjoyable.

On a positive note, definitely get the coconut water! They roast the coconuts, giving the water an incredible, fragrant flavor.

That said, if you're looking for bold, authentic flavors, this spot delivers!

Thai food restaurant with a well-rounded taste. The food is not too spicy and you can eat it all the time. The restaurant has a long queue and limited parking, but it is worth coming to try it. Foods such as mackerel boiled with makrut lime and stir-fried sesbania flowers with shrimp paste are recommended dishes that you should try. Recommended for those who love Thai food.

Highly recommended for ultra authentic local Thai dishes home cooked food.
Must try the omelette, the fried pork, the curry chicken, etc.
Service is great.
The lady boss, has been having the restaurant 33 years ago to date!

A small, cozy restaurant with surprisingly delicious food. It’s a popular local spot, so making a reservation is definitely a good idea  the place fills up quickly, especially during peak hours. Parking can be a bit of a challenge, as there are only a few spots available.
First time here… Authentic Thai dishes in local taste.   A must visit….   Definitely will find time to come back

All the dishes we ordered were really great; truly delicious and authentic!

But you probably need a reservation AND call them beforehand to order your dishes, or else you need two hours to get all your food.

The ambience is also pretty unique as this looks like an old house that is pretty well decorated.

A great Thai restaurant with delicious dishes. My favorite was the Kaeng Som—incredibly spicy, full of flavor, and perfect with rice and deep-fried dishes. The restaurant has a cozy, homey decor, and the service is good, with friendly owners.

However, the food takes a while to be served, so I recommend calling ahead to order.

Parking is limited, but you can also park on the street in front of the restaurant.

As I was invited, I didn’t get a chance to try food I like so I can make better comparison.  Overall is tasty with exception of the cat fish….no problem, just dislike catfish cooked that way.  Atmosphere was ok ish at lunch, better with high tide at dinner.
Amazing food and great atmosphere, workers are very friendly
It's very delicious.

There are so many dishes to choose from on the menu and we were surprised by how quickly everything arrived after we ordered. The grilled fish was the highlight for me, it was cooked just right and had really great flavor. The fresh vegetables and side dishes that came with it were also very tasty and made the meal feel complete.

Everything we tried was full of flavor and we felt that the prices were very reasonable for the amount and quality of food we got.

Since there were only two of us this time, we didn’t order too much. The portions are quite large, so it’s easy to get full quickly. It would be a great place to come with a group so you can share more dishes. We went around lunchtime on a weekend and the restaurant was very busy. It was packed with people, and the tables were placed pretty close together. It felt a bit tight, but the energy was lively and welcoming.

Just a heads-up: this place has a self-service system. You’ll need to grab your own plates, cutlery, cups and ice from the service station.

Overall, it was a great experience. Tasty food, fast service, and fair prices. We’ll definitely be back to try more!✨
Open seating with waitress service.  Good Isaan food.  We loved the duck leg.  The duck larb was good, and the papaya salad was very good.  The salad served with it was fresh.

The uncles and aunts are super kind and also welcoming. We paid only 230 bath for 5 dishes. The grilled chicken and the papaya salad are the signature here - The Must Try. Definitely comeback again for the grilled chicken.

My first meal in isaan, Udon Thani. The gia yang (grilled chicken) was so juicy and full of flavour. The som tam pla ra, spicy and fresh. Highly recommend. Took about ten minutes to get the bill, bit strange, not sure why.

Super spicy and authentic Isan food

First of all, let me suggest those who are unsure of their tolerance and stamina, 'please specify the number of chilies you'd like to have in your Somtam.' Otherwise, you would get your tongue and mouth burnt. Anw, the dishes are very authentic Isan. You may hardly find some dishes elsewhere in Thailand. Perhaps this restaurant could give ypu an unforgettable memory in Udonthani.

The atmosphere is calm and homey — like visiting good friends. The northern dishes are rich, full of character, with a perfect spice balance. Everything’s fresh, neatly served, and without pretense — warm, honest cooking you’ll want to come back for 😌✨

A nice quiet restaurant!!!
On the way, we feel like we’re going to the village. It’s a restaurant attached with an organic farm. You may see variety of vegetables. You can also buy them.
Meals _ delicious enough, healthy, some dishes may be said a bit pricey but worth it for their service & taste.
Helpful & kind staffs
Lots of car parking in the compound

Kinlum Kindee Sansai is a culinary gem in Chiang Mai, celebrated for its authentic Northern Thai cuisine. The standout dish, **Sai Ua**, is a fragrant herbal sausage that bursts with flavor, perfectly complemented by the tangy dipping sauces. Additionally, the **sun-dried buffalo** is a must-try; it's tender and packed with rich taste, showcasing local ingredients at their best. The restaurant's ambiance is warm and inviting, making it ideal for gatherings. With accolades from the Michelin Guide, Kinlum Kindee promises a delightful dining experience that captures the essence of Northern Thailand[

Authentic Northern Thai cuisine set in a Thai house. All dining area is al fresco which is really nice but mosquitos might be a problem at night.  You can also find exotic local dishes like buffalo meat. We stuck to the less exotic ones like vegetable soups, fried chicken,  minced pork (larb kua), fish soup and fried local vegetable (Chiang da) with egg which I highly recommend. We have these dishes with sticky rice.  Overall, this is a place to discover unique local dishes and introduce new flavors to your taste buds!

Out of nowhere in the zigzag maze like tiny local village roads there comes this beautiful and cute restaurant with not just the great garden but also the chillest vibe!

I ordered a platter and a beer which is the best combo to me. Sipping cold beer while gazing the beautiful nature surroundings is priceless to me! Killing time here is heavenly to me. Will definitely come back since I am lucky enough to live nearby!

We celebrated my husband’s birthday at CLARA, and it couldn’t have been more special 😍 the service was warm and attentive, and every course was a delight.

We went for the 8-course menu and loved every bite. The absolute standout for us was the appetizer with sea urchin and stracciatella, and merluzzo with black cod. Honestly though, everything was delicious and beautifully put together!

What made the evening even more memorable was how the staff acknowledged my husband’s birthday, it was very thoughtful.

Thank you to the whole team at CLARA for making the night so wonderful 🙏🏻

Clara Restaurant is one of my absolute favorites! 💖
A very special thanks to the wonderful staff and the talented kitchen team — everything was perfect from start to finish.

The flavors and portion sizes are truly amazing — for me, number one in Bangkok. When you compare the high quality with the prices, the value is excellent and absolutely outstanding. One Michelin star is surely at least their level.

Christian creates delicious art on every plate, while Clara makes everyone feel warmly welcomed, as if you are in their own living room. This balance of creativity and hospitality is what makes the experience so unique.

I never miss this place whenever I’m in the city — it is simply the perfect fit. Out of the top 3, this is without a doubt the one. A must-go restaurant!

🙏 Thank you Clara and Christian, and your wonderful team — you are a true example of how passion, kindness, and professionalism can make a restaurant feel so special. You always give your best, and as guests, we can truly feel it. That’s what makes every visit unforgettable.

It’s not my first time at Clara, and every time is better than the last. Christian creates amazing dishes full of creativity and flavor, while Clara makes the dining room feel warm and welcoming. The wine selection is also excellent and always pairs perfectly with the food. A wonderful experience every time!

One of the best Italian fine dining experiences we've ever enjoyed in the City of Angels. Wonderful culinary delights that are perfectly balanced. Every course is truly delicious. These creations are truly worthy of a Michelin star.
The attentive service, without any frills, and the spacious and tastefully decorated venue rounded everything off perfectly.

A huge thank you to the perfect and gracious host Clara and her team for a memorable evening. A definite recommendation... see you next time.

Our evening at CLARA was truly exceptional. From the moment we stepped into their charming villa in Sathorn, we felt genuinely welcomed.

Chef Christian's Italian cuisine has the perfect balance - elegant and comforting.
Each dish was coming with Clara’s explainations (Chef’s wife) and they’re all very authentic and enjoyable.

The attention to detail was impressive, with just 3-4 elements on each plate placed and cook to perfection.

Clara's hospitality made the experience personal. Her knowledge of each dish and warm presence add something that felt both special and wonderfully familiar. The sommelier's suggestions were also good.

The intimate setting, with its garden space and the open kitchen created the perfect atmosphere for our night. CLARA isn't just another fine dining restaurant - it's a place where you feel at home with nice and talented friends taking care of you.

No need to wait for a special occasion to go and try, or to go back 🥰🙏🏻

It was quite crowded for a regular day, with large table reservations and a packed atmosphere. The food was fresh, clean, and definitely above average in quality.

The staff seemed a bit short-handed due to the crowd, and when we asked about the menu from Google, they mentioned it was outdated — perhaps a bit impatiently. However, the overall service and food delivery were great.

The restaurant has a nice atmosphere with an impressive wine cellar. We enjoyed our dinner overall — and I especially loved the chili flakes they serve!

My visit last night was an absolute pleasure from start to finish. Upon entering the restaurant, my wife and I were greeted with genuine warmth. The entire staff, including the chefs working busily in the open kitchen, were remarkably friendly and created a very welcoming atmosphere.

We had the opportunity to try several of the restaurant's signature dishes. While some of these dishes are commonly found on other restaurant menus, the execution and presentation here were truly outstanding. Each plate was a testament to the skill of the kitchen team.

A special mention must go to our server, Golf. His recommendations during the ordering process were excellent and perfectly tailored to our preferences. His attentive and thoughtful service throughout the meal significantly enhanced our experience. Thanks to his arrangements and care, we enjoyed a thoroughly delightful and memorable dinner.

Very elegant Italian restaurant in Chiang Mai with a good atmosphere, outstanding service and delicious food. There is a wide array of foods to choose from in the menu. What inspired me to write this review is the exceptional service of a very nice waiter named Golf. He is very attentive and talkative. On the first day we ordered bread multiple times and on the second day that we came back, we didn‘t even have to ask for it, it was brought to us at once! I would definitely recommend you to go there if you like Italian Food, an elegant style and the best service in the whole city

Favola Chiang Mai was unforgettable! The food was packed with flavor and beautifully presented, and the service was next levelGolf took amazing care of us the entire night. This isn’t just dinner, it’s an experience worth traveling for. Highly recommend!

We had an incredible dining experience here! The truffle pasta was rich and flavorful, the pizza was perfectly baked with delicious toppings, and the risotto was creamy and full of taste — everything was cooked to perfection.
A special thank you to Jasmin, our waitress, who was absolutely wonderful — so friendly and helpful in recommending the perfect wine to match our dishes. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic Italian food and great service in Chiang Mai!

My first Michelin star modern Indian cuisines at Bangkok .  An honor that I gladly accepted to be seated at the chef table for the night . Chef Sachin was at the table personally explaining the journey of his 9 course dinner . For me there are quite a few highlight for me one have to be his version of chawamushi which to date might be one of the best  although I don’t like the smokiness of the caviar . But his additional sauces on that dish makes the difference . The other dish that I love have to his carabinero , the vinegar that came with it was outstanding. Finally , the main course lamb done in 3 ways was also good . I strongly recommend to upgrade the main to the lamb . The lamb was perfectly cooked and the flavor are full of surprises.
I will definitely return for his next menu .

Fantastic 10 course meal..one of the best meals I ever had.. service was absolutely amazing.. attention to detail was impeccable..Worth every penny and more!!

Moreover it’s like a once in a lifetime experience!

Kudos to Head Chef Sachin for the lovely meal and sincere thanks to Ravi who was managing our table!

Great experience. I got the 10 course menu and every dish was so well balanced, nothing was too overpowering or unpleasant. The journey was carefully thought through to give you both an immersive lesson of Indian history and cultural contact involving all of your senses. The staff makes you feel very welcomed and they guide you on your taste travel. Couldn’t recommend it enough

There are a lot of surprising things during the meal so it’s not your ordinary tasting menu. They connect India to each dish and there is the essence of the dish they are imitating but in a completely different way.
A great Michelin starred restaurant serving really good Indian dishes. The tasting menu is more than just food which also takes you to tour around the world.
One of halal food restaurant in Khaosan area. We came early morning, and try its beef noodle soup and satay. Good portion and tasty.
Traditional halal restaurant with Indonesian dishes. Chicken biryani is delicious. Thai rice cooked in biryani recipe is great.

Incredibly fast service, food took about a minute to come out. Definitely not made to order but it’s busy enough that everything tasted fresh. Small and simple menu. Ordered a few dishes and the chicken biryani was the star. $60 baht and flavorful and filling. Chicken fell off the bone. Dumplings could be skipped.

Went here nearly everyday during my stay in Banglamphu, Bangkok.

My savior during the day with great halal foods and drinks. The staffs not quite fluent in English, but they can guide you with simple sentence and very helpful.

Now I see why this restaurant get Michelin Star in 2025, because all of the foods are recommended!

Beef biryani, and ice coffee, great combo for lunch!

Will be missing this place so much when I get back to my country!

What an amazing find. This halal restaurant has recently been listed in the Michelin guide. My beef biryani was excellent. Fork pull apart tender beef, spiced rice and a savory spearmint gravy which was phenomenal. This is going to be a regular restaurant going forward. It's hidden behind a clothes stall so may be difficult to find.

A traditional northeasthern decorative style restaurant which mainly serve Thai rice noodle (ขนมจีน )with 4 types of curry soup for your choice.
For me, the best one is fish curry soup with coconut milk.
Parking are availe both in front of its restaurant and parking area opposit side of restaurant.
Great restaurant 👌 with great food. Many antiques inside and outside make it a great visit. Will definitely be back.

Was somehow of disappointment as when I went there many recommended dishes were out of order. Also the menus we ordered took quite long to wait, if get a chance to go again will have one more time to try and hope it will be nice.

service is bad . its really hard to order or get more food
food is fair
price is decent
the fried chicken was not as crispy
what I dislike most is the payment
they would have to recheck every
at the table and then give you a paper to pay at the counter it is just a hassle

I ordered Padthai. Its Padthai was so delicious. It tastes different as common sense. Not bad at all as small-sized dish. Kanom chin was also good. The sauce made up me so hungry. The service was nice. The price reach 745 THB for 7 people ordered 2 padthai, 2 big dishes kanom chin, and medium pepsi

This is fine dining in Bangkok done properly. If theres 2 words that I would use to describe the food here, spectacular & balanced. The concept, the presentation and more importantly the taste. WOW! The team they have here is really amazing. Thai cuisine can be a tricky one, especially with its leaning towards the spicy, sour notes in certain cases. Ive been to 2 other dining places that were total disappointments. Only this place I felt that I would return in a heartbeat. The chefs here do an amazing job and I would wholeheartedly recommend this spot to any of your foodies out there. The Thai Fine-dining cuisine has had its detractors or skeptics but this place made me a believer. A believer in the future of the Thai fine dining landscape. From start to finish, every dish was executed wonderfully,  elevated to a level that reminded me why I crave for fine dining experiences. Going to subpar places showed me how difficult it was to be impressed again after eating for so long, but this place was truly truly wonderful. Thank you chefs!

Booked a birthday dinner, and it turned out to be a wonderful experience. The food was beautifully designed and expertly prepared, showcasing a superb level of detail and skill. The concept was very solid, featuring avant-garde techniques combined with authentic tastes and elements. I was extremely impressed with the service and the attentiveness of the staff.

I highly recommend this place and hope they continue their excellent work. Thank you for the amazing meal!

Nawa is aiming at  delivering an authentic Thai taste  « with a twist » based on the mastery of their cullinary technique
The goal is , for me, truely achieved and the Nawa team can be proud of their Cuisine !
Every single dish, so genuinely Thai in the ingredient , taste and original recipe…..became, with the Nawa revisit , something unique and memorable!
First, surprisingly beautiful and sophisticated presentations
Then, the palate is embarked in an amazing experience of unexpected textures and taste mixes
Still, the Journey  proposed by each dish finished in familiar Thai taste and after-taste ! Taking you away….but never too far from home !
Special mentions to the « mahor » and the blue crab (2 of the « amuse-bouche ») , the River Prawn one of the main dishes), the signature Tom yam goong (even if I was visually convinced by the addition of caviar, its milder taste was, for me, largely lost in the tom yam spices)….
and the Khao niao mamuang……Nawa managed to take the iconic and world famous Thai desert to another dimension (small bite was neeeded after such a diner…….but I would have eaten one or 2 more !!!
The service is very attentive and you can feel the pride and commitment of each of the different members of the team  in explaining the dishes
So yes Nawa will certainly achieve its goal in the incrinsingly competitive Thailand food scene
Will come again for sure

Tribute to my Gen Z friend who recommended this restaurant.

Every single dish was slay, no cap. Hard 🔥

Mind blowing. Best Thai fine dining meal I have experienced thus far.  Emotional and hedonistic, there is so much joy and soul in the food that was served. I would love to go back again and again.

A rendition of modern Thai cuisines by Chef Joe and his team . All I can say this will change the perspective of Thai cuisines. The outstanding for me is how the team are able to balance the whole taste with all the type of spices they used . I’m also like what the restaurant mind behind reusing every part of the ingredient , the anatomy of the river prawn and the red curry chicken are very good example . Even they have other ingredients that are not so Thai like uni and caviar which were beautiful executed with the flavor of Thai cuisines . I will be back for sure for their next menu .

Price of a round-trip flight from the US to Thailand?

$1500.

Price of the best Pad Thai in the world?

$1500 + 60 baht

100% worth it.

This is the best Pad Thai I've ever had. There is literally nothing I enjoy eating more than this Pad Thai.

If you are anywhere near Nai Mueang Khon Kaen, do yourself a favor and order some Sriruen Pad Thai.

Their Hoy Tod is also fantastic.

I just can't...😍

I found this joint when I was looking for a Michelin Guide restaurant named "Sriruen Pad Thai (Ruenchit Road)." When I walked to that location, there were no places under the name. So, I asked locals, and it turned out the diner has changed address and moved a few hundred meters away from the original location. I walked to the new address, and there I am!
This is where I tried Pad Thai and honestly loved it. The combination of diverse known and new tastes ends in a smooth closure in my mouth. The place is far from fancy, which is my type, too.
The two hunams working here were also very kind and considerate.
Best of luck with this business :)
i wouldnt  give it a 3 star for the food not a 4. Pad thai a little spicy too much chilli, noodle was fine. is it a Michelin star , maybe  no
Yummy
The best Pad Thai ever!

Amazing lunch in Ayudhya!, beautiful decorated dining room with beautiful river view but most of all the food is superb,at the first bite of fried tofu puff in dimsum list ,love it! All dishes are served with great care , ending with dessert sago cantaloupe shake ,wonderful! Deserving for Michelin!
Michelin dim sum Place in Ayutthaya services nice dim sum although the service can be further improved. Taste is acceptable and nice but nothing similiar to hong kong dim sum.
Excellent restaurant!  I used twice in two consecutive days.  I will definitely come back to the restaurant if I come back to Ayutthaya.

Try their DIM SUM. One of the best in thailand.

Crispy duck and gravy noodle are michelin star level

Price is absolute worth it (for this level of restaurant) . Happy to pay every bath
Wry nice Chinese restaurant in Ayutthaya. Serve very authentic Chinese dim sum and taste awesome .

The signature dish is “Stir-Fried Noodle Thai Korat style (Pad Mee Korat)”. It must to try it when you visit at Korat. I also ordered “Omelt Kra-tok and Tomyum Kra-tok”. All dishes are recommended from them. All food is so tasty 😋
Love their food. Everything I've ordered has been great, especially their fried fish and kra prow.
Pretty decent restaurant. Various menu choice and style of cuisine. Plenty of parking and tables.
A MUST-GO E-SAN Thai Restaurant in Nakhon Ratchasima that you have to visit, reasonable price, a lot of parking spaces, good service, and definitely delicious foods.
one of a legend restaurant in Korat. All local and staple dishes are available. Don't compromise with spiciness, go with original taste is a must.

This was by far some of the best Thai food we’ve ever had! The crab salad, garlic shrimp, and steak were all absolutely delicious. The staff and chef were so professional and accommodating. We’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking to be impressed!

Guided by an old pal, I stumbled upon this hidden culinary gem in #ChiangMai, and let me tell you, it ranks among the finest meals I've enjoyed here! Welcome to Food for You by Chef Tutu, a charmingly rustic chef's table concept. Nestled amid a vegetable farm, it's a spot you can't serendipitously stumble upon – meticulous planning is a must. There's no menu; to dine here, you must reserve ahead and discuss your dietary preferences. The fare is nothing short of spectacular, teeming with fresh ingredients. I adored every bite, particularly their succulent beef steak and generously sized garlic prawns. The owner shared that a whopping 90% of patrons are regulars, so to savor their culinary wizardry, advanced communication is key! 🍽️🥩🍤

The restaurant is uniquely located in the middle of a peaceful forest. The food here is just something you should try at least once in your lifetime to indulge your taste. The dish with fragrance, texture, mix taste of ingredients, presentation and the surrounding atmosphere. A meal I enjoy better than many Michelin recommendations.

Heard the reputation of this restaurant from my friend, so I can't miss it.

The environment is nice, service is fine.

For the food, nothing bad but nothing spectacular. I can have these same menus from other restaurants. Probably, I expect more from reputation of this restaurant. It is mixed between Chinese and Thai.

For the price, it is higher than avg. be prepared.

Need to reserve table in advance!

Set dinner with dishes chosen by the chef. Owners are super friendly. Ambience is cozy with lots of greens and "fireflies". Here, you'll find fresh ingredients like huge red tiger prawns seasoned to the Thai palette; a bit on the sweet side especially the grilled beef. Pleasant experience overall!

Roti Pa Day

In front of Wat Mahawan, Thapae Road Soi 4, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50300, Thailand

It’s unusual to see a Michelin rated street food that sells roti, and mango sticky rice. To be rated, your roti and sticky rice must have something that’s others don’t have—be it technique or ingredient.

Anyway, this roti cart made it to the list and it doesn’t disappoint. Theirs is not the same as other rotis being offered in the streets of Bangkok and Chiang Mai.

First-timers should order the plain crispy roti with condensed milk to start. The roti dough here is uniquely made without eggs, but slowly cooked to a crispy-chewy perfection in coconut oil. Choose from 20 toppings.

They are open everyday from 5PM to 12MN in front of Wat Mahawan Temple. 😘

It’s a best way to start your dinner—start with a good dessert ala Pa Dae!

PS. I can still hear the European Lady telling her friends while passing by the cart: “Is that a Michelin?” 😆

I queued at around 5:30PM and got my order around 6PM. Haba ng pila.

#BirthdayCountdown #OctoberToRemember #LostInChiangMai #solotravel

Famous Michelin guide roti street stalls. Roti was nice and crispy and not swimming in oil like many others . Because of its reputation there is a permanent queue. I've tried a few occasions to try on my frequent visits but just didn't want to wait. Gave in today and waited 45mins !!!!. At least I can now say I've tried it.

Interesting operation model - need to take the piece of paper (rmb the number), write your order and pin it for collection. Wait for a while and your number will be called and that is when you pay.

The roti is crispy and good! Didn’t wait for too long, hence, I thought is worth a visit!

Passed by this place few times and always some people line up. Tried and yes, the roti was crispy and delicious. The grandma always smile but the aunty next to her never smile.

Remember to write down your order and observe for your turn / order number written on the paper.

I love the roti here. The grandmas make it so perfectly. It's soft with a nice crisp. But this is definitely best eaten fresh!

Special thanks to that kind person enlightening me on the self-service system. Extra stars for you 😘 (there is a small note pad for you to write out your order. You need to then hand it to the staff!)

This video captures the essence, which can easily be missed, but this was so much better in person 😉

honestly I was left a little disappointed with the overall experience.. there are few that left me wondering:
- the plates and bowls are not well cleaned
- dishes came partially and remaining only came when some of us finished eating. given the place was still empty at 11.30am it was a little questionable.

- difficult to ask some questions to waiter due to language barrier (was expecting at least we can converse in English considering Michelin)
- food was good

Did not stay in the hotel, just had some dinner on the way back to Bangkok. Food was great with some astonished Thai menu, we ordered Kang-Khao-Nuea (แกงขาวเนื้อ) and it was difficult to describe feeling while ate it: mixed good-new-strange flavor. River prawn was amazing: good creamy prawn head fat, spicy and sour soup. Just 1 thing that has to improve is service, we understand that restaurant is quite big but waiters should be available at every part of the areas the customers took seat (in my area, beside river, they did not stand by all the time even though there are many employees).

The Wine Ayudhya is a unique dining destination known for its stunning architectural design and relaxing riverside atmosphere 🍷🏞️. The structure features a modern, open design with glass and wood elements, creating a picturesque setting perfect for photos 📸 and enjoying nature.

The restaurant offers a good selection of wines 🍇 and a menu filled with both Thai and international dishes 🍽️. The food is well-prepared and presented, with standout items including grilled meats 🥩, seafood dishes 🦐, and creative appetizers. The wine list complements the food well, enhancing the dining experience.

The atmosphere is relaxed and ideal for romantic dinners ❤️, family gatherings 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦, or even casual meet-ups with friends. The staff is attentive and friendly 😊, providing good service without being intrusive.

However, prices are on the higher side 💸, which is expected given the premium location and ambiance. It’s a great choice for special occasions or when you want to treat yourself to a pleasant evening by the river.

The outdoor seats were too hot for us on the day we visit and air con seats were all booked so it was an unfortunate. Having the fan blew at you at top speed is not so comfortable.  The food tastes great. However, with tax and service charge added some dished were too expensive for the portion we got.

Nice food and relaxing place. The ambiance was perfect, with soft music playing in the background and warm lighting casting a gentle glow. Each dish was a delightful fusion of flavors, expertly crafted to please the palate. As I savored every bite, I felt the stresses of the day melt away, leaving only a sense of tranquility. It was the ideal setting to unwind and enjoy the simple pleasures of life.

Coming back again and everything was so delicious as usual. The deep fried fish was so big up to 0.8 kg. I haven’t seen the fish this big before and it is not easy to find in other restaurants. If you come here, better try it.

Sensational restaurant selling Thai Chinese style food. Open kitchen and a very talented and renowned chef who i suspect may be the owner . Generous potions so you can share. Prices are reasonable given the quality. Snapper Penang curry was amazing as was crispy por kaprow I have eaten all over Thailand and this is one of the best places i have eaten. The multiple Michelin awards  from 2022 to 2025 are testament to that. A must visit in the ancient city of Ayutthaya

One of the best crispy pork ever. The crunchiness of the head bits with the good proportion of the meat bits, together, are perfect. Pork knuckle is also cooked to the perfection. It’s tenderness with savory taste make you crave for steamed rice. Seafood also well prepared and cooked.

i thought it was regular shrimp, but turned out to be tiger prawns(fresh ones). Its chewy texture supported by stir-fry basil & red green chili gives explosive flavors. the open kitchen concept expresses confidence of chef's remarkable  cuisinart. well-thought menu items but just need to improve the quality of photos so customer does not mistakenly order 2 dish with rice.

Was here 4 years ago!

We came to eat again, food is still good, the ingredients use are very fresh. We ordered the 1 plate dish - it’s cheap and good.

We came on a public holiday - waited for more than an hour for our orders.

The restaurant here is definitely worth checking out! The quality of the food is excellent, and the prices are very reasonable, making it a great value for your money. I highly recommend trying the Pad Kra Pao; it’s a delightful dish. They add Thai chili jam to enhance the flavor, and it’s absolutely amazing and delicious. You won’t want to miss out on this culinary experience!

Absolutely loved this gem of a place that we found on the Michelin app as it’s received a Bib Gourmand - we can see why. Every dish was absolutely delicious and the service was very quick. It’s an unassuming looking place that we may have walked past had we not seen it recommended on the app - would definitely recommend! I absolutely adored the shrimp fried rice, stir fried duck, and wood ear mushroom with egg in particular.
Favourite place in BKK for late supper. So many types of food to choose from. Everything is delicious and comforting.

The restaurant was super crowded during visit. It took us a big awhile to get a table.

Waiters were active but it took sometime for food to be served (which is understandable due to busy dinners hours).

The food was tasty but it used to be tastier. I still recommend the place if you will be around there.

Lovely and classic Chinese-Thai porridge with side dishes. Menu is varied, and all of them are cooked very well on wok. Perfect for the night time!

Recommended: stired-fried crispy pork belly with chilli and salt, 5-spice stewed duck meat, and stir-fried jelly mushroom with egg.

The food is delicious and the service is excellent. The staff are polite and friendly, and the dishes come out very quickly. The restaurant has both an air-conditioned indoor area and an outdoor seating zone. Their Thai-style boat noodles are flavorful and authentic — rich, savory, and perfectly seasoned. It’s definitely a place worth coming back to!

There’s three menus they give you, double sided. It can a bit confusing at first. I ordered the large braised beef noodle soup, braised beef dried noodle, chicken wings and lime soda. If I can do it again, I would just ordered two noodle soup and lime soda. The chicken wings were ok. The dried noodle is good but the soup version outshines the dried version.
Good food overall. There’s indoor and outdoor seating. Best to go during off hours because the food actually takes a while to come out.
Nice place. Super affordable local Thai food. Friendly attentive service. Indoor w air-conditioning and covered outdoor seating available. Easy to scan QR at the table for ordering from your phone.

The boat noodles here are in the Michelin Guide. Personally I prefer the wagyu beef noodle soup. The wagyu is tender and the tendon is soft. The meatballs could be a little tastier, though. The soup is nice and spicy. You can choose your level (normal, less, very spicy, or no chili). I had it with egg noodles. Ordering is simple with the QR/mobile system. Boat noodles come out fast, but if you order stir-fried basil with beef and rice, it takes a bit longer. The time I visited, the crowd is mainly foreigners.

We decided to patronise this shop today cos I wanted to try another newly minted Michelin Guide 2025 establishment which serves Thai boat noodles.

It is not very far from our home. Anyway, there is only 2 carpark lots in front of the shop. If it is full, you’ll need to park elsewhere either on the Sai 3 main road or the soi next to this shop.

Today, we ordered the braised beef with sen lek noodles (75 baht) and a Schweppes Manao soda (20 baht). The soup base is just a tad spicy which was just nice for me to give it taste and a little bit of kick to it. I loved it very much and I believe this shop lived up to its hype.

This is one of the better places to have your Thai boat noodles whether it is with pork or beef; both options are equally delicious.

Ore in Bangkok is one of those rare places where dining becomes something far beyond eating — it turns into an emotion. Chef Dimi and his outstanding team have created an experience that’s intimate, thoughtful, and masterfully orchestrated. With just six seats and two seatings each night, it feels more like being invited into a private culinary performance than a restaurant.

Over the course of 34 dishes, every plate was a small masterpiece — balanced, original, and beautifully presented. Each cook personally introduced their creation, explaining the story and ingredients with quiet confidence and genuine passion. The service was flawless from start to finish: attentive, elegant, and perfectly timed, with an ease that only true professionals can deliver.

At the end of the evening, we moved into a second room for dessert — a striking contrast to the bright, light-filled dining space where the journey began. Suddenly, we were surrounded by darkness, soft light, and a sense of mystery — the ideal setting for the sweet finale. That thoughtful change of atmosphere added another layer of depth to an already exceptional night.

It was one of those rare dinners where happiness just took over — I found myself smiling the entire time, almost without realizing it. That doesn’t happen often, even at top three-star Michelin restaurants. Ore managed to reach something deeper — it touched the soul.

If perfection could be measured, this would easily be a 9 out of 10 — only because 10 should remain unattainable. Everything else was flawless. My gratitude goes to Dimi and his entire team for an evening that I will never forget. For anyone who truly loves food, emotion, and craft — Ore is simply a must when in Bangkok.

One of the most unforgettable and underrated dinner I ever had. One of the few restaurants that I swore that I will return to.

Dining at Ore is less a meal than a masterfully choreographed performance, where every detail—from the quiet elegance of the room to the precision of each course—seamlessly weaves into an unforgettable experience.

The chef demonstrates a rare talent for balance: flavors that are bold and interesting.  All flavours come together like match made in heaven. Every dishes was made with a purpose and left us nodding our head with pleasure after every bite.

Can’t wait to return for another amazing night!

Dining at Ōre Bangkok was truly an unforgettable experience. After a last-minute change of plans, we found ourselves here and I’m so glad we did! From the moment we entered the waiting area to being guided into the intimate 6-seat dining space, everything felt thoughtfully curated and special.

We enjoyed the creativity of the 32-course tasting menu and their attention to detail. The experience lived up to the buzz. You could feel the passion and artistry in every course.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a dining experience that’s both exciting and memorable.

Best restaurant experience we've ever had. Super glad we discovered this pearl. Innovative cooking, re-inventing Thai cuisine without labels. The chef (previously e.g. Borago, Pure C, Alchemist) uses his experience to create his dream theater after doing research for almost a year. He created an amazing international team around him, all dressed in Japanese designer clothes, with immaculate sense of detail and care. The 6 seat chef's counter is beautiful and most of the 'silverwear' and plates are hand made and custom crafted for him by different craftsmen and artists (something that is still ongoing as they did not have the budget yet to do so when they opened). Each of the 30+ dishes is super creative and looks like a piece of art. Dominik Jurasz went to great lengths as well to create an amazing alcoholic pairing which includes all types of Thai alcohol bases which are then mixed into incredible home made cocktail like drinks. Everything was perfect, and every detail was planned. Ore will definitely become something big. Go before more people get to know about it!

A masterclass in restraint, precision, and sensory design.

Ōre is one of those rare dining experiences that quietly rearranges your idea of what food can be. Each course unfolds with remarkable intention… textures, flavours, and temperatures in perfect dialogue… never competing, always building.

Chef Dimitrios and his experienced team create an atmosphere that is calm yet deeply engaging. Their warmth and conversation balance the room’s meditative stillness, making the evening feel personal rather than performative.

Every element here is crafted, not chosen. The chef himself designed the space - a minimalist, tactile environment where nothing distracts from the food. Each plate is bespoke and locally made; even the spoons are individually designed to complement the experience.

Ōre is less a meal than an immersion in artistry, precision, and thoughtfulness. If you care about the details (the quiet kind that reveal themselves slowly) this is a must-visit.

This was a recommendation in the Michelin App and they show their sign at the entrance. So the expectations were high. I can say directly you won’t get disappointed. I ordered the crispy beef, the spicy mango salad, the duck con-fee and the durian sticky rice. Every dish was really full of flavor. Only small critic, the pastry dow at the durian sticky rice were a bit to thick (heavy). But that is definitely a repeat, so many on the menu I need to try 😋

Went to Grok 1970 and really enjoyed the experience

The Southern Thai dishes are full of flavor and beautifully cooked. Every plate shows the chef’s attention to detail and creativity. From savory to sweet, everything tasted amazing

The vibe is dim and cozy, perfect for a relaxed dinner. Service is good and the staff are friendly and attentive

Definitely worth checking out if you’re into Thai food with a fresh twist

Not feeling too hungry so we came to have alacarte. We regreted not have come here with an empty stomach though :)

What I liked the most about here is their ridiculously welcoming and friendly staff, from the moment you step onto their door until stepping out, like grandma who really wanted to make sure you eat well and healthy.
