The food is pretty good as well, the presentations were modest but they taste exactly as imagined, a well balanced blend of Thai traditions and international cuisines. They can customize the spiciness for you that is a plus.

We finished the dinner with a big smile on th face and thank you Grok 1970 for your hospitality.

A fine Thai fusion restaurant certainly
with many interesting and creative dishes. Particularly like the crispy pork, green curry, crab, just ti name a few. Very customers-centric staff who are attentive.

Food: Seriously one of the best Thai meals I've EVER had. The flavors are just so unique, the smell is incredible, and the sauces are so rich. Even though the dishes look all fancy, the taste isn't complicated at all. It feels like anyone could dig it, locals and foreigners alike, 'cause it's not crazy spicy – more like a modern Thai vibe. Every single dish we ordered was a winner, my friends and I were all raving about it.

Service: BUT the service? Ugh, a total letdown. The staff clearly need more training. I booked for 10 people and paid a 1000 baht deposit that they said would come off the bill. Guess what? They forgot! The next day I remembered and tried to get it sorted through LINE, which was a pain. They had to go through finance to transfer it back, super inconvenient. And their admin on LINE? Not great at all. They never told me when they'd actually send the money – I just had to keep checking my bank account myself. So annoying.

This 1 Michelin-starred restaurant delivers bold and authentic Thai flavors. The open kitchen added a lively sensory element — we could watch the chefs at work and smell the dishes being prepared, which made the experience even more engaging.

The tasting menu offered a strong representation of traditional Thai cuisine. The flavors were intense and spicy, true to their roots, but still well-balanced and enjoyable. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared.

We especially appreciated the Thai-inspired desserts, with the Thai pretzels standing out as a delightful finish to the meal. Service was friendly, attentive, and professional throughout, enhancing the overall experience.

Went to Aksorn yesterday to celebrate Mother’s Day with my family. I was a bit worried at first, as my mom is an amazing culinary woman in our family, and there weren’t many reviews from a Thai perspective. But the dishes turned out to be amazing. We really enjoyed the complex and strong Thai traditional flavors we had never experienced before. My mom was delighted and impressed by the flavors—understandable yet prepared with such a sophisticated method. Highly recommended!

This one-Michelin-star restaurant specializes in authentic, locally inspired Thai cuisine. The dishes are characterized by bold flavors and intensity. The open kitchen layout allowed us to observe and smell the food being prepared, adding to the overall experience.

We were served a tasting menu featuring several courses. The three appetizers were notably interesting; while the shell dish was somewhat chewy, the accompanying sauce was nicely made. The other two appetizers were particularly delicious.

The main course consisted of six shared dishes, presented in a traditional Thai style. The rice was expertly cooked with an enticing aroma, and all the dishes were flavorful. One dish was notably spicy but still tasty.

For dessert, we enjoyed Thai-style treats, especially the Thai pretzels, which we found delightful.

The service was great. All staff were friendly and helpful.

Local friends were able to secure a reservation for 10....a prixe fix set meal, the service was excellent, with the staff going out of their way to accommodate a vegetarian and another guest with certain allergies.  The ingredients are all sourced locally, and prepared fresh in front of everyone in the open kitchen.  The atmosphere is dark, sexy with an open air patio for an al fresco dining option as will.... The entire experience was outstanding. There were a couple of dishes that missed the mark....a small dish that featured a snail meat confit with parsley; the meat took a bit of an effort to chew.... Otherwise, an overall great Michelin experience.... And the prices were very reasonable!

the service and the ambience is very good. The appetizers were very delicious. Main course was a bit overwhelmed for us; we felt too much onion as it is almost in all dishes and some were too salty for our taste. Overall good experience with friends. Good for bonding time

Pork Brain Soup (Kaolao Samong Moo) – Phraeng Nara Neighborhood (near the Tiger God Shrine)

If you’re someone who enjoys trying rare or unique dishes, this hidden gem is a must-visit. This old-school spot is tucked inside a vintage wooden building in the heart of the city, full of classic charm that feels like stepping back in time. Despite the nostalgic setting, the kitchen — located right at the front — is clean and well-organized.

Signature Dish:
•	Pork Brain Soup – The broth is rich, savory, and perfectly balanced. It comes with various types of meatballs — some firm, some bouncy — and generous chunks of pork brain. Surprisingly, the brain is very clean, tender, and not gamey at all.
•	Steamed Rice – Light, fluffy, and dry-grained — a perfect match with the soup.
•	Liver Sausage (Gun Chiang Tub) – Displayed in a glass case out front. It’s a must-try! Firm, flavorful, with a slight liver aroma. Tastes amazing with a drizzle of sweet soy sauce.

Atmosphere:
Medium-sized restaurant with several tables. The open kitchen is right at the entrance, letting you see everything being freshly prepared. Customers come and go throughout the day, but it never feels overcrowded.

Owner:
The sweet grandma who runs the place is incredibly kind and polite — it feels like visiting a relative’s home for a comforting meal.

Overall:
Perfect for adventurous eaters looking for something different but genuinely delicious. Clean, affordable, and full of charm. A taste of old Bangkok that’s hard to find these days.

Rating:
5/5 – For rare ingredients, great flavor, and warm, homey

Have you ever eaten Pork Brain?  If not, must try. It is my first experience trying it today and yes I find it a bit strange with the texture.  But indeed I love this restaurant. So rich in history and the deep root in great attention on details especially the presentation and selecting the best ingredients with such an affordable price.

MUST try all the small side dishes. Super tasty and yet the price is truly reasonable.  If you are in the area don’t miss it.

She has been making her special Thai Tham pork brain for more than 60 years

Quite surprising they use a clear soups, unlike most stall selling pig offal will uses strong pepper or vege pickled soup-bases to hide offal odours tastes.  They pig brain dish is not easy available and the offal have to clean very carefully, even so there is still traces of the origin offal taste in it (maybe not like by most people). They have to be respect to keep the their traditional and authentic to prepare it, which is really difficult to find at my hometown and southeast asia chinese Community. Lastly the lady is still in the stall to greet the customer😁

I loved the pork brain and offal soup. Really tasty flavors and more unique than just regular pork meat. The broth was peppery and delicious and not too oily. I also enjoyed the pork liver sausage. The radish and fried fish skin weren't as great. The fried fish skin was better when dipped in soup, but probably would've preferred two bowls of pork brain instead of fried fish skins and radishes if still hungry.

This is a famous pork brain gao lao shop, and it lives up to its name. Gao Lao is like noodles soup but without noodles. You can enjoy it as it is or accompany it with a small cup of rice. As I don’t have a big appetite, a gao lao alone suffices.

The owner lady is very old now but still very active, kind, and works hard for her restaurant. The way she speaks is so elegant, her intonation and vocabulary register, what an epitome of an admirable Thai speaker!

Simply delicious, clean and true to the taste Thai food that is  non pretentious and well executed Thai food.

Food here is delicate in taste while not lacking an essence of Thai taste using high quality raw materials.

Service is polite and smooth. Decorations is tasteful and hygiene is tip top. Been coming here many times over years and food has been very consistent.

One of my family’s favorite Thai restaurants. It sits in the small alley of North Bangkok serving high quality seafood Thai dishes. Even visiting on weekday,  there are many customers enjoying their meals when we arrived. They’re super packed on weekend.

This time we ordered fried Sea bass with spicy mango salad, red curry soup with prawn and fried omelet, spicy stir fried Chayote to have it with jasmine rice. Fried Sea bass was crispy on the outside from the crumb but fluffy yet chewy in the inside. Went so well with the spicy mango salad. The red curry soup was strong and dense but had a balanced taste of spicy and sour. Lastly, the stir fried Chayote was a bit too spicy for us but it tasted really good.

We finished the meal with our favorite Durian sticky rice ice cream and coconut milk with filling ice cream.

The restaurant serves very authentic Thai cuisine, with every dish being exceptionally delicious—hard to compare with others. The atmosphere feels like dining in an elegant, high-society home. Overall, it’s a very impressive experience.

One of a few best Thai food restaurants in Bangkok. We ordered dishes as a staff recommended and loved them all. All were very flavorful, tasty, and delicious except the pork satay that was still good but a little too sweet for us.

Best Green Curry and Pork Satay in Bangkok!

Be careful of some crazy expensive menus

Cadence by Dan Bark truly defines fine dining as an art form. Every dish is beautifully crafted — refined, balanced, and full of emotion. I visited for the Weekend Lunch Menu and decided to switch the main course from Wagyu to Duck, which turned out perfectly tender with deep umami flavor.

What impressed me most was how Thai local ingredients were thoughtfully blended with modern techniques and subtle Korean influences, creating flavors that felt both comforting and sophisticated. The experience of choosing my own knife before the main course was such a unique and memorable touch — I chose one that the chef brought from Romania, which made me think of my trip to Sibiu years ago.

The service team was warm and professional, the plating was elegant, and the whole atmosphere felt personal yet world-class.
If you’re looking for a place that celebrates creativity, precision, and heartfelt storytelling through food — Cadence is one of the best in Bangkok.

I recently dined at Cadence by Dan Bark, a restaurant that clearly reflects the team’s commitment and dedication in every detail—from the polished service to the beautifully plated dishes. The staff were genuinely attentive and professional, making sure every guest felt well taken care of throughout the evening.

The food was good and thoughtfully presented, though I personally felt that with just a touch more depth in flavor, it could elevate to something truly exceptional. Still, I appreciated the effort that went into each course.

The ambiance was calm and elegant, albeit a bit quiet during my visit—perhaps a result of the growing number of new restaurants in town drawing diners across the city.

All in all, it was a pleasant experience, and I respect the passion behind what they’re doing. With a bit more refinement in the flavors, this could easily become one of the standout fine dining spots in Bangkok.

An outstanding experience from start to finish! The Caviar and the Wagyu dishes were absolute highlights—rich in flavor and flawlessly prepared.

Chef Dan’s cooking is world-class, and the entire team was incredibly professional, warm, and attentive. The mocktail pairing was easily the best I’ve ever had, Oh Wow!

Highly Highly recommend if you’re looking for an exquisite dining experience. A truly unforgettable meal. I can’t wait to go back again!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

An unforgettable evening at **Cadence by Dan Bark** in Bangkok! Faye greeted us with a delicious cocktail and led us to a beautiful glass room decorated with roses, perfect for relaxing before dinner.

Chef Dan crafted a unique 15-course menu tailored to my dietary restrictions. Highlights included the exquisite **albino Beluga caviar** with miso-cured tuna, the stunning **Alaskan King Crab Gazpacho**, and the flavorful **Duck à l'Orange & Truffle** with a delightful parsnip skin contrast.

A special shoutout to Head Bartender Top for pairing each dish with creative cocktails that enhanced the flavors. The artistry and thoughtfulness behind every dish made this experience truly special. Highly recommend!

Booked Cadence during our 10 year wedding anniversary vacation to Thailand.  Food, service, and atmosphere was perfect for our celebration. Every dish was beautifully plated and tasted amazing. We were so glad we added the wine pairing since it complemented every dish very well.  Definitely would visit again next time. Thanks Chef Bark and all the staff for creating another core memory of a wonderful evening!

A really nice restaurant serving local dishes with a modern twist — great flavors and beautiful plating! I highly recommend the signature pork meatball wrap and the grilled sticky rice with sun-dried pork. The portions are big, so even though the price is a bit high, it’s totally worth it. The vibe is super good, the restaurant is clean, and the staff are very friendly. Definitely worth a visit!

Extremely delicious Vietnamese food here. Fresh ingredients, cooking done right, lively vibes with active stuffs and Thai oldie songs..

As a group 5 who ordered plenty of food, this quality meal costs us just 1,2xx THB, what a memorable dinner!

All dished are well prepared, if u need more hot and spicy, do cut some chili and added in the dishes. Be careful this pale chilies are burning ones. Banana flowers salad is refreshing. Fish noodles soup is really good, the noodles were made from fishes. Ice cream is not impressive and a little bit too expensive.

Beautiful presented food , ( I am bias for this Food Star due to personal preference )
Big plus for fresh veggie .

Good taste. Good service. Good Atmosphere.
For vietnam food.

Sampaonava is a lovely restaurant by the Chao Phraya River in Ayutthaya — a perfect spot to enjoy delicious Thai food with a beautiful riverside view. The decoration and ambience are warm and relaxing, making it ideal for both family gatherings and casual meals.

The dishes have a truly local Thai taste — flavorful, well-balanced, and clearly made with quality ingredients. I also love that the restaurant is pet-friendly, which makes it even more welcoming.

The staff are attentive and full of hospitality, creating a great dining experience from start to finish. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Ayutthaya.

We had late lunch on Saturday at this river front restaurant, no reservation required. The service was great, the waitress recommended the dishes made from the ingradients of the day. We ordered from the recommended dishes in the menu, all of them are great, especially the chilli paste set. This place offers authentic royal Thai cuisine you cannot find easily in Bangkok.

The open-air seats by the river look nice for dining, will try next time.

Superb atmosphere, great food with lots of variety and service!

🍒 They offered super interesting menu , some items are hard to find nowadays. Their masmun curry, which was something I barely ate, was amazing here.

Recommended dishes:

🥗 Masman curry with crispy roti.

🥠 Spicy Prawn and paco leaves salad.

🍝 Palo [พะโล้]

💌 Service was effective and quick.

🌄 Great atmosphere, I love the decorations.
Great authentic Thai food and atmosphere! Can also see a good view of Phra Prang. River prawn was great and fresh!

This place is beautiful ,modern fancy, warm, sophisticated at the edge of the river with beautiful open view. Not only is the food outstanding in quality but the service is brilliant. The seafood was so fresh .The platter portions are super generous. Authentic Thai food flavours with fresh aroma and herbs. Highly recommended.

What a find. I asked GPT for Chiang Mai’s coolest up and coming places and Aquila looked like the best recommendation. It didn’t disappoint. Book ahead and get the chef tasting menu, every single dish is top class. The place honestly feels underpriced for what you get. Five stars. Will bring friends next time they visit.

Found this restaurant on the Michelin Guide and loved everything we tried. The portions were generous, the quality outstanding, and you can really feel the care the chef and team put into every dish. Definitely a place we’ll be coming back to again!

Very good restaurant!! It’s my second time there, and everything was amazing, the service was great and the food was delicious.
The truffle pizza was the best and also the ribeye steak!!
Very recommend 10/10

Nice chef owned restaurant, lucky to arrive on a rainy midweek night with no reservation, which is recommended.
The Octopus with creamy cauliflower with the crispy pork bits was great, the amuse bouch puffs were very easy to eat, the beet root salad fantastic, the spaghetti with mussels above average and the grilled cheese sandwich for our child was nice.  Above average, reasonably priced Italian food for Thailand

Quaint cozy restaurant. A little hidden. But once inside, it's comfortable.
Food is good. A few items didn't wow me though.
Seafood supreme and panna cotta was quite disappointing. But the other items ordered were very good. Loved the pork chop. Prawn and crab aglio olio was also yums.

Recommended place to go. For the quality, prices are reasonable.

Travel from Bangkok for a day trip in Ayudhaya. This restaurant is hand down one of the best restaurants in all of Ayudhaya for their grill giant river prawn and their garlic giant river prawn. The restaurant always super busy during weekend so it's highly recommend to book for the river prawn. Besides their river prawn dishes, their other dishes such as the fish head soup, papaya salad are all very tasty.

First of all, do bring your portable fan!

I and my whole family have been here countless times. The price is reasonable for what you get and taste is top rank. Expect the food to be top-notch, don’t expect the view.

For that many times I visited, I have nothing more to add.

We had our lunch at Ruan thai kung pao during our day trip to Ayutthaya. Our driver recommended this "local favorite" restaurant. As soon as we arrived, the michelin award signs were displayed on the entrance.

It was a wooden structured restaurant above body of water.
The food were great! Fresh seafood which were fich in flavor and tasty.

We ordered:
Shaved ice
Tom yam kung
Deep fried fish with fish sauce 👍
Crab fried rice
Stir fried morning glory
Grilled giant river prawns
Deep fried shrimp cakes 👍
Fried prawn with tamarind sauce 👍

They gave us complimentary a plate of crabsticks.

Highly recommended when you visit Ayutthaya.

The place is an hour’s drive from Bangkok, and busy during the lunch hour when we visited, which was on a Sunday, so the 15-20 minute wait was understandable. The staff who informed us of the wait was very pleasant, that made the wait feel shorter than it was.

Our order-taker was a pleasant, young lady, who communicated with us, non-Thai speakers, excellently! We ordered the grilled prawns, tom yam gung (spice-level adjusted to my non-spicy preference), fish cake, fried rice, and some drinks. Everything was superb, even (or maybe, especially, the seafood dipping sauce)!

This grilled prawn restaurant is a must-try for seafood lovers! The prawns are perfectly grilled, with a springy and juicy texture that’s incredibly satisfying. Paired with their flavorful and zesty seafood dipping sauce, every bite is absolutely delightful. If you’re craving fresh and delicious grilled prawns, this place won’t disappoint!

The crew is lovely, attentive and provides good and prompt service. The atmosphere is cosy with nice decor, good for small group gathering. The food wise, was lack lustre considering the price- the mussels in white wine are sadly small and while they do not taste spoilt, they absolutely lack flavour too so they are not good for eating. The grilled chicken was good, tender and nicely grilled, the pasta was not worth definitely. Overall, it’s a place for nice ambience but not value for money Italian food for sur3.

I had an excellent dining experience at Giglio Trattoria Fiorentina and would highly recommend making a reservation in advance.

📍 Location: Very easy to find, which makes the visit even more convenient.
✨ Ambiance: Classic Italian charm — warm, inviting, and perfect for an authentic dining experience.
🍝 Food: Absolutely exquisite. Every dish was thoughtfully prepared and full of delightful surprises in both taste and presentation.
🙌 Service: This is what truly makes Giglio special. The entire team is exceptionally attentive, genuinely friendly, and goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome.
Thank you for an amazing and truely romantic evening with my partner.

We live in Bangkok and never expected to come across a place like this in Khao Lak - super tasteful and cool rooms, service completely lovely and the food was just incredibly different, fresh, and so flavoursome. This restaurant is a must-visit.

The ambience is a reminiscent of 1960s 1970s Thai Chinese setting. The food left us desiring for more. Every dish that we ordered was delicious however the small portion made us wanting more. The staffs were also very professional and gave us good pointers on what to order.

Ambience is perfect. Food is well balanced. Spices are spectacular. Staff are heart warming and kind. My taste buds are tingling. Great food and vibes. Very recommend this place if you visit Ayutthaya. I went with my foreigner friends and they love it. Even when we asked to reduce the level of spice, the taste of the food was still amazing. The staff recommended us to go with River prawns sized 3 & 4. Good size, good price.

Fabulous food right on the river Chao Phraya. Dining area on a boat. A floating area and a land area as well. Fresh River ponds are fabulous

very nice food and goooood service mind. really love their grilled shrimp and all the dishes we ordered and after we ended and struggle with finding the car back to the train station, they offered us the free ride.
This Thai restaurant in Nakhon Pathom serves truly authentic dishes, packed with rich and spicy flavors. It’s definitely a place you shouldn’t miss — the food won’t disappoint

A 30-Year Culinary Journey in a Vintage Oasis
This Thai restaurant, having navigated a 30-year journey through various locales from Chatuchak Market to its current stately home in a former primary school, is an institution defined by remarkable consistency and high-concept execution. The final location is not just a dining room but a beautifully preserved architectural setting, offering a palpable sense of vintage charm.
The interior, which evokes a refined mid-century aesthetic, is instantly striking. Tasteful decoration, wooden framed windows, and classic mid-century furniture (as evidenced by the bar and dining area in the photos) create an elegant, vintage-meets-modern backdrop for the meal. The clean design elevates the traditional Thai home-cook experience.
The restaurant’s true success, however, lies in the kitchen. Despite changing addresses, the home-cook style and taste have remained remarkably steadfast. This is comfort food elevated by the use of highest quality ingredients, ensuring that nostalgic flavors are delivered with impeccable freshness. The commitment to a complete dining experience is further cemented by a thoughtful selection of cocktail creations and desserts that adhere to the same creative and quality-driven concept.
The sole operational friction point is the extremely limited parking. Requiring guests to reserve a parking spot simultaneously with their dinner reservation, and often necessitating carpooling, is a significant inconvenience that demands planning. While the setting and the food justify the effort, this logistical constraint is the only drawback to an otherwise flawless and memorable dining experience. Despite this hurdle, the visit is highly recommended for anyone seeking authentic, high-quality Thai cuisine wrapped in rich, nostalgic ambiance.

A great place for authentic Thai foods mostly Southern Thai foods which are a little bit more spicy. Foods are served in a small portion actually too small for some menus such as the deep fried sun-dried tenderoid and stir fried shrimp with yellow chilli and basil.

Price is pretty steep I believe due to the premium raw materials used here, however, everything considered, I think it's too expensive for what you get (prices on the menu are subject to 10% service charge and 7% VAT).

Still recommended for those who love spicy and Southern Thai foods thay do not want to go out of town.

As per the Michelin guide, Prik-Yuak is highly recommended, showcasing Thai cuisine with a Southern influence. It is suggested that you complement the dishes with garlic and shell oysters, and conclude your meal with delightful desserts such as banana with coconut milk, which offer a sweet flavor.
Please note that all menu items are prepared without MSG or oyster sauce.

The Thai food here is truly delicious, with authentic flavors and well-balanced seasoning that really stands out. Every dish is thoughtfully prepared and presented beautifully. However, the prices are on the higher side, especially when compared to the portion sizes, which are relatively modest. That said, the overall experience is still enjoyable. The ambiance is pleasant and relaxing, making it a great place for both casual meals and special occasions. There is parking available, which is a big plus in this area. I would recommend making a reservation in advance, as it can get quite busy during peak hours.

Impressed with the food, decoration, vibe and service here. It was my first time visiting but I had heard about this place for a while and I really love it.

They mostly serve Southern Thai food and it is really delicious. The crab with yellow chili was the highlight. The chili was spicy but not so much that it overpowered everything. The braised eggs and pork had a balanced, clean taste which was also excellent. Other dishes like the fish and the Kaeng Som curry were just as impressive, so I honestly loved everything.

The price is a bit higher than other Thai restaurants but with everything I mentioned above it is worth the money and perfect for a nice meal !

I visited this restaurant after seeing many good reviews on blogs. It’s located by the river, so the atmosphere was really nice. The restaurant has a Michelin mark, which raised my expectations.

However, the server who looked after our table had some trouble understanding us, and there was a small mistake with our order. For a Michelin-rated place, I think the staff could be trained a bit better in communication.

The food was generally tasty, but nothing particularly special considering it’s a Michelin restaurant. I feel you could find dishes of similar quality at local spots for the same price. It’s worth visiting once for the experience, but I probably wouldn’t come back again.

Rongros is a riverside gem by the Chao Phraya River that truly lives up to its Michelin recognition. The view is absolutely stunning.
You can enjoy a breathtaking panorama of Wat Arun while dining. Every dish is beautifully presented and full of authentic Thai flavors with a refined touch. The food tastes incredible rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced.

It’s the kind of place where you can sit back, relax, and savor both the scenery and the taste. Perfect for a special evening or anyone who wants to experience Thai cuisine at its finest.

⭐️ Michelin-awarded taste, mesmerizing view, and warm Thai hospitality 👏🏻

The view and decoration are beautiful, and the food is truly delicious!

However, everything was completely ruined by the service from some of the staff. I could clearly feel a difference in how Thai customers were treated. The attitude, the looks, and the manners from certain staff members were very disappointing. My mum and I both felt upset by how we were treated.

For the price, I expected much better service and proper Thai hospitality. Sadly, it was far from that.

It’s such a shame because the food and atmosphere are wonderful. But the service left such a bad impression that I don’t think I will visit again, no matter how good the food is.

I was so excited about this and it did not disappoint! The food is excellent although the price matches the prime viewing location. Getting a rooftop table can be risky as there is definitely no rain plan and the restaurant is always booked solid so you can’t simply move inside. Luckily it did not rain on us. The service is not Michelin quality but the overall experience is well worth it.

Everyone enjoyed their food (the green curry was the spiciest thing I ate all trip though for sure!), however we all agreed the food was good but not amazing, so it definitely seemed overpriced. Laab mu, somtum lao, kep mu and sticky rice were perfect.

Now i understand the true flavour of isaan food so i will definitely eat this the next time i come back

Very friendly service, excellent food, especially the larb.
Very good!
Delicious esan food

Malfi and the team were amazing, very personable and made us feel so welcome.

Very gorgeous sunset view for the restaurant, nice and pretty dishes, with considerate staff and chef serving us, especially Morphine who is very nice. Better to book earlier time to cap to the period of sunset by the sea!

It was a special dinner for us and everything went amazing! The food was absolutely delicious, every dish was prepared with care and full of flavor. Atmosphere is really calm and relaxing, also loved the music!! Big thanks to Morphine for a great service 🤍

i love the broth and the quality of the meat. we ordered the beef dumpling as well. it was a different experience as normally dumpling fillings have a rough and firmer texture, but what i had was the opposite. Morning Brunch at Ten Suns (ไร้เทียมทาน 十光)
For our morning brunch, we treated ourselves to a local Michelin-awarded spot that specializes in all things beef — Ten Suns. This humble shop is known for serving up seriously tender cuts and bold, comforting flavors.

We ordered three dishes:

Braised Shank Beef Noodle Soup

Ox Tongue with Rice

Beef Wontons

Every dish showcased the quality of the beef — fresh, perfectly cooked, and melt-in-your-mouth tender. The ox tongue was especially impressive: soft, flavourful, and beautifully done. But my personal favourite? The beef wontons. Each bite was bursting with savoury goodness, and the beef inside was so soft it practically dissolved in your mouth.

A must-visit for beef lovers — no frills, just incredible flavours.
Had the noodle soup with tongue and beef wonton. Both incredible. The tongue was thickly sliced and so tender. The beef wonton was so juicy. And the price is so cheap. Highly recommended!

The best beef noodle in Bangkok 🐮❤️☀️🍜—if you're a beef lover, this place is a must-try! There’s really no competition, I don’t even know who to compare it to because it’s already so far ahead in taste. 👅 ✨ The flavors are rich and aromatic, and the beef is tender with distinct textures from each part of the meat. You can clearly feel the difference in the chewiness with each bite. I enjoy every part, even the meatballs are delicious. But the highlight is definitely the shoulder and tongue—they’re absolutely mouthwatering! Every time I have it, I feel like having three bowls, but they give such a generous portion that I can barely finish one.

The price is very reasonable considering the quality. The only downside is that the shop is a bit hard to find, and there’s no parking, so you’ll need to park at the nearby temple and walk over, or you can order for pickup. For tourists, it’s an easy walk, though. The shop doesn't have air conditioning, but the fans make it comfortable enough. The building has a cool, renovated vibe—an old structure with a mix of Thai and Chinese influences.
This is incredible beef noodles.Extra with no line for michelin 👏🏻 Impossible please come…Recommend cheek braised beef.

Five stars without hesitation! Dining at Acqua Restaurant was truly exceptional from beginning to end. Each course was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented…an absolute feast for the senses.

Acqua offers more than just a meal, it delivers a complete dining experience. Perfect for a special night out, a celebration, or simply treating yourself to something extraordinary.

Amazing Italian food in Phuket, the starter is impressive while main course would still need some fine tune if compare to any Michelin star 1 restaurant. Local food with the reasonable price.

Best local food restaurant and fish is very fresh and well cooked.

Standard prices and acceptable service.

Overall taste were mild with only spiciness, yet the beef was so overly cooked. The tongue was unreasonably overpriced. The restaurant was filled with smoke and smell, you will have the odor with you for a whole day if you come to eat here.

the queue runs professionally. however, the food gave me food poisoning. the taste was okay. I like the soup. meat was too hard and hard to chew.

This time we hit up a Michelin Guide street food spot in Bangkok — Lay Lao — for some seriously good seafood. 🦑🦀

Prices were also amazing, around 150–250 THB per dish, so it’s definitely a spot we’ll be coming back to. Solid 9/10 — Lay Lao totally deserves its Michelin status. If you love Thai seafood with a bit of heat, this one’s a must-try. 🌶️✨

made a reservation on sunday 5pm, and the restaurant was already quite packed. the standouts of the night were definitely the grilled pork neck and the pad thai, though the grilled squid was unique for its tender flesh and a fragrant spicy sauce.

would definitely recommend, especially for tourists if you’re in the ari area!

Best Thai food we had. Definitely must try!!!! And visit this branch. We visited another one too, but this one executed the same dishes better.
Grilled pork neck was exceptional and star of our meal, we loved it so much we ordered another plate. Phad Thai, grilled homemade chicken and honey pork was also good. Shrimp paste fried rice is only for those looking for a more unique dish, it was very shrimpey. Overall we really enjoyed our meals here!

lay lao was good! we had the crab fried rice which had chunky crab meat, chicken pad kra pao with its spicy hit, and one of their signatures: grilled pork neck. the pork neck was the most outstanding one we had—a very umami dipping sauce, akin to sinigang, but different with spices and a strong sweet-sour punch. the pork itself is tender and cooked well, pairing well with its dip.

will definitely try a lot more for when i’m back and with even more crab dishes!

To be honest, every single bite of the meal was excellent. The snails, for example, truly amazed us and we’re used to eating them back home in Spain! The Caesar salad was fantastic, and we loved that they prepare the dressing right in front of you. The steak tartare was also really good.

However, we did have an issue with the main part of the dinner: the Porterhouse Steak made with Australian Wagyu. The problem is that if a piece of meat is frozen and shown to the customer straight from the fridge, it’s impossible to cook it rare and have it come out hot in less than three to four hours. So, what we received about 45 minutes after finishing our starters was more like a “stewed” Porterhouse, covered with too much pepper. We ended up leaving part of it, which was disappointing especially because the service, atmosphere, and every other detail were absolutely perfect. The team paid such great attention to detail.

My suggestion would be to only serve fresh meat or to ask customers to pre-order their steak in advance if it needs to be defrosted. That way, there’s enough time to prepare it properly without stewing it.

Because of that, I can’t give five stars but we’re all here to learn, and I’m sure they’ll keep improving! Thank you very much.

This place is not just about great steak, it’s about the whole experience. From the fresh oysters to the indulgent mains, every dish was cooked with care and attention to detail. It’s on the premium side, but worth every baht for a special night out. Highly recommended for date nights, celebrations, or when you simply want to treat yourself to the best.

I have to say this place is “delicious beyond expectations.” Every dish is crafted with care — perfectly balanced flavors using fresh ingredients that make you want to keep ordering more. The taste is rich, fragrant, and truly irresistible.

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with comfortable seating — perfect for dining with friends, family, or even for a lovely dinner date. The service is impressive too; the staff are friendly and attentive throughout the meal.

Overall, this is a restaurant I’d genuinely recommend. If you’re looking for a great place to eat, this is not to be missed! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

I’ve been a loyal guest at New York Steakhouse, JW Marriott Bangkok, for over a decade—and for good reason. Every visit is marked by impeccable service, a refined ambiance, and consistently exceptional food.

This classic steakhouse serves up timeless favorites, from succulent grilled lobster and perfectly cooked cuts of meat to crisp, flavorful Caesar salad and indulgent desserts. The seafood tower is a must-try, beautifully presented and always fresh.

To me, this is hands down the best hotel steakhouse in Thailand. It’s my top choice whenever I think of fine steak dining, and it never fails to impress.

Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates old-school steakhouse charm with world-class execution.

Classic North American steakhouse in the heart of Bangkok. They have a nice selection of beef, as well as all the classic steakhouse sides. They have a beautiful dining room and service has always been really good.

Our all time favourite sushi place in Bangkok.  The chefs are all Japanese trained in and sent from Japan.  Their ingredients are also all imported fresh daily from Japan, so one can taste the freshness in every dish.  The staffs were well trained and were both very knowledgeable and accommodative.  I must say the service was on point.  The food were excellent, as always.  True edo sushi, which is the best in our opinion.  Honour the ingredients and true flavour.  Love it.  Highly recommend.

I went with my husband for his birthday lunch and we had such a memorable time. The staff were warm and attentive, and every dish was beautifully crafted — the sushi was fresh, delicate, and absolutely top quality.

We also had a wonderful conversation with the chef, which made the whole experience even more special and personal. It really felt like more than just a meal — it was a celebration to remember.

A perfect spot for any special occasion, and we’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend Ginza Sushi Ichi in Bangkok.
First omakase experience in BKK. Chef was very friendly and engaging. Service staff very prompt and efficient. Decent pricing, excellent quality food and service. Will definitely be back.

I had the pleasure of enjoying the omakase dinner menu at Ginza Ichi Sushi, and it was truly a memorable evening. The food was not only excellent value for money, but every course showcased ingredients that were remarkably fresh and high-quality.

What stood out most was the chef’s generosity with uni and premium ingredients – every bite felt indulgent yet thoughtfully prepared. On top of that, the chef took the time to explain the origins and unique features of the various ingredients, which made the dining experience both fun and educational.

Overall, Ginza Ichi delivers more than just a meal – it’s an authentic journey through Japanese flavors, guided by a chef who is passionate about his craft. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a true omakase experience in Bangkok.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

“Too Rushed for Omakase”

The service was very fast, too fast for an omakase experience. I finished the entire course in just 55 minutes, which felt rushed and didn’t allow time to truly enjoy each dish.

The chef didn’t seem very meticulous or engaged. The food was cooked and served quickly, with little attention to detail or interaction with the customer.

Overall, not recommended if you’re looking for a proper, thoughtful omakase experience.
The crispy crab balls are really good. I like the braised duck texture. It’s soft .

returning to Bangkok via Bang Len, we often make a big U-turn to the restaurant and buy our dinner home !  the stewed duck is the signature and has been irresistible every time over many, and many years.  and the combination with some traditional Thai-Chinese menus is the best gastronomy experience beyond words.  this restaurant is probably older than most of us; besides the good food, we also find memories of travelling between Bangkok and Kamphaeng Saen.  in March 2023, the restaurant was featured in the 'Michelin Guide'; they well deserved for this culinary honour, and perhaps the new milestone of the restaurant !
Thai-Chinese food, effordable price, one of the best in this road. Restaurant Canteen style. Clean and Tasty food. Fast serves during day time. Satisfy price vs quality.
Very delicious Chinese food, fresh ingredients, easy to afford price and easy to go with parking lots. Love it.
A local Thai restaurant with a local taste. Air conditioned and has good clean toilets.

A must-try local gem! This humble spot serves up incredibly flavorful beef ball noodles with rich, aromatic broth and perfectly tender meat. The soup has a deep, savory taste that’s been simmered to perfection, and the noodles have just the right bite. Friendly service and authentic atmosphere make it a great stop while exploring Old Town Phuket. Affordable, satisfying, and full of local charm!

It's a Michelin star noodle shop. Beef balls are very good, you might want to add on an extra bowl of beef balls. Price is very cheap considering it's a Michelin star restaurant. But it's hot inside the shop, you might want to finish quick and then go to nearby coffee shop to hangout.

I had saved this place prior to my trip and I was so happy I visited! Such simple dishes but amazing flavour. My boyfriend ended up ordering two bowls as he loved it so much!

The dark broth soup was sold out on the first visit, so make sure to get there early! However, the clear broth was also tasty.

The staff were also very helpful.

Definitely worth adding to your list.

Very good food at an insanely great price! It’s a family-run business and the owners are very sweet.
I got the vermicelli noodles with beef soup, which is a combo of all the beef options they have. Highly recommend!

Resonable Priced Hokkien Noodle Shop

Beef ball is tender and able to tell it is made by the restaurant.
Soup is clear broth with strong flavor which is great.
The minced beef is just fine.

Not sure why the restaurant is Michelin Recommened as it feels like an ordinary soup noodle shop.

However, I do think the quality provided exceed the price they charged.

However, I won't make a visit to Phuket Town specifically for that bowl of noodle

I really love it! The food is super delicious — highly recommended! The prices are unbelievably cheap; I didn’t think you could still find prices like this nowadays.

You should definitely come and try it. Support the locals and enjoy the original, authentic flavor. I especially recommend the Khao Soi — it’s absolutely delicious!

Kanomjeen is a must-try spot for authentic Chiang Mai local food, proudly holding the Michelin Bib Gourmand for 6 years. The mild yet flavorful taste feels genuinely homemade, perfect for both locals and travelers. Their menu offers a wide variety of dishes so everyone can find something they like. The highlight is the kanom jeen itself – soft, fresh rice noodles served with aromatic Northern curries and sauces that showcase true Northern Thai tradition. A delicious and memorable dining experience!

Kanom Jeen Sanpakhoi is truly a hidden gem in Chiang Mai. 🍜 The curries are rich, flavorful, and perfectly balanced — simple dishes done exceptionally well. The local vibe adds to the charm, though parking can be a bit tricky and the heat is something to keep in mind. 😅☀️ Still, the taste makes it more than worth the trip. A must-try spot for anyone who wants an authentic Chiang Mai food experience.

• Good and authentic Thai food at a very affordable price, though not outstanding.

• Worth a stop if you’re passing by and looking for a quick, cheap Thai meal. However, if you come with high expectations, you might be disappointed.

Food very nice for it's price, not all varieties are suitable to our palate though. The place is inside local market, but it still clean and need to us to do self service counter and cleaning counter. Not a bad experience though.

One of the best restaurant in Phuket!
We love it so much and came here twice. Everything tastes good. And the price is very reasonable. My favourite is the pork organ soup, all the organs are cooked to perfect. Although there are a lot of customers, we never have to wait and the food serve within minutes after we ordered.

This restaurant is the real deal. Every time I’ve run out of ideas on where to eat, this spot in Phuket Town has never let me down—it’s become my go-to comfort place. Whether it’s their flavorful hot dry porridge or the perfectly crispy pork, the food here always hits the spot.

The location is super convenient and walkable if you’re exploring around town. Evenings can get a little busy, but honestly, the wait is worth it. The prices are fair, the service is warm, and the menu gives you plenty of options with quality cuts of meat that you can actually taste.

If you’re visiting Phuket, I’d highly recommend adding this to your food list—you’ll probably end up coming back more than once, just like I did.

Found another gem in Phuket with good local taste. Easy to order menu, just A to O. Deliciously good. Taste of soup is rich and flavourful. You can order a bowl of pig blood soup which is not in the menu. Will come back again. Pay cash only, no card payment.

Heard so much about Go Benz and its legendary dried porridge, so I decided to give it a try while in Phuket. The place gets super crowded early, you will need some 10-20 minutes to queue up but service is fast and the vibe feels local and energetic. The dried porridge was actually pretty good, with a nice mix of meats and textures. I actually love their soup served separately the most.

I personally feel it’s not bad overall, but not quite as special as the hype suggests. The crispy pork didn’t impress me much — the texture was a bit underwhelming and the sauce was just okay. It’s still a decent spot for a local-style late-night meal.
Go Benz truly deserves to be in the Michelin Guide! Even though the dishes are quite common, the flavors are really unique. The portion sizes are also very reasonable for the price.

Chai Pochana (Samakkhi Road, Nonthaburi)
​This is a very famous and often busy.
It looks like a simple place but it has
received a Michelin Bib Gourmand award for good food at a good price.
​It's known for Thai and seafood dishes, often eaten with boiled rice.
The most famous dish you must try is the "Muek Hom Cha Nam Pla,"
which is crispy fried squid with a special fish sauce glaze.
Other popular dishes are sea bass, crab curry, and various spicy salads.
The food is fresh and delicious especially the fish menu which really stands out. Prices are a bit on the higher side so it may feel overpriced for some but the quality and taste are definitely good.

Chai Phochana received Michelin Bib Gourmand recognition for years, and it is no joke. It is such a hidden gem. The commute wasn't easy for me unless you got a rental car. Food was top-notch. The fermented crab 🦀 with their fresh made sauce was just phenomenal. When I mixed their fresh made sauce, the rice, and the roe from the crab shell together, it gave me this incredible food orgasm. It became bombs on my pellets. The feeling was just unbeatable, I would say. Also, the cockles scald clams had such sweetness that you could only find in such an authentic Thai restaurant. Dip the clam meat in their signature sauce, and it gave me more depths to the flavor. Oh lord it almost made me cry. Man...Amazing dining experience. Last but not least, house tom yum kung had so much aroma and flavor. I always saved soup at last. You could simply tell it was authentic. It didn't matter when I was dining at 91°c degree. Thai singha was an immediate remedy to overcome the heat or pretty much anything lol. #authentic #Thai #seafood

The food is delicious. I’ve been there many times. The wait time is short. There is plenty of parking on both sides. There are many seats, but the air-conditioned area is a bit limited. However, I’ve been eating there since there was no air conditioning.
Great food. Recommended to go early. Fresh seafood and good fruit as well. Shrimp so fresh and price is reasonable.

Tried to order and try out as many different dishes as I could muster. The star for me has to be their rice soup. Pipping hot soup that carried awesome flavours. Not herbal as the color would suggest, but the freshness of the seafood, meats and aromatics made this oh so satisfyingly good.

The toast and rice dish didnt impress. Suggest to skip on these, to dive right into the different rice soups being offered.

I was thrilled to discover this Local Michelin restaurant!

Their herbal soup was fantastic, and compared to other local spots, I loved their unique cleanses. It was a true delight to DIY my own dish!

Although the Roasted Pork Rib rice was unavailable during my visit, let this be a reminder to plan ahead—it's not available on Thu. & Sun.!

The first good sign was that I was the only farang in the restaurant 😁 It was at capacity when I got there and I only had to wait a few minutes to get a table (they are well organized giving away numbers for people waiting to be seated!) A really lovely waitress gave me a menu with everything well translated in English. You can simply choose a snack, mix and match to make your own Thai breakfast bowls, or select one of their signature. Looking at the reviews I thought I'd go for a dark broth with Phuket style noodles and all the bits of the pork. It was divine!! I also ordered their signature toast with the house-made coconut custard and it came out after the main meal. To be honest my mouth was so full of flavors from the soup that I didn't even get much out of the sweet treat... But still worth trying it anyways!!! 10/10 for this place and its authentic flavorsome dishes! Love it! Thank you

Have to admit that I was a bit skeptical before visiting this place. Well, I am glad I did come to this place. In fact, we visited this twice on two consecutive days! And my dad wanted to visit one more time before leaving the islands. 😅

Food wise, we love almost everything we ordered. Love the soup, the boiled rice, the dry boiled rice, the kaya toast, the local toast. The drinks might be a bit thin to my personal taste.

The staff were very friendly and accommodating. They even went out of their way to change a chair for my dad to sit comfortably. Very thoughtful!

The place can be crowded but the orders just took the right amount of time to deliver.

Will definitely go back!

Unique and local Phuket dishes. Very flavorful and wide variety. Have a lot of menu items for all ages. The dry Tom yum noodle with cheese was definitely an experience. Meats have real depth to them. Can see why this restaurant is a Michelin Guide. Very fast service as well. Menu is extremely well designed with pictures to know what you’re ordering. Must visit in Phuket!

In love with this place and would highly recommend to anyone who’s looking for a quiet stay with delicious local food. I stayed only one night but came back to Bangkok fully recharged. The room was very clean and comfortable. The owners are sisters who grew up in the area and really put their hearts and soul into this place. I particularly love the breakfast on the patio in front of our room where I get to make Khaojee (grilled sticky rice) and grilled pork myself. My photos wouldn’t do justice; this is the place you have to come and stay to experience it!

Suggest for advance booking and noticing the owner prior visiting so you will be enjoyed with the armosphere and the hospitality service from the them.

Food is niceee , tasty and perfect portion. My orders are for one I eventually took the rest home.

Parking lots are plenty with green scenary of rice field

Distance is just right the corner of city's outter ring. Overall, it s such a good experience to visit there.

This is a must to visit in the Isaan region/Khon Kaen area. We had a wonderful time with Pu and the staff. It is a beautiful farm, with lovely and comfortable accommodation, and beautiful animals. We spent here one night, but it could have been more. Our farm tour and cooking class before dinner were informing and fun. We had lunch, dinner, and breakfast, and all food prepared in here tastes incredibly good, some of the best meals I have had in Thailand. Very serene stay. We loved it.

I had the pleasure of staying at Mekin Farm and I regret not staying longer. Phu and her family have created something really special here at Mekin Farm and it's so inspiring to see a place like this which celebrates and teaches you all about Isan culture through food. You really can embrace the simplicity of the Isan lifestyle. The cabins are spacious, tranquil, beautiful, stylish and has everything you need including a bathtub. Many hammocks around too. We had lunch, the included dinner which was also a cooking lesson and the breakfast was also a bit of a cooking lesson. Every single thing we cooked together and ate was full of flavour,l using organic and the most fresh ingredients. The animals are very well looked after and it's just such a beautiful property. I will definitely come back. Highly recommend Mekin Farm, it's a must in Isan.

I brought foreign exchange students here for a cooking class and some cultural activities. We all loved this experience so much! Food was amazing and the tour of the homestay and farm was very fun! They loved using flowers for coloring and try eating some edible flowers.

A great dinning experience near the Phuket old town. Such a delicate place is certainly scarce in Phuket. The beef cheek is nicely done, the curry sea bass is awesome, highly recommended.  And the ice cream is a must try.
Service is prompted and super nice.

Good vibe, friendly staff, recommend to book in advance if you come with group (they may ask for deposit before arrival date).
All dishes are superb, from appetizer to main dishes and dessert. We ordered fish steak (fish of the day), taste was so amazing!
Highly recommend for this place.

If you’re planning a nice dinner in Phuket and want something refined yet relaxed, HEH is a fantastic choice. It’s a Michelin-listed restaurant that delivers thoughtful, seafood-forward cuisine in a beautifully designed space — modern yet warm, with a subtle coastal elegance that reflects its focus on the sea.

The menu is centered around fresh, high-quality seafood, with a contemporary approach that blends Thai, Australian, and global influences. The fish dishes are a real standout — perfectly cooked, delicately seasoned, and plated with care. They change the catch depending on what’s fresh, but whether it’s snapper, grouper, or something more unique, the quality really shines. Their house-made sauces and accompaniments elevate each dish without overpowering the natural flavor of the seafood.

The wine list is excellent — a well-curated selection featuring both Old and New World options, with a strong showing from Australia and France. The staff are happy to make recommendations, and pairings were thoughtful and spot-on.

Service is polished but friendly, and the environment is calm and well-suited for a slow, unhurried evening. Whether you’re celebrating something special or just looking for a more refined meal while in Phuket, HEH is absolutely worth a visit.

Just be sure to book ahead — with the Michelin mention and growing reputation, tables fill up quickly.
Food is great always, Chef Oat is great making these dishes, always enjoyed dining here. Highly recommended for good food and good vibes. 👍
Great service and amazing food. All of the dishes were creative and we loved the friendly low key atmosphere. I’d recommend the fried eggplant and ceviche.
Open very long and very tasty but food

reviewer: สุพงษ์ สิลานนท์
review_text: Ok
I wish I had a restaurant like this near my house. The fried morning glory, the hot tom yum soup, and the 🐍 🐟 salad made me close my eyes and clap my hands 👏.

reviewer: อนุสรณ์ หล่อตระกูล
review_text: The best rice soup shop in Khon Kaen. Everything I ordered was delicious. The price was not expensive. The ingredients were good. I will definitely come back again.

The shop has two sides, so you can sit on either side. The food is generous and tastes great with rice soup. You don't need to rely on dipping sauce. The price is reasonable. Most importantly, the food is taken and served very quickly.

What a beautiful and stunning restaurant. They even had a little stool for my bag to sit on, which I thought was a cute touch. We had a group of 4 and did the tasting menu with the lobster add-on. Definitely worth the money for the whole experience. It ended up being about $200 USD/person, which isn't cheap for Thailand, but compared to most Michelin experiences you could get in the States, it's considerably affordable, especially when you consider all the food and drink we ended up having.

I loved the inventive takes on Thai dishes in small bites and the different textures. Also appreciated that the menu revolved around rice. Everything was delicious to me, personally. I know there were some textures my friend wasn't a fan of, but the flavors still delivered.

The drinks were just as great as the food. I had THE BEST mocktail ever here – The Emerald – which has pandan, Asian citron, lime juice, and ginger ale. I loved it so much that I have my bartender husband recreate a close version for me frequently back at home lol!

The service stood out the most at Paste. From the very beginning we had the most attentive service from our waiters. I really enjoyed our dining experience. We were offered complementary starters and dessert from the chef which felt very special. We ordered the beef  Hang Lay curry and crab omelet. The beef was falling apart to perfection. I enjoyed the crab omelet but I would not order it again.
I also love how private our booth was, it felt like we were dining completely alone.

Every now and then we all need to experience something unique like a tasting menu.
Paste has a very nice posh atmosphere and the outdoor view at night is really amazing.
The service is great. The staff was always very attentive, took the time to explain each dish, answered any of my questions, and was very friendly.
The food was great and very satisfying. What I really enjoyed is how every dish is unique, but you can tell how each dish is built on the foundation of traditional Thai cuisine. A very unique and enjoyable experience.

Although this establishment intimidates the casual diner, I encourage those with the fine taste and generous budgets to enjoy a unique diner at Paste. This restaurant showcases professional table waiting and beautiful presentation. The dishes are unique and you’ll have fun trying the appetizers and cocktails.

The restaurant offered an amazing dining experience overall. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was well-prepared, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The menu had a good variety of options, catering to different tastes and preferences. The service was excellent; the staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout the meal. They served our food on time and were always ready to help with a warm smile. The atmosphere was cozy and relaxing, with soft lighting and pleasant background music that made the space feel welcoming. The interior design was modern yet comfortable, creating a perfect setting for both casual and special occasions. The cleanliness of the restaurant was impressive, and everything looked well-maintained. It felt like a place where you could truly enjoy your time without any rush. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food, excellent service, and a lovely atmosphere.

It was my mom’s birthday today, so I took her to CODA, a one-Michelin-star Thai restaurant in the Sindhorn Building on Witthayu Road.

The food was amazing, a creative twist on Thai cuisine I’d only seen in magazines before—bold flavors but not too spicy.

Every dish was delicious, but the real winner for me was the duck congee that came with every course (and yes, you could get unlimited refills). The soup was ridiculously good.

Came here on a friend’s recommendation while in Bangkok and it was fantastic. Food was super tasty – Thai flavors with a creative twist and a touch of French finesse.What really surprised me was the porridge they served right at the end, even after dessert. Felt like something my mom would cook at home – warm and comforting, very special touch.The place has a great vibe with high ceilings and glass all around, and the chef was really friendly. Honestly, food, atmosphere, and price – all just right!!!

Coda Bangkok is nothing short of spectacular — a place where luxury, food, and service come together seamlessly. Every dish is a gastronomic delight, crafted with precision not only for the tummy but also for the eyes. The presentation is artful, the flavors layered and memorable, and the staff ensure the entire experience feels polished yet warm.

For me, dining here marked a truly landmark trip and experience — one that will stay etched in memory as much for its beauty and hospitality as for its cuisine.
Thai restaurant with a great twist! All the dishes is full of surprise. Looks like a typical fine dining dishes, but pack with the explosive taste of authentic Thai food! 10/10 totally recommend!

I recently revisited CODA Bangkok, arriving right at opening time—partly because I was hungry, and partly because it had been years since my last visit. With the restaurant now holding 1 Michelin star, I was eager to see how the menu had evolved.

The concept remains rooted in Thai cuisine, but it’s been elevated into a modern fine dining format. Each dish was thoughtfully plated and creatively presented. While the flavors aren’t traditionally Thai in a rustic sense, the essence of Thai spirit still comes through, with each course delivering a refined interpretation of familiar elements.

The restaurant space is bright and airy, especially if you dine early in the evening. The natural daylight flooding in through the glass facade makes it perfect for food photography—every plate looks like it belongs in a magazine.

A particularly thoughtful touch: after the main courses, if you’re still peckish, the team offers a complimentary hot duck congee, served steaming and soul-warming. It’s a generous gesture that speaks to their hospitality.
Very good food for a very good price. Service is very friendly and fast. I can recommend Curry Soup, Springrolls and PadThai. We've been there multiple times. Great smoothies too.

Absolutely fabulous food. Plenty of options and the right amount of spices. Despite other places they don't add excessive sugar in the dishes. The place is super proper and they invested a lot to make it comfortable too.
Closed on Saturdays.
Payment cash.
Free WiFi.

10/10 ! authentic thai, fresh, tasty, great portions, and with great prices.
Staff is great. Good service.
Atmosphere is amazing!

we took around 10-12 dishes, everything was amazing, and it costs us around 700 baht.

👍 parking
👍 WiFi
Delicious vegan food. Lots of flavour. Very authentic tasting.
Amazing food! Just had to wait a bit too long to get it. But great atmosphere, super friendly staff and wow the food! Would come back for sure

Can’t beat fresh seafood on peaceful BangPo beach! We visited several times during our week on Samui, and their large menu didn’t disappoint. Highlights: in-season fried fish with garlic, steamed in-season fish, gaeng som soup, grilled prawns. Thanks for the delicious food!

One of best seafood restaurant in Koh Samui.
We ordered around 6-7 dishes which comes freshly prepared and steaming hot.
The taste is very good and the fishes, crab and mussels are fresh.
They work hard and fast to deliver the food to the table.
And main thing is the prices are very reasonable and good value for money.
That's why Michelin recommended.
Good...keep up !

I see that they are taking the reviews quite seriously.

After seeing the reviews, I was a bit worried about going , but though we'd give it a try.

We tried several dishes recommended on the menu: #1 Grilled squid, #2 Fried squid, #4 Padthai with seafood, #6 Grilled crab, #7 Crab with coconut curry, #6 Thai papaya salad with crab meat, and #12 Baked prawn with glass noodle.

They were all decent.

I think the vibe of the place - a local restaurant by the beach - suits the price of the place. The staff were quite attentive and were quite quick with serving.

I think it's a good local place worth visiting but not "extraordinary". I would recommend it with the right expectation.

Final comment - because I kept over hearing people making comments about this very word - Michelin. This restaurant is (and so are many restaurants) simply a Michelin-recommended restaurant. Neither Michelin star nor Bib Gourmand, which means that it was a good restaurant for inspectors. That's it.

And this restaurant was exactly one of those.

(I'm adding this rather flamboyant comment after hearing over and over the people "critiquing" those restaurants during my 4-day trip in Koh Samui - "this restaurant doesn't deserve a star"... It doesn't have a star!)

Really cool local place on the beach, unassuming, unpretentious, simple, great.
I’m not a great gourmand and can’t necessarily comment on whether the Michelin recommendation is warranted. I tried two dishes. The squid in curry and with spices was brilliant. The sea urchin egg salad was so spicy that I did not taste much. But it was interesting and unusual nonetheless. It’s definitely worth another shot to explore what their depths are. I think there’s more :)
It’s good, nothing to complain, hope on some sunny afternoon will go for dinner again. I am so satisfied with the fish. By the way, my baby also like it.

My husband and I are big fans of Thai food, and every dish here felt truly special and fantastic to us.
As many reviews mentioned, the menu was quite difficult to understand—even for Thai food lovers like us. Fortunately, a kind waitress recommended four less-spicy dishes, and we thoroughly enjoyed them.

That said, we had to wait quite a while for dessert after finishing our main course. It left a tiny mark on an otherwise perfect experience—but the desserts were absolutely worth the wait.

Actually, getting to Koh Fahn was one of the most memorable parts of our visit to Long Dtai. A very friendly driver took us to the island in an amphibious vehicle, and we returned to Chong Mon Beach by a little boat. It was such a fun and unique experience!

As an overall experience, if money is no object, then I would recommend Long Dtai. Even if you aren’t rich, and you can’t really afford it, for a couple of hours you’ll feel rich, which is fun.

We saved it for a birthday special, and had really high hopes. After all David Thompson has an amazing rep in Australia. Come on Dave, please be good!

The arrival lounge, the “unique” transport in, the gold buggy up to the restaurant, the first view of the sky unfolding over the endless turquoise ocean, the outdoor cooking, and the beautifully landscaped dining and kitchen area are so stunning. The ambience is really special, it has a lovely feeling when you walk in. You feel like you’ve found a secret spot. I don’t know if it had a scent but it felt like it did, you know?

Before we get to the food, this isn’t a negative review, because overall I’m so glad we went and we were so desperately willing Long Dtai to be incredible, but there is a caveat to this review and it’s because the price is high and the chef’s reputation is so renowned so I think it’s fair to critique.

For the food and service it felt a little overpriced. The beef skewers, the deep fried fish and the five spice chicken were all quite overcooked almost to the point of being - dare I say - dry. The shrimp in Garuda was good for the first mouthful and then became bland and we didn’t finish it. Dinner though was saved by the blue swimmer crab curry which was the showstopper dish and genuinely one I would swim across oceans for, but overall, compared to other high end restaurants, across the world it lacked. And it was sometimes hard to get a drink - at that price, timing of service is everything. But the ambience was great and the view incredible, so still you should go. And maybe we just ordered badly.

At Long Dtai, all of the elements are there for an absolute showstopper but the food could just be better.

Dinner on a private island, with the cliffside view of the setting sun? What’s not to like? The extra fun factor is crossing the narrow channel by boat makes that much more of an experience. The food was not as spectacular as the view or the ambience but it was not bad. The only ding was Service, it was a little inattentive and slow for the fancy restaurant that it is. But I do recommend giving this a try. I recommend coming early - like 5pm to enjoy happy hour prices and the stunning vistas.

Long Dtai means traveling in the south defines our dining experience at the restaurant very much. My curiosity as a fan of David Thompson from many places in London & Bangkok, we decided to dine there. We found the authentic southern Thai cuisine with locally & sustainability products took us to the culinary journey of the beautiful South of Thailand. We love the fresh crabs in the yellow curry soup.
The harmony of fresh ingredients & spices are excellent. The location, the service are simply elegant.

Long Dtai by David Thompson is a must-visit restaurant, offering an unforgettable dining experience. I am fortunate to be spending my holiday at Cape Fahn in Samui, where we will enjoy dinner at this acclaimed establishment.

Long Dtai's cuisine emphasizes local ingredients to create extraordinary, authentic southern Thai dishes. Featured in the Michelin Guide, the restaurant guarantees a delectable dining experience.

My favorite dishes from the menu include:

- **Aromatic Beef Skewers with Cumin and Turmeric:** The beef is incredibly juicy, and the aroma of fresh Thai herbs is delightful. 480 baht
- **Coconut and Turmeric Curry with Blue Swimmer Crab:** Typically a favorite of mine, this dish here is exceptional, with incredibly fresh crab. 980 baht
- **Palm Sugar Dumplings in Coconut Cream (Dessert):** Easy to eat, with the perfect sweetness from the palm sugar. 270 baht

The restaurant operates from 18:00 to 21:30. If you arrive early, you can visit the bar, open from 17:00 to 22:00. Please note that the restaurant is closed every Wednesday.

Guests from outside the hotel are welcome, but it is advisable to make a reservation in advance. Additionally, allow extra time for the hotel's transit boat to reach the restaurant.

If it's not the rainy season, I recommend sitting outside to enjoy the island view.

Overall, I believe this restaurant is likely to receive a Michelin award next year, thanks to its impressive flavors, ambiance, and service. Thank you for providing me with such wonderful memories.

I had such a wonderful dining experience at Nan Bei! The restaurant is truly beautiful, with a warm and elegant atmosphere that makes the whole evening special.

A big thank you to the amazing team — Bew, James, Art, Hun, Aoy, and Deab — for their outstanding service. They were all incredibly attentive, professional, and genuinely friendly, which made the experience even more memorable. Every detail, from the food to the service, was handled with great care.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for not just delicious food, but also excellent hospitality.

“We had such a romantic dinner here, enjoying the beautiful Bangkok city view amidst lovely, dim lighting. The food was absolutely delicious, and the portions were just right. My personal favorite was the crispy pork—they’ve truly mastered making the skin perfectly crispy while keeping the meat incredibly juicy. The other dishes were just as delightful.

While the prices are on the higher side, the service is excellent. We arrived around 6:00 PM, and our food was served very quickly. The restaurant’s decor is clean, stylish, and well-maintained. They also offer private rooms with a minimum spending requirement.

A special thank you to F and Pam, who took such good care of us with their warm smiles and friendly service. We hope to come back again soon!”

Nan Bei at the Rosewood Hotel delivers a refined and delicious take on modern Chinese cuisine.

The service was excellent throughout the meal: attentive, professional, and friendly.
The elegant atmosphere added to the overall experience, making it a perfect spot for a special lunch or dinner.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-quality Chinese cuisine in Bangkok.

What a place to be for authentic Chinese food. Amazing atmosphere with such caring and genuine service from Khun F and Khun Aoy. I’m going home thinking about the best Beijing Duck, jelly fish salad, hot and sour soup, and premium Tim sum. Thank you so much!
Safe to say Nan Bei is our favorite weekend spot for Peking duck. We’ve been here almost 10 times in the past 10 months. Love the food (Peking duck is a must). The service is great, too!

Plu restaurant is serving authentic Thai food. The food tends to be more southern Thai style. The decoration and the vibes is Thai comtemporay. This is a perfect place for family gathering or business dining. It is pricy but worth the experience.

The service is great. Waitresses are so attentive and informative. A lot of  smiles even though in peak service hour.

Food is delicious here. Taste of real Thai with full of spices and flavours. Stir-fried Sea Bass (fish meat) with celery is nicely cooked and seasoned which goes well with jasmine rice. Beef with black peppers is tender and has a nice aroma. Try one of thier mocktails or fancy tea drinks which is lychee in the mixed is so refreshing, highly recommend!

Okay this place is insanely good!!! I’m a foodie, visiting Thailand for the third time and this is the most impressed I’ve been. We ate 3 dishes - The 5 spice eggs & pork belly stew was melt in your mouth and the broth so flavorful and the eggs cooked to perfection. The pomello & smoked duck breast salad felt like it was straight out of an inventive masterchef contest. And the pumpkin crème brûlée - again creativity that is brilliance not force fitted. I’m looking forward to visiting again!
P.S. Even the complementary snack they served at the beginning was a flavorbomb!

We loved this restaurant and would recommend this place to anyone, especially tourists to Bangkok. It can be easy to miss as it is not on the main road but this place was recommended to us a from Thai local and we all enjoyed the food very much. The waiter had also advised that the chicken and beef here is halal.

One of the best restaurants I’ve visited in Bangkok. The restaurant is really nice, and the staff are very friendly and professional. The food was excellent. We had the Spicy Oyster & Lemongrass Salad, Pork and Chicken Satay, Stir-Fried Noodles with Beef and Kale in Black Soy Sauce, and Stir-Fried Minced Beef with Holy Basil, followed by a few desserts. Everything was well-prepared and full of flavor. I’d definitely recommend it.

I was so impressed by the variety in every dish, even in the simpler dishes like papaya salad and the omelet. Stir fry noodles were my favorite, with flavors I literally have never tasted before. Pics don’t do it justice. Exquisite!!!

restaurant_name: Guay Jub Chang Moi Tat Mai
review_text:
a long-celebrated Michelin-recognized noodle shop that has proudly held its award for over six consecutive years.
Located in the Chang Moi area, parking can be a bit of a challenge as there are only a few spots available right in front of the shop. However, there’s a nearby parking lot that charges about 30 THB per hour.

Today, I ordered two dishes: the special Kway Chap and crispy pork with pork intestine on rice.
Price-wise, it’s slightly on the higher side for the portion, but nothing too surprising. The crispy pork was perfectly crunchy, with a sweet-style sauce that balanced nicely once paired with chili fish sauce and vinegar. The soup for the Kway Chap was clear, aromatic, and had a pronounced peppery note — similar to the Yaowarat-style broth, though slightly milder.

As for the “intestine” I ordered, I initially expected large pork intestines, but it turned out to be sausage instead — quite similar to Korean soondae, though lighter and easier to eat.

Overall, the flavors were good — not mind-blowing, but solid and satisfying.
The ingredients were fresh, clean, and of good quality — fair for the price.

One thing to note: the shop only accepts cash payments (no transfers).
To get a queue, you’ll need to write down your order and place it at the counter — otherwise, your order won’t be processed.
The wait time wasn’t bad at all, roughly 5–10 minutes today.

restaurant_name: Guay Jub Chang Moi Tat Mai
review_text:
Guay Jub Chang Moi Tat Mai

99/11-12 Chang Moi Tat Mai Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50300, Thailand

This place specialises in Guay Jub with Sai Ua sausage, served in a unique peppery broth, featuring with crispy pork and pork liver. Their soup reminds me of bakuteh of Singapore but a little less subtle.

I ordered their famous crispy pork + sausage with rice, and mixed vegetables and meat soup for lunch! Their sausage is to die for!!! It tastes a lot like Vigan Longganisa a less salty but more peppery and humongous. 😅

They are open everyday from 10AM to 3PM to for cater lunch. Be sure to reserve (by writing your order on a paper provided) before 12NN to secure seat as locals flock during lunch time.

#BirthdayCountdown #OctobertoRemember #LostInChiangMai #solotravel

restaurant_name: Guay Jub Chang Moi Tat Mai
review_text: A Thai-Chinese style restaurant with signature dishes like Kao Lao (clear soup with meat and veggies) and Guay Jub (rolled rice noodles). The broth is rich, flavorful, and fragrant with pepper. Their unique minced pork stuffing sets them apart, and the spring rolls are also delicious. Overall, it’s a local gem that has earned Michelin stars for several consecutive years. Definitely worth trying for yourself, since everyone’s taste is different.

restaurant_name: Guay Jub Chang Moi Tat Mai
