Because there are not a lot of seats available, you should make your reservation in advance.  Additionally, due to the location of the shop, it could be a little bit challenging to get a parking spot.  In general, it is not considered to be bad.

You have to book in advance. I tried coming in at 8pm thinking the place isnt busy anymore. But it is.

They were fully booked but I was lucky someone cancelled and the chef allowed that I can take the slot. Really great service thank you so much Rasik local kitchen!

For the food, it was gooooood!!!! I would say best meal so far in Chiang Mai! I like how cozy the place is - good for just vibinv

Modern Thai cuisine I would say. All the starters were very good such fried squid and mangosteen salad. Mains were average in terms of flavour. Place is very vibing small space but pack with guests, service is warm and welcoming explained all the food like they know what they are doing. Book in advance tho.

The food was absolutely delicious made with quality ingredients that really came through in every bite. Portions are on the smaller side which keeps the pricing quite reasonable.

The place itself is cozy with just 4–5 tables per round and three rounds a day, so booking in advance is definitely recommended.

The staff were friendly and confident in recommending the dish of the day which was a great touch. The wait for food was a bit long, but well worth it. Overall, a lovely experience and I’d happily come back again✨

To begin with, once we are arrived at the restaurant the women who greeted us which i believed somehow is a girlfriend of the owner which is not helpful and kind enough with her ego facial expression tho.

Secondly, the food wise aren't that worth for the price point. Even though the services team mentioned that the grilled fish was 450.- per piece then the total billed said 650.- on it. At that point i would just let it go and dont wanna escalate the situation.

We have been ordered for 4 dishes and if i have to recommend to a friends or among who read the review here is just to go a different places to have a reasonable price and better services than here.
This is just a bib gourmand tho imagine if it get the stars that might be overkill.

Details matter

Just for the owner or related personal read this, pump up your services and attitude of the lady (thin body) that minor details will be great !

The reservation process was challenging but the meal was worthwhile. The two of us took the recommendation of the chef and ordered 5 dishes plus rice and drinks. While the dishes are not big and all delicious, we just couldn't finish them and had no space for the desserts we wanted to try. Highly recommended are:
Stewed free-range pork, Grilled beef rib fingers, Fish in white curry, Mangosteen with poached prawns.

The food is here is amazingly good!!
Everything is cooked with a Chinese-style twist, but still packed with flavour.
The waiters and the owner were so helpful and welcoming. The restaurant was full when we went - always a good sign! 🤩

Southern Thai cuisine, not sure if it’s worth the hype as many places from here all the way to Songkhla are able to cook to a similar level of standard whilst offering a much lower price. Still, if it’s your first time trying southern Thai food, this will be a good place to start.

A Michelin guide restaurant with local food. We came back twice because the food was so delicious. Really recommend the fried sand whiting fish and butterfly pea coconut juice. The fish curry was also really fresh and flavorful but slightly on the spicy side.

All the dishes are so good and full of flavors! They can made the dishes to be non-spicy (no chilli added) upon request also and the taste is still awesome.
As a visitor from Bangkok, I found that this is the best local restaurant in Surat Thani. :)

Our absolute favourite dinner in Surat Thani, which we discovered on the Michelin guide. So good we went twice. We loved the penang, fish cakes, sweet and sour, chicken cashew nut and the fried garlic pork. All delicious, served hot and very flavoursome. The staff are also friendly and welcoming. 100% recommend.

Amazing authentic southern food all the classic favorites in an authentic AC restaurant should be Michelin star owner has an amazing collection of wines many 10+ years old.  Fantastic food great setting.

delighted to have discovered this southern-style restaurant. The moment you step inside, you’re enveloped by the familiar aroma of smelly beans, which is used in southern Thai cuisine.

The food lived up to expectations. The curry was spot-on, the vegetables and shrimp chili were delicious, and the chili is quite spicy. Every dish was authentic and well-prepared.

While the portions were a bit small, it actually allowed us to try more dishes from the extensive menu. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with the food and would highly recommend this restaurant. It’s definitely worth a visit!
Super delicious for thai southern food it is incredible to find thai authentic southern food in the north of Thailand, i came to this restaurant twice and I’d continue came here. 🥰🥰🥰🥰
Talung Southern Thai Food in Chiang Mai!  It's amazing. The food is incredible, especially the stir-fried squid with ink – seriously delicious.  And the service? Top-notch.  I'm going back for sure.
Definitely one of the best southern Thai food in Chiang Mai, the shrimp paste is amazing
It's lovely! The view is spectacular and the food is delicious. Not to mention the great warming staff that works there. Will visit again definitely ❤️

An absolutely exceptional dining experience! TAH at Four Seasons Koh Samui offers not only perfectly prepared dishes with a focus on freshness and authentic Thai flavors, but also a breathtaking setting. The atmosphere is luxurious yet relaxed, with stunning views of the sea and surrounding nature.

The service was top-notch – professional, attentive, and always friendly. Every detail, from presentation to menu recommendations, was handled with the highest level of care.

This was one of the best culinary experiences we have ever had. Highly recommended for anyone looking to combine outstanding food with a magical atmosphere. 🌺✨

Wow wow wow! I cannot describe how amazing and breathtaking Koh Thai is. From the second they greet you in their waiting area to their shuttle to the top. You feel like you are truly pampered.

All the food we had was incredibly delicious. The cocktails were very refreshing and sweet and all the little touches from the potato and taro bites were fantastic. Worth coming here. I was the best meal we had our entire trip to Southeast Asia and I’m still thinking about it.

We have been eating there 3 nights in a row the food is absolutely delicious , we have tried all the starters , all divine, Pad Thai is a must ! One of a kind !!!! Every day I had the coconut sticky rice ! Absolutely great , the view is amazing on sea and green hill . Great place , thank chefs for such excellent cuisine

This was really a beautiful location, the views are stunning and the service is excellent.  Food was tasty but did not have the depth of southern Thai cooking.  Flavoured towards the guests of a continental palate.

Great spot to eat for solo, friends and family. Fried lobster with thai chillies and salt was the best. Absolutely worth the price. Didn't enjoy the roasted curry with wagyu as much. It got so overshadowed by the lobster.
Staff was attentive but perhaps a bit too much. But they still did a great job.
Inside seating has AC and outside seating for the people that can tolerate heat.

One of my favorite restaurants on the island. The food is worth every penny! Friendly service, clean, fresh food, & a good drinks selection.
The signature southern curry and the deep fried sea bass variations are my favorite.
See you soon again.
Lovely cocktails (I had the Bees Knees, and it was sublime), and the food (Crab curry was my favorite dish my whole trip here) was amazing. The staff were so attentive and kind. Absolute recommend!
Amazing food!! Highly recommend coming here. Best restaurant in Chaweng. The papaya salad was delicious, the yellow curry with shrimp wow!! Go here.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Dining at Kapi Sator was truly an amazing experience! The food was so delicious that I couldn’t stop eating — it truly lives up to its Michelin recommendation. Every dish was crafted with care and attention to detail. A special thanks to our server, JU, who was warm and attentive, making us feel right at home from start to finish. From the food to the ambiance and service, everything was perfect, and I can’t wait to come back!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Very local street side duck noodle but clean and tasty. We drove out from chiangmai city center to try these dishes and it's worth the drive! Their specialty is the duck noodle and you'll love it if you enjoy roasted ducks.

Such an unassuming Michelin guided place on a busy road. Excellent duck, good portion size and fantastic value. No Q. Cash only. Friendly English speaking service. I’ve included a translated (to English) pic of the menu. Worth a visit.
Very nice taste, yummy 😋 that why they are Michelin guide 2025!!

If you are a duck lover, you should try this shop. Although it is a bit far from central chaing mai, it is worth it to go outside the town to have this delicious menu😋. Don’t forget to try snacks & desserts as well. The price is really reasonable & definitely worth it .

Amazing place if you like duck. I ordered khao soi with roasted duck and it was incredibly delicious. The meat was tender and had this smoky flavor which elevated the dish to a different level.

They are specialized in duck and noodles, but you can also try pork here. Soups are available as well, and the portions are pretty big and the prices low.

It is a bit far from the center but definitely worth the trip. Apparently it's opened every day until 4pm.

Huen Muan Jai is one of the best places in Chiang Mai to experience truly authentic Northern Thai food. Their Sai Ua (Northern Thai sausage) is incredibly flavorful, perfectly spiced, and tastes so fresh. The fried pork belly is super crispy on the outside and tender inside — a must-try! The atmosphere feels local and cozy, making the meal even more enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to taste real Northern Thai flavors.
👍

Had high hopes and most of them were met! The vibes were fantastic and very serene. The service was quick and pleasant, and we only waited for about 25 minutes on a busy Saturday. :)
