- Sai Oua (Northern Thai Sausage): 4/5

*   Khua Pak Chiang-da Sai Khai (Stir-fried Gymnema Vegetable with Egg): 4/5 - Worth a try.
*   Gaeng Khae Pla Duk (Spicy Vegetable Curry with Catfish): 2/5 - Sorry, I didn’t like this at all. We thought it was mostly flavorless and overwhelmingly fishy in taste.

This was a great introduction to the world of Northern Thai food. Definitely recommend! 🙏

Delicious food that tastes just like home-cooked meals from mom’s kitchen! Authentic Northern Thai flavors — rich, comforting, and satisfying. The restaurant is spacious and welcoming, with reasonable prices. It can get a bit busy, so you might need to wait for a table, but it’s definitely worth it for the great food and local taste! No wonder they’ve been awarded a Michelin Star for five consecutive years!

This restaurant, right in the heart of Chiang Mai, offers absolutely amazing food. The interior is beautifully designed, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The menu is inspired by the northern region of Thailand, and everything we tried was outstanding. We had several dishes, probably ten or more, and they were all delicious. I highly recommend the mixed platters, where you can try a variety of different items. The service is top-notch – the staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and helpful, and they speak excellent English. I highly recommend visiting this place for anyone looking for great food in a beautiful setting. From the moment you walk in, it’s clear that this place is special!”
Northern Thai food The taste is unique. There are a variety of menus to choose from, desserts, parking, convenient travel, overall good, recommended, recommended.

The food is great, with excellent service and the atmosphere, the decor, and by the river scene is simply just amazing. The only catch is the price. It is definitely on the expensive side. We visited on the weekdays but I expect it to be very busy during the weekend so might want to make a reservation advance. Will I visit again? Almost definitely.

Very nice European dining house and garden.
Good service and very yummy foods
I am here becoz of Lisa!
Great to celebrate bday here
Staff are friendly. Food was good. A bit high price but acceptable. Especially fish which came only 2 small and medium for 400.  Soup was delicious.  Lemon juice was very tasty. We order twice.

Nestled in the heart of Ayutthaya province, this Thai restaurant offers delightful flavors at every turn. The dishes are not only delicious but also reasonably priced, making it a fantastic value for money. The interior is beautifully decorated, creating a pleasant dining atmosphere. The service is impeccable, and ample parking space is available.

Among the recommended dishes are the succulent shrimp curry, a must-try that shouldn't be missed. Other standout options include the garden-fresh grilled tilapia, the green curry, and the savory salt and pepper golden needle mushrooms.

However, there is room for improvement, as a few ants were spotted floating in the green curry. Overall, this restaurant offers a satisfying culinary experience that captures the essence of Thai cuisine.

Really good food that can be enjoyed outside so as to enjoy the garden and river or inside the cozy building.

There are a few things that I think could be improved that would further elevate this already good restaurant. 1. Update the physical menus. It's the quality of a restaurant in a soi. 2. This is a great restaurant that respectable people come to eat but the beverage selection doesn't reflect that. So many fake sugar soda drinks and you can't even get sparkling or quality mineral water. 3. Service. Staff are nice, but are slow, fail to check on customers to refill drinks, remove plates, check if they want dessert, or just check if they need something. I don't think they are doing a mediocre job on purpose, it feels more like they just don't know. I'm sure if they were trained, they would do a good job.

Now, I'm only harping on these things because when they are able to fix those issues, this place is going to be packed. It's very enjoyable to eat here and everything we ordered was delicious. And if you don't mind a slower than normal service for this caliber of restaurant, 100% you should eat here.

Been looking for a cool chill place where I could relax, have some excellent food and drinks and watch the sunset and discovered this very modern and chill bar! Has a real classy look and relaxed vibe and the staff was very responsive and helpful. They really made me feel at home and comfortable the entire time I was there and the food! Oh man the food was excellent and definitely recommend it for the fresh seafood and the drinks were such a treat. Well mixed and good variety. If you’re looking for a cool place with great prices and a chill vibe then I can whole heartedly recommend Mu-Te-Lay!!

Me my wife and our 1.5 year old came here 4 times for dinner in the space of a week. The food, the staff and the atmosphere were excellent every time.
We ordered papaya salad, shrimp cake, chicken cashew nut, chicken pad Thai, mango stick rice, and a drink each.
Only downside to the beautiful atmosphere is the heat and moderate level of flies with the outdoor seating, which I think could be combatted with more fans and some lemongrass or citronella scattered around the place.

Very nice place for local Thai food with a view! It is just about 5 minutes drive with the taxi from Pullman hotel.
We had tom kha kai, som tam, stirfried kingcrab, local beattle leave with egg dish, fried squid, all very delicous. Fried rice was ok. We had a very fresh coconut juice and the icecream brand is very good. We had duruan and mango icw. I can highlt recommend the place with friendly staff!

We searched this place a few minutes before arriving here, and i must say what a beautiful place. The food is super delicious, the staff is amazing and very attentive :) we will definitely be next time :)

Nice spot, perfect for watching the sunset thanks to the sea view and the relaxed vibe. The food didn’t really impress me, nothing special. I tried the watermelon juice, but it was quite watery and lacked flavor. Overall, worth it for the location, but there’s room for improvement when it comes to food and drinks.

If you want real Thai food, this is the place. Go to the second Mook Manee (not the first one by the beach) — it’s way more relaxed and feels local. The food is fresh and full of flavour. Try the Tom Yum and check what seafood they have that day; everything comes straight from the sea. Best to visit outside peak hours for a chill experience. Simple, authentic, and tasty.

The service was great. They have servers station at each table to refill drink, serve food, and all.

The food was okay. We got all kinds of seafood - shrimp, crab, fish, and shells. We also got fried rice with crab meat.

Crab with curry tasted okay, but crabs didn’t have much meat. The shrimp with tamarind sauce was good.

The parking was far away, but they provided transportation.
When I come to Phuket, I have to come to this restaurant because the seafood is fresh and delicious. The atmosphere is seaside. I give it 5 stars.

Very good place, but buy your seafood and ask them to cook, cuz their prices are very high maybe 2-3 times more price.
And make sure to give them each food by 1 kilo so they cook for 100baht
Even 0.5kg they cook for 90 so know this.

We love tiger with cheese, shrimp with panang and baby octopus garlic fried top top

Bonus: they have tasty coconut icecream from nestle (in box) incant find them anywhere only here

The only Michelin restaurant in Rawai Beach — and fully deserving of the title. Owners nai hua Pitoon and khun Mon his sister personally oversee every detail, delivering top-quality food and hospitality. This is my only choice whenever I visit Rawai, and it always leaves an impression on my family and friends as well

Another thanks to Mr. Man, one of the restaurant’s key staff, who manages a small seafood shop outside and always provides live/ freshest and recommendations.

Kinda sad to write this honest review as l think getting Micillin Star recommended restaurant should be a Wow fact !!!
Was excited to try but unfortunately most of the food were lack of taste.. so bland. Eating small local restaurant probably much better than here. Very disappointed

At first I thought we had the wrong place due to lighting/tables etc, but it was the right place and the food and service were excellent. We had ant eggs, and the small fried banana root fish. Also larb ped and som tum.Used google translate on the menu.
An elevated Isarn food experience. All classics in one place including the more obscure and hard to get by ones. Everything was cooked to perfection.

Reliable Isaan Cuisine in Udon Thani
"Krua Khun Nid" offers Isaan food in a comfortable setting. It's a dependable choice for local dishes. A good spot if you're looking for quality Thai Northeastern food.
Grilled pork neck is the best. Great variety of Isann food. Plenty of seating and parking.

This is my first experience in coastal indian cuisine and this is an exceptional first impression for me. All of the food we ordered are very impressive. We order fish and roast mutton for small starting dish, ans both are well cooked with strong spice and well balanced flavor. The main we ordered are dosa with ghee roasted chicken and alleppey mango curry. The ghee roasted chicken are very fragant with a lot of spice that was smooten with smokey butteryness of ghee. The mango curry is very unique with prominent lead of sweet and sour taste while still have enough spice and savoryness to make it work well with the accompanying rice and tapioca.
The staff are very helpful and attentive as well. The place might be a little pricey, but, personally, it is well worth the price. Overall, it was a very enjoyable experience.

The food was not only delicious but also beautifully presented, every plate made us excited to try it! If I had more room, I would have definitely ordered even more dishes.

Beyond the amazing food, the service truly stood out.

The staff were attentive and thoughtful, we never had to ask for anything, yet everything was prepared in advance. For example, when my girlfriend found a dish too spicy, the staff immediately served yogurt to balance it out.
Even at checkout, when we forgot to pay for the extra of drinking water, they gently and politely reminded us.

Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience where both the food and the service exceeded our expectations!!

Thoroughly enjoyed the food and service here. Great date place. They serve coastal Indian cuisine so if you’re like me who are more familiar with British Indian Curries (butter chicken/tikka masala/etc) you are off to an adventure and forced to venture out.

What a delight. My group of 8 ordered family style.

We had:
Mini Apam
Cashew Gobi 65 (like chicken 65 but with cauliflower yum)
Tanga Chili Crab

Badanekai Ennegayi - eggplant
Ghugni Kochuri - white pea curry
Pineapple Mensakai - roasted pumpkin curry
Chili Pepper Crab
Karaikudi Butter Garlic Tiger Prawns
Kundapura Ghee Roast Chicken
Kurobuta Pork Chop Vindaloo

Malabar Parota bread
Cashew Ghee rice

All was worth ordering again except white pea curry cuz the other dishes shine more for me. So good. Excellent job.

One of my absolute favorite restaurants in Bangkok—and easily one of the best places for Indian food. That said, I wouldn’t classify it as your typical Indian spot. Jhol specializes in coastal Indian cuisine, offering a refreshing and distinct contrast to the more commonly found North Indian dishes.

I’ve tried most of the items on the menu, including the tasting menu a few times, and honestly, everything is outstanding. That said, there are a few dishes I keep coming back for:

Masala Maska Bun – never thought I’d enjoy this so much, but now it’s a must-order.
Kerala Mutton Roast
Fried Chicken Wings
Ghee Roast Chicken – hands down my favorite. I usually skip the tasting menu just so I can order this.
Lamb Shank – amazing, but definitely best shared with a group.

Other highlights include the pork ribs, biryani, and pork chop, all of which are well worth trying.
I usually skip dessert since I’m not big on Indian sweets, but the savory side more than makes up for it.

The staff and manager are incredibly welcoming, attentive, and always happy to offer recommendations.

In short: a must-visit if you enjoy Indian food—or even if you think you don’t. It’s a place I take every guest visiting me in Bangkok.

Just had an absolutely fantastic dinner at Jhol in Bangkok and I'm still thinking about it. This isn't your average Indian restaurant—it's a whole new level of modern, coastal Indian cuisine. Every single dish was a perfect balance of traditional flavors and unique twists. The service was impeccable, and the staff were great at explaining each dish. The vibe is sophisticated but still really relaxed and welcoming. It's clear why this place is getting so much buzz. If you're looking for an unforgettable meal, this is the place to go. I highly recommend it!

Very good value of money.

Strong flavors, penetrate well into the chicken thigh. Loved the pickled garnishes. Drinks are delightful. We’ve had roselle juice and Thai black coffee.

We went there on a Tuesday. They open from 8 am and we arrived at 8:15. They shop is packed already but we didn’t have to wait as we got the last table. By the time we left, the line got quite long.

Family run shop, it is quite heart warming to watch they work together!

Best Khao Soi we have had on this trip to Cnx! Michelin rated authentic, small/open kitchen serving tons of tourists and locals with the tastiest khao soi. We had to wait for only 10 mins on a weekday at lunch time. Their buzzer system for cue management is pretty efficient.

Khao Soi Maesai is, without a doubt, one of the essential culinary stops in Chiang Mai. Their version of the Northern Thai curry noodle soup is famously rich and perfectly balanced. The broth is thick, creamy with coconut milk, and boasts a wonderfully deep, complex curry flavor with a satisfying hint of spice. I highly recommend the Beef Khao Soi; the meat is incredibly tender, practically falling apart into the decadent soup. The contrast of the soft boiled noodles beneath the crispy nest of fried noodles on top is pure perfection. It's easy to see why this spot consistently earns a Michelin Bib Gourmand—it’s an authentic, unforgettable taste of Lanna cuisine. Go early to avoid the inevitable queue!

I went there for breakfast to avoid the lunch rush and it turned out to be a great choice. I ordered the Khao Soi with pork and a traditional Thai milk tea—both were excellent. The curry broth was rich and flavorful, with just the right amount of spice. The noodles had a perfect, firm texture, and the pork was tender and well-seasoned. Definitely worth a visit if you’re a fan of Northern Thai cuisine!

I ordered takeout at 12:30 and only had to wait about five minutes. I noticed they have a standard workflow for preparing khao soi.

the owner seemed a bit impatient while taking my order. As for the food, the mild khao soi soup was easy for foreigners to eat and overall it tasted good.

Amazing local Satay restaurant!
Strongly recommend to order bread along with the satay then dips them to source! The heavens touch 😂
Very tasty satays! One of the famous restaurants in Phang Nga, it's well worth a visit if you are in the area. All the satays are great, but do try the prawn satays, they are something else!
It's on the side of the road in Phang-na town. Great satay. Not expensive. Great peanut sauce, stop there for a good snack or satay meal. Cost about 400 baht for 5 of us
It’s all about the satay here—and nothing else. Devotees of satay in Malaysia and Singapore may walk away underwhelmed, but if you’re in Phang Nga and hankering for some, this is THE place to go.
Fantastic satay -- especially the pork and shrimp. Loved the peanut sauce and fresh salad. Speedy and courteous service.

[There's another fish ball noodles restaurant of the same name in the Phra Nakhon area (Grand Palace) that Grab took me to.  It wss not the correct one.]

Nai Ngieb Noodles restaurant is actually situated about 30 km, next to a highway, outside of central BKK. And, approx. 40 mins Grab car ride without any traffic from Silom.

There are outside sheltered non-air-conditioned, and inner enclosed air-conditioned, restaurant seating areas.  Although sheltered, the non-air-conditioned area was right next to the extremely noisy highway, and was too hot and stuffy for me.

Being 1 person, I couldn't have everything on the menu, so I ordered the Nai Ngieb quintessential: the fish balls, fish cake, fish dumplings, shrimp dumplings and crispy salmon skin.  And, I opted for the pinky Yen Ta Fo style of preparation.

Everything tasted nice and was cooked well.  Although the food itself didn't disappoint, it wasn't as mind-blowing as I had hoped... 😏 Bring Singaporean, I am still more accustomed to and prefer Singapore's version of fish balls and fish ball noodles...

Prices are definitely on the higher side compared to other vendors in Thailand.

However, the Nai Ngieb Coffee is amazing! 👍👍👍 I had 2... 😂

I couldn't help but compare Nai Ngieb Fish Noodle to the Original Chula Hakka Noodle (Banthat Thong area) that I discovered recently.  I was more impressed with the latter though, because it felt more traditionally Thai.

Unfortunately, although good, Nai Ngieb Noodle did not wow me enough to entice me to travel 30 km from BKK city centre to have another bowl of their noodles and such when I am next back in BKK.

Thank u for a great experience, Nai Ngieb!
a worth visiting restaurant for your Phutthamonthon trip (just opposite). Many dishes from fish. Noodles + sauce are tasty.

Delicious Guarantee by Michelin guides 3 years. Please try very delicious, first-time I'm impressed. Fish noodles, fish ball, fish dumplings very delicious *** recommended. There've dim-sum and variety drinks menus. There've both the air conditioner room not changing and open air. Peach back tea was good taste. Good restaurant, good service and resonable price.

All the fish menus are delicious and freshly made. I recommend the fish noodle. Their soup has a great aroma with well-balance taste.

Surprisingly their coffee also very good! Dim sum also not that bad. Really deserves the Michelin award, however, considered pricy for the portion served.

Pretty good Chinese/Thai fish ball noodle soup. You can choose different type of noodles and three different soup base: original, yentafo, and tomyum.

The restaurant is clean and air conditioned. Friendly staff and quick services. Their prices are high though compared to other similar restaurants.

Easily one of the best Michelin-starred spots in Bangkok. They really do have the best mango sticky rice, no question.

K. Panich has been around since 1932, and you can taste the tradition in every bite. The sticky rice is perfectly cooked, the mangoes are sweet, and the coconut cream ties it all together in a way that makes every other version feel second best.

The shop is located in Bangkok’s Old Town, about an 18–20 minute walk from Tha Tian Pier and Wat Pho. If you decide to dine in, they’ll give you a small slip of paper as your ticket, which you hand over once your order is ready. The seating area is across the street and shares a space with a milk tea shop, so you can also enjoy a drink with your dessert.

If you’re in Bangkok and looking for the ultimate mango sticky rice experience, K. Panich is the place to go.

This type of mango is almost perfect — a great balance of sweet and sour, just the way I like it. The restaurant is famous for its perfectly made sweet sticky rice, and it truly lives up to the reputation. If you’re in Bangkok, this is definitely worth trying. A bit pricey with a small portion for locals, but an excellent example of top-quality mango and sticky rice!

K. Panich – Legendary Mango Sticky Rice
This place is an institution in Bangkok and famous for good reason. The sticky rice is perfectly cooked, soft and fragrant, and the mango is always ripe and sweet. The coconut cream topping balances everything beautifully. It’s a simple dish, but here it reaches another level. Don’t expect fancy décor – it’s all about the flavor and tradition. A must-try if you want to taste the best mango sticky rice in the city.

Alot had been said but I guess the proof is in the pudding so to speak. We went there outside of mango season and the other mango sticky rice's  we had all had noticeably off-season mangos. But K. panich managed to find some ripe, soft and juicy mangos to serve alongside rice that was cooked just right with some salt and mungbeans. At 130 baht at time of writing not the cheapest but worth the trip

Had passed by twice during my stay as I was in the neighborhood and it was exceptionally good Sticky Rice. I don't personally think you should travel exclusively for this dish (though the area has many food finds so I think you'll end up here anyway) but I do think it's a standout version of this dish well deserving of the Bib Gourmand.

For me, the key to a mango sticky rice is how good the second half of that dish is, the Coconut sticky rice. This was one of my favorite versions of that. While sweet mangoes are a dime a dozen in Thailand, good sticky rice is often an afterthought. This is why I believe K Panich has gotten it's recognition. Very well done rice.

The fruit shakes here are also quite refreshing in the Bangkok heat

From the moment we arrived, everything at Blue Elephant Phuket was absolutely perfect. We were warmly welcomed with a beautifully presented welcome soup and cocktail, which set the tone for an unforgettable evening.

Our host Erwin was simply amazing attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about Thai cuisine and hospitality. He made us feel right at home and guided us through each course with enthusiasm and grace.

The presentation of every dish was stunning (the welcome plate was almost too beautiful to eat!), and the flavors were a perfect balance of tradition and creativity. The attention to detail  from the elegant table settings to the fresh ingredients  truly elevated the dining experience.

If you’re visiting Phuket and want to experience authentic Thai fine dining with world-class service, Blue Elephant is an absolute must. Thank you to Erwin and the entire team for making our evening so memorable!

We had a wonderful dining experience at Blue Elephant Restaurant. The ambience was elegant yet welcoming, and the food was simply outstanding—flavors that truly stood out and made the evening special.
A special mention to our host, Pathomrat, who made our visit exceptional. From the moment we arrived, Pathomrat greeted us with warmth and ensured we felt comfortable throughout our meal. Their attentiveness, knowledge of the menu, and genuine hospitality added so much to the overall experience.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for amazing food, beautiful surroundings, and service that makes you feel truly valued.

The amazing food and the superior service demonstrates why the Blue Elephant Restaurant is a Michelin Star and has received numerous awards. I had the sea bass and it was excellent. Compliments to the chef! Jane and her staff provided fantastic service to include recommendations. I encourage Jane and her staff to open a Blue Elephant Restaurant in California while bringing the same quality and service found in Thailand. Thank you to the Blue Elephant Restaurant for a memorable experience.

Delightful and charming staff who were entertaining and kind. Thoroughly enjoyed talking with them and the environment they created - Namcha and Star were really stood out.

The food served was delicious and the portion size was hUGE - taste was flavourful and well balanced. Drinks were unique and tasty also :)

The atmosphere was brilliant, we went at night and the outdoor premises were breathtaking. Went for a short stroll around after our meal.

Thank you to all the lovely staff who made our 4.5 year anniversary memorable haha.

Jane and Namcha provided excellent service and were very welcoming. The food and drinks were amazing. If you are visiting Old Town Phuket this restaurant should be on your list.This is true Thai cuisine. They have a spice shop. Purchased several Curry Pastes. Can't wait to try them at home.

Without a doubt, a very special place to return to. I went on a friend’s recommendation and it couldn’t have been a better experience. Everything stood out: the location, the service from all the staff, and especially Chef Gerard Villaret. Thanks to him, I enjoyed one of my best gastronomic experiences. An admirable professional who puts all his passion and expertise into every dish. I truly hope to return to Bangkok and experience it again.

Exceptional cuisine for finer taste pallets. The waiters were very helpful and explained everything they served to me. Bravo to the chef that orchestrated such a wonderful combination of flavours. Micheline star well deserved.

The Element at the Okura is one of the finest restaurants I’ve visited, seamlessly blending French and Japanese culinary artistry. Every dish is beautifully crafted and presented, exceeding expectations with its refined flavors and impeccable presentations.

The ingredients are top-tier, thoughtfully selected to enhance each dish, with skilled chefs elevating flavors to perfection. The staff is well-trained and attentive, delivering a service experience truly worthy of its Michelin status.

Though portions may appear small, they somehow always provide just the right level of satisfaction. The refillable bread selections are an absolute treat—enjoyable before, during, and after the meal, especially when paired with the housemade compound butter.

For special occasions, The Element never disappoints, offering an experience that is both elegant and memorable.

An exceptional dining experience at Elements, Inspired by Ciel Bleu. Every dish was cooked to perfection by an amazing chef, beautifully presented with incredible flavors. The sommelier was outstanding, and the service was flawless from start to finish. The open kitchen adds to the perfect ambience—elegant yet warm. Truly a Michelin-star-worthy restaurant in Thailand. I will definitely return!

Stayed at the Okura Hotel on a friend's recommendation and discovered this well reviewed restaurant. Managed to get a table for dinner. The food was excellent, as was the service. I particularly liked the chicken. It was done succulent and the stuffing under the skin had the same texture, such that if you didn't pay attention, you may not even have noticed the stuffing. The uni pasta and fish dishes were well executed, but the other standout dish was the foie gras. The combination of ingredients and sauce lifted the dish. Truly fabulous. Oh, and there was also dessert.

We were driving to the pier and a friend recommended this restaurant which faces the sea. The sea breeze was really pleasant. The food that we ordered didn’t take long to be served. We had steamed fish, grilled river prawns which is big, seafood salad, crab omelette. All the seafood were really fresh and it was very nice to be in the ambiance.

Definitely recommending this place to anyone.
Food is delicious and comes in big portion. Their dried-fish plate is so delicious. I bought it home.

Staffs are welcoming, non-english speaking yet helpful. View is amazing (beside the right side neighbor with all the trashes and cute dogs).

This is not my first time
So I would like to confirm the mouth watering here!
———
Two years ago I was suggested by some friends who is local in Suratthani for this restaurant
On that time I called to restaurant but the owner rejected me and she said she wouldn’t sale today. BUT RESTAURANT IS OPEN!

I decided to drive here and found out that.
LEGENDARY IS REAL!

You’ll found authentic local recipes
It’s name may like any other Thai restaurant, but the taste is never agree more!

This is BEST THAI RESTAURANT in Suratthani for me!

The food is fresh, tasty and balance.
For both Thai and Foreigners you will enjoy the real real real real ! Authentic of southern food

This is what Southern Thai Food Taste should be !
Best local food that you must try, everything I order it’s so delicious 🤤

If you a SEAFOOD lover don't miss this place. Situated on the Don Sak River running out to sea and the fishing boat harbour. The Quality of seafood is excellent. Come enjoy the food and the view. Easy to find. Google will get you there.  Don't miss it it's excellent.

Quite a high end restaurant with a great outdoor seating area on the roof.
Good entertainment with a female singer, very helpful staff.
Although the food was delicious the sweet menu was very disappointing we ordered an ice cream which came in a cardboard container what you would expect in a 7 Eleven.
We paid ฿2,000 for 6 people.
Wonderful place with nice ambience. Perfect for fine dine and special celebrations. Located close to moon river banks, Good view and relax sitting. Recommended place in ubon ratchathani
It is a wonderful restaurant by the river. The wine list was good, too. The food was normal but better for foreigners.

5 stars for this restaurant on the Mun River.
There is a huge terrace with a beautiful view over the river. The menu is very complete with all sorts of dishes from fish to meat, Thai soups, tasty and genuine...
At night, there is a live band for the animation.

Huge boat themed restaurant with various dining areas including rooftop, lakeside and bar setting, both with live performance

The issue is with the food

Were served "frozen" shashimi that was not properly thawed; can feel ice bits when put in the mouth. Horrifying!

The steak was too thin for the price and it's overcooked

Fried pork skin was not fresh and hardened

Really disappointing dining experience for such a nice set up

Dinner with friends and had to book a month in advanced, restaurant was full on our day of visit. Overall a cosy fusion style restaurant. One thing to highlight is, to maintain their quality of food, they do not allow takeaways, which imo is an excellent trait.

Highly recommend their Sam Lor Omelette, fluffy and flavorful with flowing egg when cut. The moo ping style pork rib and fried rice were also our main highlight dishes of the night.

Went here for dinner with a couple of friends, and we ended up ordering almost everything on the menu (as always). Overall, the food was really good—just note that dishes tend to be a bit on the spicy side, so let them know if your tolerance is low.

My favorites were the ceviche, Samlor omelette, and chicken cashew nut. The mystery fried rice is also a fun highlight—different each time, and both versions we tried were delicious. Even the morning glory, which I’m usually not a fan of, was surprisingly good.

We also ordered the beef tartare, pork jowl, bao, salted egg squid and tom yum—decent, but nothing particularly special. The wine list is quite nice and pairs well with the food.

The setting adds to the charm—an old Thai house with rustic, old-school decor, which gives the whole experience a cozy, authentic feel.

They do take reservations (recommended), and the restaurant has a great vibe for a relaxed Thai dinner in the old part of Bangkok.

Come hungry so you can try a variety of dishes—the menu is worth exploring.

I’d been wanting to try Samlor, so I made a reservation. Even though I arrived late, they were kind enough to seat me at the bar. I ordered their signature dish — the egg was fluffy, but overall nothing remarkable. The prawn ceviche was refreshing and enjoyable. Overall, the place feels more tourist-oriented, and there wasn’t much to shout about.

The restaurant’s décor is very charming, reminding of an old Thai-Chinese house, and the warm Thai hospitality makes the experience even more inviting. I enjoyed their special stir-fried vegetables, which were crunchy and flavorful, and the grilled tiger prawns were also delicious. For those who prefer a wetter style, the beef pad-Krapao is worth trying. However, the famous Samlor omelet was a bit too greasy and oily for my taste.

We scored a table right at opening - good thing too because every table had a ‘reserved’ sign.

We came for the viral Thai omelette but couldn’t resist ordering more. The prawn ceviche was incredibly fresh and bursting with flavour, and the wagyu tartare had that fiery Thai kick I secretly love.

But the star? That omelette. A genius mix of textures - part soufflé, part crispy fried egg, with a delicious lava-yolk centre. Absolute heaven. I’d come back to Bangkok just for this.

If you’re visiting, do yourself a favour and book ahead - this spot’s worth it.

Having lunch at Philippe has been a Bangkok lunch tradition for us for about 20 years. We come to Bangkok about 2-3 times a year, and we always find time to have lunch during those visits. The food is very French and always excellent, and the quality has remained consistently excellent for all of the years that we have enjoyed having lunch there. The service is also excellent, with well-trained staff who always welcome us and are attentive throughout the meal. Philippe is usually at the restaurant, and he always takes time to come out of the kitchen and greet us and the other guests. That special touch is greatly appreciated.

We called in to book and just found out they’ve got a Michelin too! We ordered a la carte. The scallop with foie gras was absolutely delicious, loved it. The salad was fresh and tasty. Octopus was good as well, though it leaned a bit sweet for my personal taste if you have the whole dish. Service was excellent. Thai staff were attentive.

A French restaurant near Prom Phong area in Bangkok. All dishes made of excellent quality.
The service is friendly, helpful and very responsive.

I found myself in Bangkok for Christmas Day without a dinner reservation. I had passed Philippe many times in the past and decided to check and see if there was a possibility of getting a last minute seat. Waitstaff were gracious and it was Philippe himself that arranged for a table for me. I glanced through the extensive menu and settled for the prix fixe Christmas menu. I’m happy to say that this unplanned meal turned into a very satisfying and festive Christmas dinner. The food was excellent, the service was impeccable, and the overall ambience was enjoyed by the full house. Sometimes the special memories are the ones that occur randomly. Very highly recommended. I can see why this restaurant has a successfully pleased its patrons for over 20+ years!

Authentic, classy and vintage ambience for your wonderful French dinner in Bangkok. The place is charming where you can plan for special occasion e.g. Birthday, anniversary, Valentine  or graduation. The restaurant is large enough for group of 8-10 persons.

reviewer: กลิ้ง กลิ้ง
review_text:
Local food street, Michelin guide guaranteed 2025
Open in late night

Parking at road
Easy price

Taste: salty and spicy ( Not like bangkok : sweetness first)
Amazing street food.  Order everything from the menu and you won't be disappointed.
Delicious grilled pork neck and Larb Moo. 👍

Local pork grilled restaurant. The location is in the CBD area. In the midnight time, there are many shop (mostly are restaurant) along this street. The menu focusing on E-San recipe such as Tom-Yam pork rib, Liver grilled and E-san salad. The price quite high while comparing with the quantity. Good taste. The vibes is local street food style. The parking is quite hard.
All menus are made of pork. Good taste, but a bit too spicy for me. Free dringking water. The price was low. Recommend!!

The restaurant has some really good food with balanced flavours. The decor is from yesteryear and well maintained. Being an older establishment it was on the warmer side for awhile but it got better. We were on thr 2nd floor with air con.

We had the chicken pong teh, roasted coconut salad, and local Phuket style sausages. All were delightful and very tasty.

Would recommend visiting this place.
It is really a germ find for truly authentic Peranakan food in Phuket town. Love the dining vibe that gives old Peranakan house feel. And the staffs are very helpful and attentive.

The Charm captures the golden days of the Peranakan with its embellishments and elegant finishing tucked away in the heart of Phuket’s historical Old Town. Dining here is a wholesome experience where your eyes feast first before your palate. We enjoyed the entire experience and it truly deserves all the recognition given. Make sure to make a little stroll in the night market after dinner.

Recommended dishes:
- Moo Hong – a rich and tender braised pork belly dish, deeply flavored with local spices.
- Crab Curry and Eggs with Buns(personal favourite) – aromatic delight best savored with soft, fluffy buns.

I actually stumbled upon this place while walking through Phuket. I had no idea that it had won heaps of Michelin stars.

It’s been a while since I’ve eaten somewhere and every dish was absolutely amazing. The Chinese sausage is a MUST. Such a beautiful dish.

The staff were very helpful in recommending different dishes which was very nice.

The restaurant itself is also very beautiful and unique.

We found this restaurant based on reviews, and it didn’t disappoint. The place itself reminded me of my grandmother’s home, which gave it such a cozy, homey vibe. The menu had so many great options to choose from. We ordered a lot of food, and everything was amazing. The level of spice and flavor was perfect. Definitely recommend this place!

This is one of many Bangkok's Michelin Bib Gourmand places to try.
I was staying not far from this place and I woke up early to visit this place for breakfast.
There were not many customers in the shop but the staff were very busy. They seemed to be more busy with takeaway orders than the dine in orders.
Ordering food here is very easy as you only need to choose the pork leg and rice. The size of the pork leg depends on how much you want to eat or how many people are sharing it.
Didn't take more than 2 minutes for the food to arrive after taking my order. First look it looked good and smelled good I thought one plate of rice would not be enough.
Have to say the pork leg was really well executed. The skin and the meat was so soft it could just melt in your mouth. The sauce is so addictive and special cause I would have expected it to be savoury yet it tasted sweet. And also the collagen from the skin should make the sauce thick but it was quite watery.
The smallest portion is sometimes even too much for one person. I finished the rice and still had some meat left.
I finished everything clean, the meat pairs quite well with the spicy sauce, loved the soft preserved vegetables hidden under the pork leg.
Nothing much to fault, simple meal but very satisfying. Price wise is also super reasonable in terms of quality and quantity.
Worth visiting.

Soft tender melts in your mouth sensation.
The chili sauce is mild spicy, a hint of sourness from the vinegar, blended with green and red chili to give it just enough of kick, and a good serving of garlic to give that distinct punch with the pungent-ness. Lovely street side atmosphere authentic and casual. Highly recommend.

Though I wish they served more vegetables and would like to try hard boiled eggs cooked in the pork broth.

Another Bangkok Michelin gem quest.
Located hidden in a narrow alley, you can be noticed the stall by a crowded and long customers queue during lunch time.
There's a couple minutes wait until you get seated, it is bit easy if you're alone, but maybe longer when you bring a crowd.
The service was good, the staffs work deft, organized. Once you get seated, your order delivered fast.
Their braised pork trotters is amazing, sweet and smells good with herbs aroma. The meat  was so tender that you need no effort to execute it.
The portion quiet small but indeed satisfying.
Highly recommended.

Absolutely signature dishes. One of my favorite since the first time here in Bangkok 2 decades ago. My favorite the perfect blend of fat with lean meat. Melt in the mouth. If you like part, must order a plate of organs and parts.

A small shop located in a small alley right opposite State Tower. Menu is kept simple here- they serve braised pork (trotter/meat/intestines) with rice.

The broth itself is quite fragrant and not too sweet nor salty. Pork itself isn’t too gamey but wish it came with some pickled vegetables to cut through the fattiness of the dish.

Overall, the food was worth the amount paid. Flavours had depth for most dishes.

I would highly recommend the Bai Cha Kraan salad. If you can handle your spice, I would recommend the Mum's Recipe fish as well, especially if you are drinking. Beware that the spice builds up though! The massaman beef cheek curry is too sweet for my liking but the beef cheek was tender.

Rice is THB40 and there's both white and black rice. Refillable too!

Overall, the Local is a place I would revisit (save that there are many other places and things for tourists to try😂)

The Local in Bangkok is one of those rare places that gets everything right. The atmosphere is elegant yet relaxed, the service is warm and perfectly timed, and every dish feels like a celebration of Thai flavors.

The deep-fried sea bass was exceptional – light, crispy, and full of depth. The appetizers and starters showed great attention to detail, beautifully presented and full of character. Even the drinks stood out – creative, balanced, and thoughtfully paired with the food.

It’s easy to see why the Michelin Guide has recommended The Local for so many years. It’s authentic, refined, and absolutely delicious. I’ll be back soon – without a doubt.

Have been here many times for business dinner. This time experience was fantastic, maybe because going with family. The river prawn is very fresh and the black pepper crab is well cooked. Quality of service is improved comparing before: they serve plastic glove, provide cracker on call and also teach effective way peel off prawn meat. Food price is within reasonable range for the taste, service and environment.

We had a memorable meal at The Local Bangkok. 🥰 The steamed fish was absolutely superb — fresh, tender, and full of flavour. The pork dish we tried was equally impressive: wonderfully tender and rich in taste. 💯 I also appreciated that they serve two types of rice — jasmine and purple rice — which adds a special touch and rounds out the meal beautifully. The food quality really stands out, and the ambience is charming.

Would definitely recommend and return! 🥹

😄Good :
The staff is great, and the vibe is sophisticated.
It's authentic Thai, but the dishes are fancy.
The flavor is strong.
They have a lot of options for everyone.

🤔Down:
It's a bit pricey, but I think it's worth it.

64th floor fine dining experience overlooking Bangkok- the location itself is worth booking a table at Mezzaluna. The french- japanese cuisine to the point and precise. Service of high standards especially welcome staff. French caviar and japanese oysters are also available as "extras" as well for the real connaisseurs.

Had an incredible dinner at Mezzaluna. Every course was beautifully done — the fusion of flavours was bold, creative, and just delicious. The service was thoughtful and genuine, which made the whole experience feel effortless and relaxed.

It’s rare to find a place that nails both the food and the hospitality. Mezzaluna truly delivered on both fronts. Highly recommend for a special night out!

One of the best spots in Thailand I think. If you’re intoeating peafully come here. It’s so solemn. The staffs are really so welcoming and warm. One of the greatest fine dining experiences I’ve had in Asia I think. Magnificent view while you’re eating and they also have the best wines. (If you’re in a budget, please ask the prices of the champagne they offer you before saying yes 🫣🙈) it’s all worth it. Cold pasta is the one that stood out for me and also the HUGE oyster that they serve. It was so mouthwatering.  (ofcourse for my own tasting🙈) all and all it’s such a great experience.

The day we celebrated our wedding anniversary at Mezzaluna at Bangkok was an incredible experience, an unforgettable and unique memory. From the moment we walked through the door, the customer service impressed us, reaching a level worthy of 2 Michelin-stars restaurants. The staff, with their warmth and professionalism, made us feel special every step of the way. We were seated at table 11 and enjoyed the exclusive tasting menu crafted by Chef Ismael. Although we didn’t have the chance to meet Chef Ryuki in person, the quality of Chef Ismael’s cuisine was outstanding. Every dish was a work of art, not only delighting the taste buds but also telling its own unique story. Chef Ismael’s passion and dedication were reflected in every detail, making each bite a memorable experience.
The Mezzaluna team stood out as the best we’ve ever encountered in terms of customer service. The kindness and attentiveness of every staff member made us feel right at home, and their professionalism took the experience to another level.The grand finale of the evening was the dessert by Chef Clothilde, a masterpiece that closed this culinary adventure with the perfect sweet touch.
We are incredibly grateful to the entire Mezzaluna team for the thoughtful touches that made our wedding anniversary truly special. It’s an experience we will never forget

The food is really outstanding! Every meal we had was full of flavor and cooked to perfection. I was really impressed by the service at Mezzaluna. The staff members were very knowledgable about the food and provided fantastic suggestions. Truly excellent service! This restaurant has the best ambiance. Whether eating inside or outside, you will be surrounded by beauty and charm. It's the ideal place to relax and dine in luxury. Fine meal, indeed!

The food and service quality was truly exceptional, I can’t wait to come back.

Such great Thai experience at Le Du in Bangkok. It’s elegant, jet playful. Fine dining without being to pretentious. Chef Ton who is a great ambassador for the Thai kitchen works closely with Thai farmers and fishermen to get some great produce. Flavours, textures that I sometimes recognise but sometimes they are totally new to me. It’s such a nice experience to eat here and the staff are very attentive. We had both the wine pairing and also the non-alcoholic alternative. And surprisingly equally nice!
Interior, it’s cozy and the restaurant having a fantastic light from thousands of little lamps in the ceiling!

We visited Le Du shortly after it was named the best restaurant in Asia. It was a nice experience overall, though not quite the best we’ve had - in Asia, Thailand, or even Bangkok 🙂

The signature river prawn was truly outstanding, and the coconut, sage & sesame dessert was another highlight. The rest of the dishes, however, felt more average and didn’t leave a strong impression.

The ambience was pleasant but not extraordinary, and the air conditioning was uncomfortably strong, which made it a bit hard to fully relax and enjoy the meal.

We visited several two-star restaurants in Bangkok and were utterly enchanted and surprised to find that this one-star establishment outshines all the others in terms of flavor. The service was pleasant and unobtrusive, the wine selection was exceptional, and the Thai dishes were presented with a modern twist. The food was beautifully arranged, and the cozy bistro design, complemented by an open kitchen, created an inviting atmosphere. This place truly encompasses everything that makes a gourmet heart race with excitement.

Every aspect, from the carefully curated menu to the welcoming ambiance, reflects a dedication to culinary excellence that is often hard to find. The balance of traditional Thai flavors with innovative techniques showcases the chef's creativity and skill. Dining here feels like a delightful journey through the rich tapestry of Thai cuisine, making it a must-visit for food enthusiasts.

Dining at Le Du was nothing short of extraordinary. The restaurant’s focus on seasonal Thai ingredients paired with modern techniques truly shines through in the 6-course Le Du Experience Menu. Each dish was a thoughtful expression of flavor, texture, and artistry. The portions were just about right. As the dishes were seasonal, I think the dining experience will be slightly different everytime you visit. But I’m sure the service will be impeccable.

So glad I got to meet Chef Ton in-person
The wait staff are well trained and hospitable. Food tastes most of them are yummy and some have adventurous texture and flavour. We opted for 6 course meals with wine pairing.

A luxurious Chinese restaurant guaranteed by being in Michelin guide for 9 years straight. I love their dim sum menus. Their a la carte menus are also good. But staff looking our private room was a bit moody.

Chef Man's restaurants in Thailand have been recognized with Michelin Plates from 2017 to 2025, according to Chef Man Group of Restaurants. Authentic Hong Kong-style Cantonese cuisine, with delicious dim sum, mapo tofu, and braised fish maw with egg noodles in abalone sauce ❤️ ho sek (好食)

The Peking Duck was impressive, live cutting and various choices veg and mango to eat with the duck skin. Nice place after renovation. The plates and cutleries are so fine. The service staff face was not welcoming when we called her. Good and creative food menu just the Price was quite high.

Yesterday I went to eat with my family and ordered many dishes😋 I would like to recommend the crispy pork, very delicious!!!!! and the crab fried rice and the important dishes!! …..wasabi shrimp🍤🦐 If you miss this menu, you will miss out! It’s one of the restaurants that we are very happy to visit with our family

The famous Chef man at Eastin Hotel and I can tell you that the flavor and the quality of is awesome I like everything. The chef stick to the authentic style. It’s a bit boring compared to those fusion Chinese elsewhere but hey I like it. I think it’s honest and not pretentious. The flavor and the execution is spot on. Overall it was a great meal.

Delicious food with a curated menu — not your typical restaurant, but one that serves authentic royal Thai cuisine. The riverside setting along the Chao Phraya River is absolutely stunning, with a serene and scenic atmosphere inside. The staff are very attentive and provide excellent service. Highly recommend!

you go to this place for the view!! its a very special experience, given the atmosphere and view. every table is positioned so you can see Wat Arun at sunset. everything else was icing on the cake imo. the food was beautifully arranged, and i especially liked the appetizers with the spicy lotus cups. however the meat in the massaman curry was dry and not that tasty. as a one off; everything else was pretty good.

service is 11/10; they are very attentive and kind, especially since there aren’t many people there dining together.

there’s only space for make 4 tables, total of maybe 8-10 people, so the dining environment is quiet and relaxing. you can hear the water and watch the boats going down the river while you dine, and Wat Arun and the naval station have light shows in the evening.

you need to make a reservation online, and when you arrive the gate is locked. they let you in once they know you have a reservation.

This was a very special experience I can only recommend! The grounds of the restaurants are stunning. As you enter you are greeted by this own little jungle-esque getaway.

It is recommended that you arrive around 18 o' clock, so you see the sun setting on Wat Arun, and that was so memorable and beautiful! You also receive a delicious welcome drink.

The host is so polite and kind, and also funny and makes you feel very welcome and accommodates you to every need. (Mosquitos were really agressive at one point and without saying anything, they noticed and brought out a big fan and provided me with mosquito repellant, since mine ran out!)

Now the food was also so good. They have a different menu, based on each day, and the presentation is also a work of art in itself. Whileyou do have an entrée, all of the main dishes are served at the same time. The food was very very good! The desert for the day was fine.

However, they knew it was our anniversary and they surprised us with a plate with brownies and macarons and it was so delectable! Simply because of this gesture we would come here again! 10/10 can only recommend of you want a special and unique experience.

What a setting for our family Christmas dinner. Beautiful view and the perfect place to host our family of 12 adults and 4 children.  We arrived a little early and were able to catch the sun setting before dinner started. The food was impeccable and staff were great. We had asked for some modifications to a couple of the dishes and they were able to accommodate on short notice. It was a set menu and there was plenty of food with leftovers to take home. Great for forum settings and special occasions. It can accommodate smaller groups as well. There was a small table for 4 on the same night as well having dinner.

Excellent, five star dining experience all around, set on a property owned (and lived in) by the Thai Royal family. Reservations are required and seating is limited to 20 people per night. The food is a pre fixe tasting menu, and they have a vegan menu which is what we ordered (2200THB/pp). The food was amazing, best food we had in Bangkok, very thoughtful flavor profiles over the many courses served, and very filling (we couldn’t finish all of it). The views and venue were beautiful and a nice escape from the craziness of Bangkok. Natt (the manager of the property) was a pleasure to communicate with and super professional all around. Can’t recommend this place enough.
We’re always coming here for food and icy beer. We love stir-Fried prawns and stink beans with shrimp paste, spicy beef soup, mussels with holy basil. Service is good too.

I've been coming to this place for over ten years and I always enjoy the food. The taste and quality are consistently good. While they serve excellent seafood dishes, I really love their Southern Thai food. The prices are also reasonable.

Highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who enjoys spicy Southern Thai cuisine.
Pretty good, however quite expensive. The crab and shrimp were very good and everything arrived at a reasonable time however not fast. It was a reasonable dining experience and the food was not bad.

My southern friends have consensus that this eatery is one of the best southern eatery in Bangkok, so if you seek authenticity, this is your choice.

My recommendation is focusing on southern curries and dishes, not seafood, which are fine, but you just don't have to be here for relatively bland seafood comparing to other southern dishes.

Hot, spicy and herbal stir-fry dishes are worth trying. Yellow curry should not be missed. Fish kidney curry (Gaang Tai Pla) here is a must and prepare for extreme taste like no other southern eateries in Bangkok.

Lastly, the battered-fried small shrimps is simply an awesome snack to alleviate the heat from other dishes.

Great place for Southern Style Cuisine and fresh seafood in Bangkok.  Great ambience, Wide selections of Thai dishes and seafood,  tasty Thai dishes and definitely cold cold beer.  Highly recommended for a visit if you have a chance while you are visiting Bangkok or passing by.  You will not forget the deliciousness’s of this restaurant.

We were in the mood for fish cakes but didn’t want to deal with crazy traffic, so when Google Maps popped up this spot just four minutes away, we figured, “Why not?” Best decision ever. Every single dish was spot on. Fresh ingredients, great presentation, and flavors that just click. Honestly, hard to believe the quality and taste came together so perfectly here. Huge shoutout to the two lovely ladies who waited on us, they were super friendly and kept everything running smoothly. Our only regret? Skipping dessert. (We’ll totally fix that next time.)
If you’re after tasty food, laid back vibes, and top notch service, this place is a total win.

This was the 1st time experience here and we had a good lunch.

The dishes were slightly sweet side from our taste except for Khanom Chin(w/ Green Curry).

There were two service staffs during lunch service but they seemed too busy watching their smartphone screen to take care of customers. But it's ok because of no additional VAT and service fee.

If you are seeking an exceptional dining experience that encapsulates the true essence of Thai cuisine, look no further than Banya Thai Restaurant & Home Cooking. Located in the heart of Nonthaburi, this culinary haven is a perfect blend of tradition and excellence.

Upon entering this charming old house restaurant, guests are immediately enveloped in a cozy and welcoming atmosphere that sets the stage for a remarkable meal. The menu at Banya Thai Restaurant offers a tantalizing array of authentic Thai dishes that are a celebration of flavor, freshness, and creativity.

It comes as no surprise that Banya Thai Restaurant & Home Cooking has garnered recognition from Michelin, a testament to the exceptional quality and authenticity of the dishes served here. The attentive and friendly staff further enhance the dining experience, ensuring that every guest feels like a cherished member of the Banya family.

Authentic Thai restaurant in old style house. Got 4 years Michelin gave high expectation.  Khao Chae (Chilled Thai Summer Rice) is the famous menu that available not only in Summer time but available year round, the taste was just fair, not impressive. The price was ok, cheaper than expected.

Having dinner with my family, didn’t knew about Michelin star. The quality of food is high, rich flavor and not too much spicy. We came at holiday so the food having some hiccup on serving but it’s totally worth the waiting time. I recommend Saeng-wa Kung. Best one I ever try.

Great food and great service
Authentic northern-Thai food with nice presentation
แกงฮังเล (curry) taste really nice and aromatic
แคปหมู (pork rind) is not too hard and not soggy great paring with the chillies that come with
The fried fish is also really good, I never seen this dish before. There's no bone (It's like a stuffed fish)
Although I missed the singing because I came too early, I have met the owner and the singer from the 80s famous Thai northern folk song duo. She's very kind
The restaurant was decorated in northern style with the duo picture. Many pictures of the late คุณจรัล in the restaurant
Great vibe
More on the expensive side but worth it

Shared our anniversary dinner here and it was so unique! Sat outdoors, under the lanterns, and listened to the lovely live music. We ordered the northern Thai sampler, the sweet hinlay pork curry, bamboo shoot dry curry stir fry, sticky rice, and ice tea. The food was delicious and more than enough for 2 people to share. We were new to northern Thai food and found each bite to be flavorful and full of complexity. Dip the sticky rice in the curry and nam prik, and you can’t go wrong!
Good vibes restaurant situated along Ping river with traditional Lanna food.  Live folk song music on stage is also nice.

Very nice restaurant with live music, the owner use to be a famous singer in Thailand, and she will sing in live after around 7:30 pm. The fried frog legs are so delicious, they can do less spicy here in the restaurant for spicy dishes which is very accommodating. Service is slow but people are nice.
Beautiful setting and the dishes were incredibly flavourful.  The live music really added to the ambiance.  Planning a second visit.

I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the tasting menu at the chef’s table, and it was truly exceptional. From this vantage point, I could watch the entire team at work — their coordination was seamless, professional, and genuinely inspiring. There was a real sense of harmony in the kitchen, and it added an extra layer of appreciation to the meal.

Each course was beautifully presented and thoughtfully composed, showing a clear sense of balance and intention. The dishes highlighted fresh, local ingredients and offered a creative fusion of Thai and Western flavors that felt both familiar and exciting.

The pacing of the meal was perfect, allowing time to savor each dish. The service was impeccable — attentive without ever feeling intrusive — and every detail was handled with care. Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience that combined culinary artistry, local inspiration, and warm hospitality. Highly recommended.

Had an extremely pleasant experience. Went for my fathers birthday and they did make it a special day. The food was innovative and the staff was incredibly friendly.

There are a couple points they could improve of if they want to go to higher fine dining level, but this is not in any way a negative review. If they want, I believe ,they can go even higher.

Amazing experience, amazing night and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a fine dining, unique experience.

Came here with the fam in May 2023 and took me a while to post this. This is probably the best meal we had when we visited Thailand (Chiangmai, Bangkok, Phuket). Very innovative dishes away from the city center. It was our first meal in Thailand so we were fighting jetlag, but all 4 of us agreed this is most memorable. I would definitely return in the future. Good job Chef Nan.

Just had my second visit to Cuisine de Garden in Chiang Mai, and I must say — the evolution over the past year and a half is remarkable. The food has grown more mature, confident, and conceptually focused.

Chef Nan clearly has a deep understanding of flavor metrix and the mouthfeel concept — beautifully demonstrated in dishes like the salt-cured fish with granita, where temperature and texture contrast are handled with finesse.

Though the foundation is New Nordic, the cuisine leans heavily on Thai ingredients, elevated through European technique, offering genuinely exciting and rare flavor profiles that are hard to come by elsewhere.

The ambiance is excellent, supported by a high-quality sound system and a curated playlist that subtly enhances the dining rhythm. The wine list may be compact, but selections are well-priced and thoughtfully chosen.

Service is polished, warm, and well above its price point — a rare find in this segment.

A sincere congratulations to the team. I’ll definitely be back the next time I’m in Chiang Mai. Wishing you continued success and creative energy ahead.

Cuisine de Garden is a rare gem. Located only a few minutes from the center of Chiang Mai, this under-rated restaurant has everything: brilliant food (varied, creative, offering an impressive balance in tastes), great service (attentive, proactive, passionately led by the owners) and a beautiful setup (Nordic style, with plenty of room between tables, allowing a very personal experience). If this restaurant would be in a large metropolis, you would have to wait for months to get a table and pay double the price. If you visit Chiang Mai, don't miss it. If you live in Chiang Mai, visit often (the menu is completely revamped with every season).

It was an incredible experience.  Best meat I have ever had and amazing service by Non. I am a big foodie and love meat and was a bit suspicious to see wagyu beef outside Japan and it did not disappoint. We celebrated our honeymoon here and it was the best decision we could have made. The prices are a bit high specially for Thailand but it was so worth it. Non was extremely mindful for our needs and gave us the best experience we had so far.

We had such an amazing dinner here our first evening, it was an absolute must to rebook it again for our last evening on property. The service/food was so amazing, fresh and extremely flavorful. My next trip to Koh Samui will be at the Ritz so I can enjoy the best steakhouse in Thailand.
The Ranch has a Michelin Star recommendation but they deserve the award in my opinion.
Thank you Chris, Pim, Non, Kaka, and Gift on the saxophone for the fantastic experience at the Ranch!

We had a very overly enthusiastic serving team for our table. They hurriedly cleared dishes the moment we finished. All the food was served at one go…. We hardly had started on the appetiser and the team served the main course, clearing the table as they did. Felt so hurried. Food was ok… but the price was exorbitant in relation to the food quality and the service. Don’t get me wrong, the serving team was super friendly. Maybe some training will help. It was a super hurried meal and it felt like the servers wanted us to eat quickly.

Enjoyed wholesomely over a beautiful dinner at this refined steakhouse inside the Ritz Carlton. The experience lived up to what previous diners had described - from the warm welcome to the food and consistent service.

The company and I virtually enjoyed all the menus; though my highlight goes (rightfully) to the main show: the steaks. The cuts of meat are dry aged and were prepared very nicely. The doneness level is spot on and both the wagyu tenderloin and the rib eye were nothing short of exquisite. Although, I did learnt earlier that there were cuts of picanhas and chateaubriands here but unfortunately discovered on the spot that the menu had been updated and these cuts weren't available, sadly.

Beyond the meat, we also enjoyed the seabass ceviche, the lobster bisque, the wagyu beef tartare, as well as the restaurant's complimentary set of pretzels to enjoy each.

The service was as professional as it was cordial from every member of the team - consistent, attentive and so nicely cared for. Heaps of thanks to Mai and the team for such great care and making our evening so wonderful. The refined steakhouse experience here is truly indulged.

The Ranch – Perfect Steak & Elegant Ambiance

The Ranch exceeded all expectations! The steaks were cooked to absolute perfection, full of rich flavor and melt-in-your-mouth tenderness. The ambiance was elegant yet relaxed, making it a perfect spot for a special dinner. Service was attentive and professional, ensuring every detail was just right.

If you’re looking for top-quality steak, a refined setting, and a memorable dining experience in Samui, The Ranch is a must-visit! Highly recommended. 🍷🥩✨
Every time I come back to Khon Kaen, this is a must-visit spot. The broth is rich and fragrant, the minced pork is delicious, and the offal is always clean and fresh. The taste is consistently great
Great place for breakfast. Well known for their pig blood soup and fried shrimp wontons. The soup was fine but if they could made it more flavourful this would be even better.

An original restaurant serving boiled pork and its organs, with a number of side dishes. The restaurant is quite popular with locals, so it can get crowded during weekend morning hours. Tasted quite good but not the best of its kind. Prices are a bit on the high side, but still acceptable.
Famous breakfast in Khonkhaen pork soup big portion.
Always our family’s tradition to come here every time we in Khon Kaen. So popular so good!

This is, without a doubt, a 5-star experience from the moment you step inside.

The atmosphere is the first thing that charms you. It's a truly cute and cozy retreat, utilizing warm lighting, intimate seating arrangements, and thoughtful decor that instantly makes you feel at home. It’s the perfect place for a relaxed date night or an intimate gathering with friends.

The Fusion Thai Issan cuisine here is a revelation. Every dish is a testament to the chef's commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. The vibrant, herbaceous flavors of Issan (Northeast Thailand) are elevated with modern finesse, striking a perfect balance between traditional heat and refined complexity. The curries are rich, the soft shell crab is tender, and the signature Issan charcuterie was truly a burst of flavor—you can taste the quality in every bite.

What truly seals the deal, however, is the top-notch service. The staff is exceptionally warm, knowledgeable, and attentive without ever being intrusive. They glide through the dining room, anticipating needs, offering excellent wine pairings, and taking the time to explain the menu.

If you’re looking for high-quality, inventive Thai food served in a delightful setting with impeccable care, look no further. This restaurant is an absolute gem and a must-visit.

A hidden gem in the heart of Khon Kaen! The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a clean, minimal style that feels both modern and cozy. The Pomelo Salad is a must-try — refreshing, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. Every dish bursts with bold, zesty flavors, and what impressed me most was the creativity in each plate. The staff were very friendly and attentive, even recommending dishes that turned out to be spot-on. A wonderful spot for anyone looking to enjoy Thai food with a unique and modern twist!

I’ve been coming here every time I visit Ayutthaya, and it never disappoints. This place serves very authentic Thai cuisine, cooked with care and passion. It’s first come, first serve, so I wouldn’t recommend it if you’re looking for a quick grab-and-go meal. The chef prepares each dish carefully for every table, so it’s best to order everything in one go; otherwise, you may have to wait a while.

Each curry paste is freshly made, and you can truly smell and taste the freshness and spiciness in every curry dish. Their signature Pad Thai Rai Sen is a must-try — I usually order it to balance out the heat from the Thai green chicken curry. The salted egg with squid is another favourite; the squid is tender, and the dish has that perfect sweet-and-salty flavour. My kid loves it too.

The Thai green chicken curry may not look very spicy, but the fresh spices enhance the rich flavour beautifully, while the coconut milk adds creaminess that makes it mouthwatering. Since most of the fish dishes were not available, I ordered the minced pork kra prao. At first glance, it doesn’t look too spicy, but unlike many other versions, the heat really seeps into the meat, making it unique and memorable.

Overall, this is a must-visit spot if you stop by Ayutthaya.

“Over 70 years old, this grilled shrimp is still as delicious as ever." With the technique of burning shrimp with a charcoal stove that has been passed down from generation to generation, the shrimp meat is juicy, not dry, the shrimp head is delicious, with yummy dipping sauce, easy to eat, no need to go far to Ayutthaya.

- "Grilled River Shrimp" Large live river shrimps grilled on a charcoal grill with special expertise until the shrimp meat is sweet, well cooked. The shrimp head is rich in shrimp oil, the color is very beautiful, very seductive. Scoop it and mix with hot steamed rice. Pour delicious seafood dipping sauce, fragrant with hot chili and lemon juice. It's not strange that it's a "must order menu".
- "River Prawn Tom Yum" thick soup with chili paste (no fresh milk or coconut milk), delicious and refreshing, reminiscent of childhood. The soup is not greasy. The taste is fresh and smooth. There is a sour taste, followed by spicy, salty, less sweet, and also with straw mushrooms. This is "True ancient Tom Yum".
- "Fluffy catfish stir-fried with chili paste" uses real catfish. Stir-fried dry, not messy, not wet, even if it doesn't add flour to make it fluffy like other shops. The taste is delicious and mellow.
- "Crispy boneless fish" is a seasonal menu because it only requires large and fat fish. The fish is fried until crispy. Served with "Mango salad" is another great menu that should be ordered if that day they have it.
- "Fried fish with chili" is fried fish, can be eaten whole. The chili is fragrant with chili, sweet, a little spicy. Anyone who likes fried fish with chili should not miss this dish.
- "Stir-fried gourd with salted fish" is delicious (better than stir-fried with eggs). The gourd is very well made, odorless and not bitter. Even anyone who doesn't like gourd should order it and try it as well.
- "Stir-fried fish balls" authentic fish balls stir-fried with herbs. Add young coconut tops to it. It goes well together.

# Ton Fon Restaurant - A Hidden Michelin Gem ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

**Location:** Junction between Krabi-Phuket (Phang Nga side)

Just stopped by this authentic Southern Thai restaurant during our drive from Krabi to Phuket, and what a delightful discovery!

**The Michelin Recognition is Well-Deserved**
Three dishes earned Michelin Bib Gourmand status, and after trying two of them, I completely understand why:

- **Yam Ton Fon** (Restaurant’s signature salad)
- **Moo Koey Hom** (Aromatic pork dish)

**What Makes This Place Special:**

- **30 years of consistency** - Chef-owner has maintained authentic Southern flavors since 1995
- **Locally sourced ingredients** - Fresh seafood and organic produce delivered daily from nearby farms
- **Personal touch** - Met the owner who genuinely cares about every guest’s experience
- **Quality over quantity** - Focused menu where every dish reflects the chef’s passion

**The Experience:**
As one of the few Michelin-recognized restaurants in Phang Nga province, Ton Fon proves that authentic local cuisine deserves international recognition. The combination of traditional recipes, quality ingredients, and genuine hospitality creates an unforgettable dining experience.

**Perfect for:** Food enthusiasts traveling between Krabi and Phuket looking for authentic Southern Thai cuisine.

**Verdict:** Worth the detour! A true gem that showcases why Thai cuisine earned its place on the world stage.

Toh Daeng at Baan Ar Jor is an absolute gem and one of the most memorable dining experiences I’ve had in Phuket. The decoration is beautiful, with vintage touches that make you feel like you’re dining at your grandmother’s house, surrounded by history and love.

The food is simply outstanding. Every dish reflects true Thai tradition, made with fresh, high-quality ingredients — many of them grown right in the restaurant’s own garden. The lobster was absolutely delicious, perfectly cooked and full of natural flavor. The traditional Thai curry was another highlight — rich, aromatic, and beautifully balanced, with that perfect mix of spice and creaminess that defines real Thai cuisine.

The service is equally impressive: kind, attentive, and genuinely friendly. The staff take time to explain the dishes and share the stories behind them, which adds even more depth to the experience.

Toh Daeng is not just a restaurant; it’s a place that captures the soul of Thai cuisine and hospitality. A must-visit in Phuket for anyone who appreciates fine dining with heart, authenticity, and warmth.
